== Description ==
The '''Acacia''' can be found on the grassy side of [[Ferwater|Ferwater Island]] near the bridge, and is uncommonly found in the desert. It has more branches than most other trees. It's also one of the few smaller trees on '''Finlay''', other than [[Deadwood]].

Once cut down, you can sell the log for '''$1 per stud.''' If you use the saw or a sander, you will create the sanded version of the wood which sells for '''$18 per stud.''' You can also use a planker to get the '''Planked''' version, which sells for '''$22.5 per stud.'''

Like any other material in the game, you can use logs, sanded, and planked Acacia to complete '''schematics'''.

title: Abandoned Mine
wikitext:
== ALTHOUGH THE CONTENT ARE MOSTLY REMOVED. THE LOCATION STILL EXISTS TO THIS DAY AND SERVES A NEW PURPOSE ==

== New Purpose - A gate to get back in time ==
Located by the right side beach of the main island map, near the way to Fairway Island on the right side, the cave still exists.

However, the bunker has opened.

A [[Strange Portal|gate opened]] with green color, teleports player into another place out of the game, when the game has only 2 islands. Return back in time.

The retro Oaklands

== Description ==
You will be basically back in time to the old island where landscapes are mostly flat and drivable easily back then.

Only the map revert is the significance change. But the map is slightly changes from that old time: Exists a portal with green whirl to teleports you back to main game. Only the sea of Finlay Island is saved, other waters are removed. The map takes the version when the [[Lighthouse]] are destroyed and Magma Tree no longer spawns on land (need verify on if Magma Tree still exists in that version)

Only you is the only player in that server, no one else joins. Progress are saved like normal.

=== Profits ===

* Mushroom Cave aka [[Uncertainty Cave]] will gets easier to reach since there are literal maps point exactly to its location
* [[Mysterious Mushrooms|Mysterious Mushroom]] are easier (?) to get since the cave back then has short roof, making the mushrooms closer to ground
* Since the sea are not 100% filled like back then (only the main island has proper water), you can easily gather [[Kelp]] just like a normal tree on the ground at second island
* [[Classic Store|The classic shop]] are easier to reach back then (at the back of main island), allowing you to buy classic items easily
* '''Quests are not tested, need more people performs it in this specific version.'''

=== Disadvantages ===

* Base that has basement will be half-flooded, making difficulties into basement.
* Minimaps are not loaded, making players has to use self-intuition to figure the paths (except old players who didn't have maps back then but still remember the way)
* Selling still works but by individual patches (if using [[The Oak Depot|Oak Depot]]'s selling pit or [[Radical Shack]]'s selling pit), because there was no united [[Resource Hub]] back then.
* Shops are also return to old times, meaning some items are not available to buy

== Description ==
The Abandoned Mine is a Mine located near the Bridge for the [[Ferwater Island]]. This location is the starting point for the [[Key]] and [[Uncertain Pickaxe]] quests. 

== Appearance ==
Abandoned mine is a small room located inside of a cliff. Inside there are 3 pillars holding it from collapsing, as well as a blocked off trapdoor that as of date does not lead anywhere. Walls are decorated with unknown neon ores. To the left of the entrance a button is located with runes above it which can be translated to "TRIGGER". UI of the button itself states "Registry", while the interaction prompt states "PRESS TRIGGER". Pressing it activates the [[Key]] pedestals.

title: 7 Segment Display
wikitext:
''"Allows you to display numbers. Bottom middle input allows you to provide a number input to display. Bottom left input allows you to provide a color. Top middle output is a passthrough for the number input. Optionally, you can individually activate every segment."''
{{Logic |title={{PAGENAME}} |image= 7_segment_display.png|Unboxed 7 Segment Display boxed.png|Boxed |Island=Finlay |Store=[[Alan's AutoLogistics]] |Cost=$1,400 |Object= |Purpose=Displaying numbers |Outputs= |Requires=[[Wire]] |Date Added=01/11/2023 |Version Added=1.43.0 |Status=Obtainable}} The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a structure that can be purchased from [[Alan's AutoLogistics]]. It accepts logic signals to light up sections of its display. == Functionality == The 7 Segment Display has seven inputs on the back which can be activated individually to light up the corresponding segment, with a brightness ranging from a signal of 0 (unlit) to 15 (maximum brightness). There are also two extra inputs on the bottom which accept larger signals. The input in the middle controls the displayed number: this accepts signals from 0 to 10, where 0 turns off the display, 1-9 are mapped to their respective numbers, and 10 displays 0. This input will light up parts of the matrix with a brightness equivalent to receiving a signal of 10. The input to the side bottom changes the color of the display. Top middle output is 10 when number is displayed and 0 when nothing is displayed. [[File:7_Segment_Display_scheme.png|256px]]
Colors: * 0 - white * 1 - red * 2 - orange * 3 - yellow * 4 - green * 5 - blue * 6 - cyan * 7 - pink * 8 - purple * 9 - bright white * 10 - black * All others - white ==Trivia== *Description says about top middle input while it's an output. {{Logic Nav}}

title: 14 Segment Display
wikitext:
''"Allows you to display numbers and letters. Bottom middle input allows you to provide a number input to display. Bottom left input allows you to provide a color. Top middle output is a passthrough for the number input. Optionally, you can individually activate every segment."''
{{Logic |title={{PAGENAME}} |image= 14 segment display.png|Unboxed 14 Segment Display boxed.png|Boxed |Island=Finlay |Store=[[Alan's AutoLogistics]] |Cost=$1,400 |Object= |Purpose=Displaying Numbers |Outputs= |Requires=[[Wire]] |Date Added=01/11/2023 |Version Added=1.43.0 |Status=Obtainable}} The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a structure that can be purchased from [[Alan's AutoLogistics]]. It accepts logic signals to light up sections of its display. == Functionality == The 14 Segment Display has fourteen inputs on the back which can be activated individually to light up the corresponding segment, with a brightness ranging from a signal of 0 (unlit) to 10 (maximum brightness). There are also two extra inputs on the bottom which accept larger signals. The input to the side changes the color of the display. The input in the middle accepts signals from 0 to 36, lighting up parts of the matrix with a brightness equivalent to receiving a signal of 7. Signals up to 10 function identically to the [[7 Segment Display]], where 0 displays nothing, 1-9 are their respective numbers, and 10 displays 0. However, the 14 Segment Display can display capital Latin characters, which are alphabetically ordered from 11 to 36. The table below functions as a quick reference for each character. {| class="fandom-table" |+Letter to Number !Letter !Number |- |A |11 |- |B |12 |- |C |13 |- |D |14 |- |E |15 |- |F |16 |- |G |17 |- |H |18 |- |I |19 |- |J |20 |- |K |21 |- |L |22 |- |M |23 |- |N |24 |- |O |25 |- |P |26 |- |Q |27 |- |R |28 |- |S |29 |- |T |30 |- |U |31 |- |V |32 |- |W |33 |- |X |34 |- |Y |35 |- |Z |36 |} {{Logic Nav}}

title: 4-Way Conveyor
wikitext:
{{Objects|Shop=Alan's AutoLogistics|Price=$680|Function=Conveyor belt that goes in 4 different directions|optionalTitle=4-Way Conveyor}}

The 4 Way Conveyor can be used as a single [[Straight Conveyor|Conveyor]] except it can move any object at all 4 directions. This has no square box to connect to any [[logic]] structures. It can however be switched directions by an [[interactor]] like other [[Straight Conveyor|conveyors]]. 

When facing the conveyor's direction switch and connecting an [[interactor]] to switch direction with power outputs, use these numbers as outputs:

Output of 0 - RIGHT 

Output of 2 - LEFT 

Output of 8 - BACK 

Output of 10 - FRONT 

There is also a direction for the [[Straight Conveyor|conveyor]] to not move ( also like other [[Straight Conveyor|conveyors]] ) , though it does not appear to have an input value.

title: Acid Crown

== Acid Crown ==
The '''Acid Crown''' is a quest item and equipment item dropped exclusively from the [[Skeleton King]] located in his arena near the back of the [[Acidlands]]. It serves no purpose other than to complete the Goblin arena Quest to start the trial.  

Similar to that of other worn equipment items like the [[Miner's Helmet|Miners Helmet]] or [[Refined Scooba Tank]], it can be worn and seen on the players avatar when equipped. 

After you complete the Goblin arena Quest, you won't be needing to wear acid crown anymore in order to enter the goblin shops. As well you can rematch the arena without using the acid crown.

title: Acid Smog
wikitext:
The '''Acid Smog''' is a medium-sized cave within the [[Acidlands]] caves. To find it, go left from the Acidlands entrance until you get into a cave. There, you can find a hole that goes down into the smog.

{{Buildings|Island=Acidlands|NPC=None|Purpose=Ores, NPC combat|Version Added=?|image1=AcidSmog.png}}

== Description ==
This region is characterized by a very dark, choking atmosphere that constantly deals damage to players. The terrain consists of a few islands or juts from the surrounding walls, most of which containing large pillars and green crystals similar to those seen in the [[Boomite]] or [[Quartz Cave|Quartz caves]], along with skeletons of some distant leviathan creatures. It has two entrances, both of which are in the Acid caves, and both are on the north/back of the island. Many of the acid rivers within the caves flow into the lakes in this biome, very slightly visible from the upper levels of the acid caves. 3 hostile NPCs can be found here; the normal Skeletons, armored skeletons, and goblin dogs. One of the key differences between the Acid Smog and the rest of the island is the unusually high spawn rate of [[Uranium|Uranium,]] commonly being the majority of all ore nodes that spawn, and the lack of [[Greeb]] or [[Inkstone|Ink]] nodes. 

== Strategy ==
The Acid Smog features a toxic, dense gas that constantly deals damage to anyone inside. Because of this, and the hostile NPCs, a [[Healing Coil|healing coil]] or [[Fusion Coil|fusion coil]] is absolutely required to survive in this biome. Mining ores is challenging, as anything short of an [[Uncertain Pickaxe]] deals such low damage, or such a small radius, that mining one node could take several minutes. Navigating this region is also difficult without [[Night Vision Goggles|night vision]] or a [[flashlight]], as there is almost no light within this region and multiple bridges over extremely deadly acid rivers. Should the player survive long enough to get a few trailers of ore, however, and manage to forge the uranium, they can expect to bring in well over $100,000 from one mining trip in just this part of the Acid Lands, if not $2-300,000.

title: Admin Axe
wikitext:
{{Unobtainable|There's no such thing as an 'administrator' in Oaklands, only developer.|reason=This item is exclusive to developers.}} {{Axe |image1 = Admin Axe.png|Unboxed Admin Axe Box.png|Boxed |Island = Finlay |Shop = [[The Oak Depot]] |Swing Power = 2 |Swing Distance = 50 studs |Swing Time = 3 (Instant) |Price = $0 |Version Added = Pre-release}}
''"If a tree falls in a forest and no one is around to hear it, does it make a sound?"''
== Description == '''The Admin Axe''' is an admin tool obtainable only by using a Spawn Menu. Like the name implies, it's a tool used for ease of testing for tree cutting. It has maxed out stats, capable of one-shotting most trees in the game, having no charge and 50 studs of range. == Appearance == '''The Admin Axe''' is a medium sized hatchet with a glossy pink headpiece and pearly white handle. Headpiece is pink in color with the default legacy foil material applied to it. Handle is colored white, using the default legacy wood material. It's model appears to derived from the [[Rusty Axe]], minus the improvised grip. == Gallery == Admin Axe GC.png AdminAxe3rdTexture.png == Trivia == * Early version of '''Admin Axe''' used to have a decal of the internet meme "Giga Chad" plastered over it's headpiece. DevShurikeno used to have a special variant of the Admin Axe, with a decal of...Twitch streamer XQC morphed into a Pepe the frog holding a pink heart plastered over it's headpiece. * Current design of '''Admin Axe''' seems to be heavily based upon the Alpha Axe of Testing from Lumber Tycoon 2. * Current design of '''Admin Axe''' uses the design first introduced in older Oaklands iteration - Oaklands Legacy. * "'''If a tree falls in a forest and no one is around to hear it, does it make a sound?'''" is a philosophical thought experiment that raises questions regarding observation and perception. * The admin axe was obtainable in the testing version of Oaklands * The admin axe as well as other admin tools are publicly usable in "[https://www.roblox.com/games/14171339725/Oaklands-100-Players Oaklands 100 Players]", however this game is rarely unlocked by the developers. [[Category:Tools]] [[Category:Exclusive]] [[Category:Axes]] [[Category:Admin items]]

==Description==
'''Adurite''' can spawn in '''[[Lightslate]]''', '''[[Beigeslate]]''', '''[[Darkslate]]''', '''[[Lavaslate]]''', '''[[Blackstone]]''', and '''[[Blueslate]]''' nodes.

Its refined variant uses a legacy Granite Roblox texture. Its forged variant uses a legacy Mud Roblox texture. All states of '''Adurite''' seem to be a deeper red color.

Putting raw '''Adurite''' in a refinery raises the sell value to '''$100/stud'''. Putting refined '''Adurite''' through a forge further increases the value to '''$200/stud'''.

Like every other material in the game, you can use refined and forged '''Adurite''' to complete '''[[Schematics]]'''.
== Trivia ==

* Due to an '''incorrect''' translation string, it took the name of '''[[Mythril]]''' for some time.
* You can find '''Adurite''' in both '''[[Finlay Island|Finlay]]''' and '''[[Ferwater Island|Ferwater]]'''.
* '''[[Mythril]]''' and '''Adurite''' have the '''exact''' same texture, only the '''[[:Category:Ores|ores]]''' of both have different textures.
* Adurite can easily be missed in Lavaslate since it nearly matches the color of Lavaslate.

== Fun facts ==

* Many quest items use '''Adurite''' in their name, but not as a key component, such as the [[Adurite Key|'''Adurite''' '''key''']] or '''[[Emberbane]]'''.

{{Ore Nav}}

title: Adurite Key
wikitext:
{{Objects|image1= Key.png |Island=Finlay|Price=$48,200 (in materials and Large Bombs)|Function=Creating the Emberbane Axe|Version Added=v1.4.2|Date Added=3/13/2023|Status=Obtainable|optionalTitle=Adurite Key}}
''-"?? ?? ??? ?"-''
[[File:Scaffoldin area.png|thumb|Where to find Scaffolding (look on roof)]] The '''Adurite Key''' is a special quest item obtained by completing the ''Pedestal Puzzle'', which involves placing three different Refined tools (the [[Tall Refined Axe|Refined Axe]], the [[Refined Chisel]], and the [[Tall Refined Pickaxe|Refined Pickaxe]]) onto their respective pedestals. This key is part of a larger puzzle required to make the [[Emberbane]] axe. ==Appearance== The Adurite Key is a skeleton key with a heptagonally shaped ring, a long shaft and two equal-size teeth. It appears to be rusty and corroded. This item is roughly 2.5 studs in length. ==Obtaining== : ''Note: It is advised to do this quest on a solo/private server. When the Key spawns, it doesn't have an owner, which can result in it being stolen.'' * Go to [[Mike's Mines]] from the Finlay Island entrance. Keep right until you see a large lake with wood planks suspended above it near the cave roof. Locate the rusty truss (ladder) and parkour across the planks until you reach the designated location. After climbing the truss you should see a little room in the cave ceiling with the red button at the end, surrounded by floating red particles. [https://youtu.be/r2fjzUCArGU?si=rFMUhkhAhltSHqTf Watch this video] to see how to complete the parkour without the usage of a gravity coil. '''If the button is nowhere to be seen, this means that a person in your server already toggled the quest, you can then skip that part and go to the next quest''' * *Buy the required refined tools found at [[The Oak Depot]], these being: [[Refined Axe]] [{{#invoke:InfoData|price|Refined Axe}}], [[Refined Chisel]] [{{#invoke:InfoData|price|Refined Chisel}}], [[Refined Pickaxe]] [{{#invoke:InfoData|price|Refined Pickaxe}}]. The total price of these items is $47,000. *Bring the [[Tall Refined Axe|Refined Axe]] onto the pedestal located infront of [[Alan's AutoLogistics]]. If done correctly, the pedestal will emit green particles. *Bring the [[Refined Chisel]] onto the pedestal located at the bottom of the canyon, underneath the right bridge. *Bring the [[Tall Refined Pickaxe|Refined Pickaxe]] onto the pedestal located just before the [[Lighthouse]], in the middle of the lost forest. *If successful, the items on the pedestals will disappear, the green lines will appear, and then you will hear 3 "poof" sounds followed by a loud bang. Immediately drive to the highest point where [[Corpse Flower|Corpse Flowers]] are found in the [[Acidlands|Acid Wastes]] to claim your Adurite Key, which awaits atop the pedestal. ==Map Guide== [[File:PedestalsGuide.png|none|thumb|180x180px|''(Credits to @timeywimeywaiwey on Discord)'']] ==Trivia== *This is the first quest item to be added into ''Oaklands''. *The developers had to alter the puzzle due to being too difficult to solve when it was initially implemented. *This item has been renamed to ''"Adurite Key"''. *Obtaining this item is similar to [[Uncertain Pickaxe]]'s obtainment. [[Category:Items]] [[Category:Quest Items]]

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a store in Oaklands. Part of the store is closed; the store's owner, [[Alan Burk]]. This is the location where players can purchase components and structures with which they can use [[logic]] on their property including a new [[Freyliner Transporter|truck]] and [[Freyliner Transporter Upgrade|upgrade]] for it.

== Description ==
{{PAGENAME}} appears to be two stores in one. The structure is primarily built out of red brickwork. The neon sign above the store reads "Alan's Autologistics," where the left side for Alan's Auto is written in a varsity font, while the right side for Logistics is written using a [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fourteen-segment_display fourteen-segment display]. While the Logistics side of the store is open for business, the entrance and windows for the Auto side of the store are blacked out to prevent anyone from entering or looking into the store. Curiously, the rear windows are not blacked out. In addition, the lower-left corner of the window is broken, although the reason is unknown. Additionally the Auto side of the store sells the [[Fever Vinyl]] and the aforementioned vehicle/upgrade.

Checking behind the cashier's register and looking upwards reveals multiple messages pinned to the upper side of the wall. These messages loosely direct players towards acquiring the [[Lab Card]]. This card has Alan's name on it, implying a connection between Alan and the lab.

title: Acidlands
wikitext:
{{DISPLAYTITLE:Acidlands}}
[[File:New Acidlands screenshot.1.png.png|thumb|290x290px]]Description

The '''Acidlands''' is a secondary location on the Oaklands map, off the coast of [[Finlay Island|Finlay.]] It is characterized by its green hues and its expansive acidic waters. It is accessible behind an explodable wall, requiring 3 [[Small Bomb|Small Bombs]] (or 1 TNT barrel) to break through.

*The Acidlands has two entrances:
# The Finlay entrance is located between [[Lighthouse]] and [[Flowering Meadows]].
#The Mike's Mines entrance is located to the right of the Mikes Mines Farlands entry and then downhill right again at the T intersection.

It is also possible to reach the Acidlands without spending explosives once the player has obtained a [[Refined Scooba Tank]].

The Acidlands are difficult to traverse using a car, so some tips for traversing the Acidlands are:

* Some areas may be easier to traverse on foot, it may be useful to have a grabber to move ores back.
* Having more than one trailer is risky; one trailer may fall into a hole and pull the rest of your vehicle with it, or trailers could simply get stuck in holes.
*The [[Sellner Explorer]] is the most useful vehicle for this area, as it is relatively good at traversing narrow spaces, while having about as much cargo space as a single trailer.
* Don’t be afraid to take multiple trips to avoid losing all of your ores.

== Lumberwork==
The Acidlands are the spawn locations for [[Willow]] trees and [[Windswept Pine]] trees. Willow wood offers middling profits when sold at the [[Resource Hub]]. However, their unique green coloration can be used in forest-like and mystical builds, as well as in making foliage.

==Flora and Fauna==
Near the pedestal where the Uncertain Pickaxe can be obtained, there are several [[Corpse Flower|Corpse Flowers]] on the ground. When pressed in a [[Press Machine]], it sells for $1,000 coins, making it a profitable flower for early game players. While there are no animals in the game, there are multiple references to [[Goblins|Greeb Goblins]] made.

==Mining==
Two types of stone node spawns in this location - [[Gravel]], and [[Grimestone]], which spawns in large, green stalagmite-like structures. While not unique to this area or stone type, two rare ores that have a higher chance of spawning in this location are: 

*[[Greeb]] in Marble or Grimestone nodes.
*[[Uranium]] in Limestone or Grimestone nodes. Mainly spawns in the [[Acid Smog]].
*[[Inkstone]] in [[Limestone]], [[Lightslate]], [[Grimestone]] and more nodes.

Note that other more common ores, like [[Inkstone]] and [[Iron]], can still spawn in Grimestone as well. Due to the large average size of Grimestone pieces, players can retrieve the largest possible size of Uranium at the Acidlands.

==Secret Quests==
The Acidlands also contains the main Pedestal for both the [[Uncertain Pickaxe]] and [[Key|Adurite Key]] quests. The entrance to the pedestal is slightly obfuscated - it is accessible by walking/driving across a stone bridge similar to the stone spires.

The '''Acid Wastes''' is a secondary location on the Oaklands map, off the coast of [[Finlay Island|Finlay.]] It is characterized by its green hues and its expansive acidic waters. It is accessible behind an explodable wall, requiring 3 [[Small Bomb|Small Bombs]] to break through. Deep in the cave system exists the [[The Arena|Arena]].

The Acid Wastes has two entrances:

# The Finlay entrance is located between [[Lighthouse]] and [[Flowering Meadows]].

The Acid Wastes are difficult to traverse using a car, so some tips for traversing the Acid Wastes are:

* Some areas may be easier to traverse on foot, it may be useful to have a grabber to move ores back.

* The [[Sellner Explorer|Sellner explorer]] is the most useful vehicle as it functions similar to a trailer while making narrow spaces easier to traverse.

== Lumberwork ==

The Acid Wastes contain a variety of hostile creatures such as skeletons, [[Skeleton King|The Skeleton King]], [[Goblins|Greeb Goblins]], [[Goblins]], Goblin Archers, Goblin Mages, and Armored Goblins.

== Mining ==
Two types of stone node spawns in this location - [[Gravel]], and [[Grimestone]], which spawns in large, green stalagmite-like structures. While not unique to this area or stone type, two rare ores that have a higher chance of spawning in this location are:

* [[Greeb]] in Marble or Grimestone nodes.
* [[Uranium]] in Limestone or Grimestone nodes.
* [[Inkstone]] in [[Limestone]], [[Lightslate]], [[Grimestone]] and more nodes.

Note that other more common ores, like [[Inkstone]] and [[Iron]], can still spawn in Grimestone as well. Due to the large average size of Grimestone pieces, players can retrieve the largest possible size of Uranium at the Acid Wastes.

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a structure that can be purchased from [[Alan's AutoLogistics]]. It centers objects that pass through it.

==Functionality==
The Alignment Conveyor appears as, and is otherwise functionally identical to, a standard [[Straight Conveyor]]. However, whenever an object touches the bounding box of the conveyor belt at any point along its length, it instantly teleports the object '''directly to the end of the belt''' (unlike what the description of the structure says) and centers it. This will also force objects to stand upright unless they exceed a vertical height limit, where they will then be laid horizontally.

When a vehicle or trailer is over the conveyor belt and a '''player exits the vehicle''' it causes an update on the items inside allowing them to be teleported. This means you can unload your trailer by driving on top and exiting, however they will all try to teleport at once.

==Trivia==
* Prior to update 1.52.1, the price of the alignment conveyor was $280
* Items that have been teleported using alignment conveyors seem to be unable to teleport again more testing needs to be done however you can get around this by using a drawer and some logic
* Items cannot be teleported more than once by the same alignment conveyor until another item has been teleported by said conveyor, allowing the first item to be teleported again.

title: Aroura Quest
wikitext:
{{Stub}}

The '''Aurora Quest''' is a new quest for the new [[Auroracrest Pickaxe|Auroracrest]] tools added in the 2024 Christmas Event. It requires you to have the [[Icecrest Pickaxe|Icecrest]] tools from the Ice Golem Shop and combine them with [[Heart of Borealis]] on an altar in a secret cave, The tools will only combine during an aurora, however you can "prepare" them in advance by putting everything on the pedestal.

== Guide for both of the Auroracrest tools: ==
Required items :

* [[Heart of Borealis|2x Heart of Borealis]]
* [[Icecrest Pickaxe]]
* [[Icecrest Axe]]
* [[Flamethrower|Flamethower]] ( alternatively,  3 [[Small Bomb|small bombs]] or one [[Large Bomb|large bomb]] )
* [[Grabbiest Grabber]] ( optional, reccomended. )

'''Finding the Shrine :''' The Aurora Shrine is located in the [[Snowlands|Icelands]] ( Informally called the Snowlands), It is reccomended to make your journey as soon as an aurora starts to avoid waiting for an aurora while in the shrine. 

Heading to [[Snowdrift Station A & B|Snowdrift Station A]] and across the tram to [[Snowdrift Station A & B|Snowdrift Station B]] will place you close to the shrine already. Keeping right will take you to a sign that points toward the observatory, follow the icy path toward the ramp where it leads up to a higher point of the mountain, however, do not go up. Looking right and down the ramp, there is a drop that leads to a long, thick path where there is a breakable wall of ice. Jump down with your hearts and your explosive/flamethrower. Destroy the wall and walk through the cave.

'''Getting through the Cave :''' Thankfully, the cave isnt very hard to traverse. Walk through the cave, since there are no branching directions, you can just go with no directions needed, there will be a big daunting drop, dont worry though, you can drop down easily. You will be met with an icy floor with a few gaps present at this point of the cave, swim down and through the water, going forward. When you hit the wall, swim up toward the gaps in the icy floor above you and jump out, you are now in the Aurora Shrine.

'''Making the Tools :''' If the aurora is still happening, the path will glow green, pink, and blue, if they are transparent, the aurora is no longer happening and you cannot make the tools. Walk over the path and up the stairs to a large pedestal, drop your hearts and Icecrest tools onto the pedestal, and watch the magic. The tools cannot be created when there is no aurora present.




[[File:The aurora cave while there is no aurora..png|thumb|This is the cave while there is no aurora happening. While there is no aurora, the bridge will be transparent and you will not be able to walk on it, making you fall below. The stairs to the pedestal will also not be present.]]

== Description ==
The '''Arcade Machine''' is from the [[Gift of Golden Times]], it plays a minigame based on Cookie Clicker, where instead of clicking to earn cookies, you earn logs.

You can use these logs to buy '''two''' powerups, the '''lumberjack''' and the '''handsaw'''.

* From the '''beginning''', the lumberjack costs '''15 logs''', gives '''one log per chop''', and drops a raw log on screen.
* From the '''beginning''', the handsaw costs '''35 logs''', giving '''two logs per chop''' which drops a sanded log on screen.
* A '''gift''' can drop at any point, '''increasing''' the logs given and the speed. It also enables an '''ice effect''' on the screen, dropping '''ice logs.'''

== Appearance ==
The Arcade Machine only comes in a light red and maroon color, with only a red button and a black screen

== Description ==
Bamboo spawns around the [[Acid Wastes|Acid Area]], Ook Lake, The Oasis, and the beach near [[Radical Shack]]. It was once one of the most profitable "tree" to farm before the Island Expansion Update, only overshadowed by Palm.

Its appearance consists of a short and thin base with no branches or leaves other than the thin protrusions on the main trunk, although its real life counterpart has both. Its raw variant uses a pre-2022 Sand roblox material and seems to be Moss colored. Its processed variant uses Pre-2022 Sand roblox material and seems to be Lily White colored.

Bamboo should be very tall, grow in groups and generally not in sandy areas. But in this the opposite is the bamboo that, scattered grows, is very low and in the lower right corner of the largest sandy beach there.

== Trivia ==
* Technically, Bamboo isn't a type of tree; it's officially classed as a type of grass. It is the fastest growing plant in real life.
* Bamboo was one of the last trees to get added before public alpha release. The others being [[Petrified Oak]] and [[Palm]].
* Bamboo is one of two trees to use an unusual mesh for its segments and is hollow inside. The other tree to have a unique mesh is [[Cactus]].
* After 1.3.0. all tree prices were increased by 1.25x. They were increased further in 1.3.3. by 1.4x.

== "Automatically cut logs and planks! This resizable bandsaw is perfect for any automated cutting you may want to do! Warning: Keep limbs out of reach." ==

It can automatically cut planks, and be resized to fit larger or smaller trees - with maximum size of 20x20. Much like other machines, it can be moved around in the Property Management menu. When turned on, the Bandsaw will make several cuts into the wood (or player, if you stand in its way, which deal about 20 hp/s) until the wood is removed or the bandsaw is turned off. Bandsaw's damage is fairly weak compared to a normal axe, making chopping huge wood like Sequoia relatively slow. Consider buying multiple bandsaw in a row to make efficiency in time.

title: Binary Input
wikitext:
{{stub}}
''"Takes in up to 5 bits of binary, and will output it as a linear signal."''
{{Logic |title = {{PAGENAME}} |image = Binary Input.png|Unboxed Binary Input boxed.png|Boxed |Island = [[Finlay Island|Finlay]] |Store = [[Alan's AutoLogistics]] |Cost = $580 |Purpose = Packs binary states into one signal. |Outputs = |Requires = |Date Added = 01/11/2023 |Version Added = v1.43.0 |Status = Obtainable}} The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a logic component that can be purchased from [[Alan's AutoLogistics]]. It is used to pack a binary state into a numeric signal. == Functionality == The Bit In is a logic component to pack binary states. It has 5 inputs, each corresponding to a binary digit (1, 2, 4, 8, 16) from right to left. As long as an input has a signal strength above 0, it will be activated. The output combines the binary input into one signal. This signal has a maximum strength of 32 if all inputs have a signal. == Trivia == * During testing of the Logic system, this was known as the BITINComponent. [[File:BITINComponent.png|right|thumb|180px|The BITINComponent.]] == See also == * [[Binary Output]] {{Logic Nav}} [[Category:Logic]] [[Category:Logic Gates]]

title: Binary Output
wikitext:
{{stub}}
''"Takes in a linear signal, and will output it up to 5 bits of binary."''
{{Logic |title = {{PAGENAME}} |image = Binary Output.png|Unboxed Binary Output boxed.png|Boxed |Island = [[Finlay Island|Finlay]] |Store = [[Alan's AutoLogistics]] |Cost = $580 |Purpose = Unpacks one signal into multiple binary states. |Outputs = |Requires = |Date Added = 01/11/2023 |Version Added = v1.43.0 |Status = Obtainable}} The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a logic component that can be purchased from [[Alan's AutoLogistics]]. It is used to unpack a binary state from a numeric signal. == Functionality == The Bit Out accepts a decimal signal of up to 32 and converts it into 5 separate outputs. Each output corresponds to a binary digit. For example, sending a signal of 27 to the input would enable the ports from left to right as (1,1,0,1,1). All outputs will have a signal strength of 10 if activated. == Trivia == * During testing of the Logic system, this was known as the BITOUTComponent. [[File:BITOUTComponent.png|right|thumb|180px|The BITOUTComponent.]] == See Also == * [[Binary Input]] {{Logic Nav}}

title: Blocker
wikitext:
''"When the inputted signal on the right is 0.0, the inputted signal on the left will be outputted."''

The '''Blocker''' is a logic component that can be purchased from [[Alan's AutoLogistics]]. The Blocker is related to and is very similar to a [[relay]], but has the opposite functionality.[[File:Missing Image.png|thumb]]

== Functionality ==
The Blocker is primarily used to pass along signals when the signal from the right input is off. This allows for logic circuits to be activated when a different part of the circuit is turned off. 

On the input side with two ports, the left input will be the input that voltage is allowed to pass through when the Blocker is 'activated.' The right input is used to toggle whether the left input's signal is will be outputted. Any signal greater than 0 on the Blocker's right input will toggle the Blocker to block any voltage passing through the left, resulting in a voltage of 0 being outputted.

''For example:'' A [[switch]] being turned off when connected to the right port would then allow the left port to be activated allowing voltage to pass through.

wikitext:

When it hits an ore, all of the unbroken pieces have the regular cracked texture + a layer of ice around them. (This ice does not appear to change how difficult the ore is to break.) == Obtaining == First, obtain the following items: # [[Burning Blossom]]/[[Meteor Core|Meteor core]] x 8 # [[Lab Card]] Does not consume # [[Flamethrower]] Does not consume # [[Fusion Coil]] Does not consume(For mobile use) Things to keep in mind before doing this: * Disconnecting will reset your progress and lose any items placed in the statues; make sure you have enough time to do everything. * The statues don't have to be activated in any particular order, the numbered order is the most convenient when starting from spawn. Go to the first '''six locations''' on the map and use the [[Flamethrower]] to melt the ice for each pig statue. ''Don't leave them before activating them with the blossoms or cores!'' Placing a [[Burning Blossom]] or [[Meteor Core]] into each one and the '''seventh in the Observatory''' and '''eighth in the ice cave''', you should see an orange glow in each statue. (Drag the object into them)[[File:SecondFloorInObservatory.png|thumb|453x453px|none|Map of frozen statues in the second floor of [[Gizmo's Observatory]]]][[File:Altar4.png|thumb|Frozen statue|none]] == Frozen Statue Locations (1-6) == Remember to melt + place a '''Burning Blossom''' or '''Meteor Core''' in each statue. #[[File:Altar1.png|thumb|190x190px|''This one is underneath the waterfall''|none]] #[[File:Altar2.png|thumb|none|190x190px]][[File:GoAltar2.png|thumb|747x747px|''Enter through here. At the top of the image is Station A''|none]] #[[File:Altar3.png|thumb|none|190x190px|''This one is located underwater'']] #[[File:Altar4Map.png|thumb|none]] #[[File:Altar5.png|thumb|none]] #[[File:Altar6.png|thumb|none|190x190px|''This is located higher up on the way to the Observatory.'']] == Observatory Statue (7) == Place a '''Burning Blossom''' or '''Meteor Core''' into the statue in Gizmo's Observatory.[[File:Altar7.png|thumb|[[Gizmo's Observatory]]|none]]Use the '''Lab Card''' to open the door to the second floor.[[File:Use lab card.png|thumb|none]][[File:Altar7Look.png|thumb|none]] == Cave Statue (8) == Go to the final location, using the '''Flamethrower''' if needed to enter the caves. Walk down until the floor is '''solid ice''', and there should be a drop to an area of '''transparent ice'''. (It'll be next to a stone path to the '''Void'''). Melt the ice above the huge ice block to open the entrance, and place [[Burning Blossom]] into the last statue. #Closest entry to the cave system.[[File:Closest entry.png|thumb|none]] #Go until you see the icy area with the dark rocks on the ceiling. Burn the ice above connected to the dark rocks. (Run up the sloped rocks with the [[Fusion Coil]] until you can use the [[Flamethrower]] for the ice, then jump down once the rock falls.)[[File:GoAltar8.png|thumb|none]] #There should be 7 fires already active. Place a '''Burning Blossom''' or '''Meteor Core''' in the final statue before the ice, and grab the '''Blizzard's Bane''' from the pedestal after the ice melts.[[File:InAltar8.png|thumb|300x300px|After activating 7, standing on the final statue needed to melt the ice.|none]][[File:AltarWorking.png|none|thumb|390x390px|After activating all 8, the Blizzard's Bane spawns and can be stored.]]

== Description ==
'''Blue Pine''' trees can be found on the central hill of Finlay Island. They appear as blue tinted trees with many branches that come to a point near the top of the main log. The sanded version of this wood has a bright pale blue color. 

The '''Blue Pine''' is a tree native to the central hilly region of [[Finlay Island]] where the grass grows a more blue-green color compared to the spawn region's more vibrantly green-colored grass. The Blue Pine is identified by its blue-gray bark and blue-green leaves, a color similar to that of the grass where it grows. Similar to the [[Spruce]], the Blue Pine takes on a tall, thin, and slender shape and stands about 45 studs tall, making it slightly taller than the Spruce on average. It is a heavy tree and cannot be picked up off the ground by the end of its trunk with a player's hand unless with the [[Grabby Grabber]] or [[Grabbiest Grabber]], or the player picks it up on its side near the middle. 

As with any other material in the game, logged, sanded, and planked Spruce can be used to complete schematics.

'''Boomite''' is a common ore found on [[Ferwater Island]] in a specific cave found in the desert. It can only spawn in [[Terracotta]] nodes within the cave. Boomite appears as a dark blue crystal with blue smoke emanating on the node, but as soon as the player mines the piece off, it will turn a bright orange, with orange light and sparking particles emitting from it, along with a hissing sound similar to lighting an explosive.

About 10 minutes after it's mined, Boomite will explode, causing nearby players to take damage, moving objects, and the ore itself to disappear (does not damage walls of rocks).

When placed in [[Storage Drawer|Storage Drawers]], it will not explode, however the timer continues and if the boomite is removed from the drawer it will still explode at 10 minutes from when it was mined. If it has been longer than 10 minutes, the boomite will immediately explode.

When refined or forged, Boomite will lose the ability to explode, and will return to its original blue color.

Boomite's profitability comes from how large its nodes are on average, therefore increasing stud volume, and also because of how common it is. 

==Trivia== 

*Though being able to explode, Boomite ores are unable to damage or destroy destructible walls, ores, or rock nodes of any kind.
*Ramming your car into the larger Boomite crystals in the cave will also cause them to turn orange, exploding after a few seconds. The explosion can fling vehicles, loose items, and damage players.
*Chiseling Raw Boomite causes it to return to its blue coloration, however it will still explode.
*Boomite (specifically refined) tends to fling people far into the air.
*Upon forging Boomite, its name used to change to "boomite" (all lowercase).
**This has since been fixed.

The '''Bridge''' is a landmark in Oaklands. It connects [[Finlay Island|Finlay]] to [[Ferwater Island|Ferwater]]. 

== Previous functionality ==
When first added to the game, the bridge had a short span in the middle that was a drawbridge. Both the Finlay Island and Ferwater Island sides of the bridge were manned by the [[Hyper Bridgeman]] and [[Sleepy Bridgeman]] respectively. For whatever reason, the bridgemen can't operate the bridge correctly.

For the bridge to come down, the player had to complete a "Simon Says" memory game by interacting with a panel with six buttons. These buttons flashed in a specific order. When initially added, the memory game went for a full 6 rounds, but it was later reduced to 3 rounds, before eventually becoming completely bypassed and simply activated by talking to either NPC. Once the memory game had been completed, the bridge would lower, allowing players to cross it. The bridge would then remain lowered for approximately 4 minutes, after which it would raise, and the memory game needed to be completed again.

== Current functionality ==
After the island expansion update,the bridge was no longer a drawbridge and is just a normal bridge. The bridgemen were relocated, making it just a very plain normal bridge.

</gallery>

== Trivia ==

== Description ==
The '''Brick''' is a special item bought in [[Flora Laura]] for $15. It is located in the wall in the right side room near the stairs.

== Trivia ==

* The brick can be used as a building material, one brick can fill up to 60 cubic studs, E.g. a 1x6x10 cube (See fig. 1 for example).
* The brick can be painted as of v1.63.0.
* The brick can be dyed using a [[Dye Machine]].
* A similar brick can be seen in the lighthouse in white, but cannot be bought.

== Building Tips ==

title: Burls
wikitext:
'''Burls''' are a unique sub-resource to trees[https://oaklands.fandom.com/wiki/Category:Trees]. Unlike trees, however, burls are unique in that their wood cannot be turned into ''refined planks'', but are instead highly valued by players for their unique sanded/''plank'' texture. Burls also cannot be chopped into smaller pieces. 

Burls can rarely spawn on the largest of specific living trees identified by the fact they also spawn dead variants such as stumps and fallen logs. 

As of writing the examples currently include: Oak, Petrified Oak, Birch, Red Birch, Pine, Blue Pine, Red Maple, Olive, Willow, Sakura, Acacia, Sequoia, and Spruce.

And now Shadow since the introduction of the ''secret update''.

One unique case among burls is the [[Beehive]], which is considered a woodburl material by the game but can grow on multiple species of tree leaves and may also be put through the [[Press Machine]] after being planked in order to make a jar of '''Honey'''.
[[File:Pine and sequoia burls.png|frame|center|A pine and sequoia burl.]]


All tree Burl types:
* [[Oak Burl]]
* [[Petrified Oak Burl]]
* [[Birch Burl]]
* [[Red Birch Burl]]
* [[Pine Burl]]
* [[Blue Pine Burl]]
* [[Red Maple Burl]]
* [[Olive Burl]]
* [[Willow Burl]]
* [[Sakura Burl]]
* [[Acacia Burl]]
* [[Sequoia Burl]]
* [[Spruce Burl]]
* [[Shadow tree burl]]

<s>There's rumors of a burl for the [[Suiratcal]] and [[Heavenly Tree]] however they are likely so rare that they are just rumors.</s>
This cannot be correct. Burls only spawn on trees that also spawn a dead version such as stumps and fallen logs - unlike Suiratcal and Heavenly.

title: Butterflies
wikitext:
[[Category:Meadows]]
[[Category:Ice Lands]]

== Description ==
Butterflies are a passive mob that can be found in different places around the entire Oaklands map, some of them spawn exclusively in these places and others can be found in multiple places. 

The only way to catch a Butterfly is by using the Bug Net or the Bug Catcher 3000, which are purchasable in [[Flora Laura]] Shop. If successfully caught a butterfly, they will transform into a draggable item and fall to the floor.

Butterflies can be sold in the [[Resource Hub]] depending on their type. You can also put them in a Butterfly Cage which are found in 3 different sizes in Flora Laura Shop, the butterflies that are placed inside the cage will start to fly inside it. They can also be equiped as pets, and some will give the player effects while being equiped.

title: Chantarelle mushroom
wikitext:
[[File:Chantarelle mushroom.png|thumb|Chantarelle mushrooms captured growing on the sides of acacia trees.]]
The '''chantarelle mushroom''' is a type of mushroom that usually grows on the sides of [[Acacia|acacia trees.]] One chantarelle mushroom will sell for exactly '''$100.'''

It is characterized by 5 smaller mushrooms growing in a clump with typically 1-3 spawning on each acacia tree. The item is not edible, nor can it be used to fill schematics. 

It is reccomended to use a variant of [[Grabbiest Grabber|grabber tool]] to pick these off the tree, as they are quite small and come in bunches together for easy transporting.

These are also based off of the real, ('''edible!)''' counterpart! however it has poisionous look-alikes, so be careful.

[[File:Real life chantarelle mushrooms.jpg|thumb|Real-life chantarelle mushrooms, which they are based off.]]

The '''Chestnut''' tree is one of the various trees that can be found in [[Finlay]]. It is a large, dark brown tree with chestnut shells in the leaves. Some of the larger variants also have burl twisting around the trunk.  It seems to be the largest type of tree in the game.

Like every other material in-game, it can be used to complete schematics.

Putting the tree into a material gun reveals there are 3 separate versions of it. All of them share the same textures. 

The small version that generates without burls sells for significantly more per unit. This is likely to prevent people from gaining massive amounts of money by selling one tree.

title: Computer
wikitext:
''"Applies math equations to the two inputted signals. Addition, Subtraction, Multiplication, Division, and Exponentiation."''
{{Logic|title={{PAGENAME}}|image=Calculator boxed.png|Island=[[Finlay Island|Finlay]]|Store=[[Alan's AutoLogistics]]|Cost=1450|Object=|Purpose=Performs math on signals.|Outputs=|Requires=|Date Added=01/11/2023|Version Added=v1.43.0|Status=Obtainable}} The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a logic component that can be purchased from [[Alan's AutoLogistics]]. It performs basic arithmetic on incoming signals like the boring subject in school. == Functionality == The Computer accepts two separate inputs, performs math on them according to its setting, and outputs them. The left input is treated as the left number while the right input is treated as the right number. Interacting with the Computer causes it to cycle through the following settings: addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, and exponentiation. There are two things to note about the Calculator: * There are no negative signals, and attempting to output a negative number will cause the Computer to not emit a signal. * If a Calculator set to division mode would attempt to divide by zero, then it will not emit a signal. {{Logic Nav}}

title: Commander
wikitext:
''"Activates an output when the assigned phrase is in a chat message. Outputs 10.0 if it is the owner, outputs 1.0 if it is a random player."''
{{Logic |title={{PAGENAME}} |image= Commander.png|Unboxed Commander boxed.png|Boxed |Island=[[Finlay Island|Finlay]] |Store=[[Alan's AutoLogistics]] |Cost=$1,470 |Object= |Purpose=Allows chat messages to be used in logic systems |Requires= |Date Added=01/11/2023 |Version Added=v1.43.0 |Status=Obtainable}} The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a logic component that can be purchased from [[Alan's AutoLogistics]]. It outputs a signal if a player chats something that matches its assigned phrase. == Functionality == The Commander will emit a signal when anyone chats the assigned value. This will match any part of the message: if the Commander is set to listen to the word "blue", it will also activate if someone says "I like blueberries ". If the chatter is the owner of the property, it emits a signal strength of 10; if the chatter is any other player, it emits a signal strength of 1. This is a momentary pulse, and the value will return to 0 approximately 0.5 seconds after emitting the signal. Its important to remember that other players can activate your commander to avoid this you can connect your commander to an and gate with a number interface set to 10 this way other players can’t trigger a wire signal. The owner of the property can interact with the Commander to assign it a message to listen for, up to 150 characters in length. Players can use the emote prefix to make "private" commands. For example, setting the message to "/e toggle", and then chatting "/e toggle", will activate the Commander without actually chatting a message.{{Logic Nav}}

title: Composter
wikitext:
{{Objects|image1=Composter.png|Island=Flowering Meadows|Shop=Flora Laura|Price=10,760$|Version Added=1.66.2|Function=Сreates dirt by putting a lot of flowers, plants into the Composter.|Date Added=30.08.2024}}

== Description ==
''<big>"Fill up with plant matter to produce dirt! Dirt will always come out where the arrow faces."</big>''

== Method of application ==

* With dirt, you can refine and can forge it. Also, you can fill schematics with it.
Players can throw any flowers and fruits into the composter and the like.

'''Attention''': Filling a composter can be difficult, you really need a lot of resources to fill at least 1 composter.

====== Tip: A single [[Tumbleweed]], [[Cattail]] or [[Water lily|Water Lily]] can fill the entire composter instantly. ======





Once the composter is completely full, you will not be able to load any biomaterials into it, then you had to wait about 1 minute or a little more, and then a lump of earth will form next to it, and the composter itself will be empty.[[File:Filling the composter.png|left|thumb|Filling the composter.]]
[[File:Composter work.png|left|thumb|Results of the work.]]

==Description==
The '''Classic Biome''', also known as the '''Classic Island''', is a remote area accessed via a the shoreline of [[Ferwater Island|Ferwater]]. The Classic Biome is a small archipelago of islands textured with classic studs. It contains classic trees, rocks, and ores, as well as an NPC that will trade Steel tools for Classic ones (Pickaxe and Axe only).
==Important Locations and Quests==
The Classic Biome has two notable locations. There is a [[Noob|noob]] standing in a fire ring akin to those that appear within Sword Fights on the Heights, and upon interacting with him, you can trade a [[Steel Pickaxe]] for a [[Classic Pickaxe]] or a [[Steel Axe]] for a [[Classic Axe]].

The [[Classic Store]] is located at the back of the biome across the red bridge.
==Lumberwork==
Three types of trees spawn in the Classic Biome.
*[[Tree|Classic Trees]]
*[[Classic Cactus|Classic Cacti]]
*[[Classic Purple Cactus|Classic Purple Cacti]]
==Mining==
Two types of Stone and two types of Ores spawn in the Classic Biome.
*[[Stone|Classic Stone]]
*[[Classic Sand]]
*[[Ore|Classic Ore]]
*[[Bombastic|"Bombastic" Ore]]
==Trivia==
*The Classic Biome was made by two members of the Discord server. If you're in the server, you can click [https://discord.com/channels/865737627712749579/1309957319433523270/1328770952523288667 here] to see the announcement - they're credited at the end of the message. 
*Interestingly, the Classic Biome is shaped like the [[Linked Sword]] (note the curved handguard and large pommel), an item bought in the Classic Store. This could possibly link the biome to the [[King Statues]], who all wield classic-Roblox era swords.[[File:Classic biome outline.png|thumb|Classic Biome, outlined to show it's sword-like shape]]

title: Corrupt Biome
wikitext:
[[File:Corrupt cave.png|thumb|180x180px|A hole in a mountain located in the corrupt biome.]]The '''Corrupt biome''' was an area located in The Desert. It was added during the 2024 Halloween event with purplish red and purple ground with purple crystals, and WAS mistaken to be a permanent addition. However, only the materials were stated to be permanent.

This biome was possibly a reference to the The Corruption from Terraria.

In this area you could find: [[Corrupt Deadwood]], [[Corrupted Cactus]], [[Corrupt Acacia]] [[Corrupted limestone|Corrupted Limestone]] and [[corrupted tumbleweed]].
[[File:Screenshot 2024-11-03 103930.jpg|thumb|Corruption hole from afar.]]
[[File:Corruption.jpg|thumb|This was the supposed corruption core causing the Corruption around the Oke Desert]]
The supposed source of corruption was a large [[Infused Core|infused core]] with floating boulders surrounding it.

During the Halloween updates, the corruption seemed to grow larger per update.

It seems the corruption is related to [[Mysterious Mushrooms|mysterious mushrooms]] and that it causes the corruption like the mysterious mushrooms itself gained a purpose to "invade and conquer" causing the large [[Infused Core|infused core]] or the supposed corruption core to be created. 

Evidence suggests that the corrupted meteor caused the caves and surrounding biomes to begin corrupting, yet somehow the corruption receded to only be in the caves. The only remaining remnant of the once growing spread of corruption are the Mysterious Mushrooms (and crystals) which cause any material hit with one of it's spores to turn into its subsequent corrupted variant.
[[File:Corrupt core.png|alt=The corrupt core is nowhere to be seen leaving a huge hole behind|thumb|The tunnel after the biome was removed.]]
The corrupted meteor used to reside in a tunnel it created, leading to a small underground area. However, as of now, the meteor has been removed and only the tunnel remains.

During the 2024 Halloween event, corrupted tumbleweed would spawn throughout the [[Oke desert|Oke Desert]]. title: Corrupted
wikitext:
[[File:Acacia log vs, Corrupted Acacia log.png|thumb|Corrupted Acacia log and Acacia log side by side]]
Corrupted is a general tree type that appears after a tree being hit by [[Mysterious Mushrooms|Mysterious Mushroom]]'s projectile. Cactus, Acacia and Deadwood have corrupted variants while any other wood types will become regular Corrupted. Players often seen them hitting Mushrooms and thought Corrupted must only be spawned by Mushrooms.

Corrupted has a dark purple brown-ish color outside and dark messy purple color inside. All trees being made Corrupted has same properties. Big tree or small all takes 1 hit from the projectile to be converted into Corrupted. Corrupted state convert the tree's bark color and inside as well as not changing any sizing, meshes (like Mushroom cap) begone, union (like most trees complex leaves) become a solid 1 block purple leaf based on model's shape. 

Corrupted sells for 1$ per stud, and corrupted variants sell for half the value of their normal counterparts.

The '''Corrupted Palm''' is a tree exclusive to the [[2025 Halloween Event]], and is found in the [[Corrupt Biome]]. [[Bomb fruit]] grow on this tree, which can make it dangerous to cut down.

== Description ==
'''Corrupted Kelp''' is a tree exlusive to the [[2025 Halloween Event]]. It is found in the [[Corrupt Biome]], along the coastline of Ferwater. Corrupted Kelp has mouth-like appendages that will attack the player if they get too close to it, causing damage as well as pulling the player to the base of the tree. 

== Obtaining (during Halloween 2025) ==
Go to the [[Corrupt Biome]] during the [[2025 Halloween Event]] and swim along the coastline untill you find the hole in the where you can find the kelp.

=== Tips during the event: ===
* It is recommended to have the [[Refined Scooba Tank]], as it will allow you to more easily reach and harvest the kelp.
* A [[Healing Coil]] or [[Fusion Coil]] is also recommended, which allows you to recover faster from the damage taken by the appendages.

== Obtaining (outside Halloween event) ==

# Get any kind of kelp ([[Kelp|Regular Kelp]], [[Eel Kelp]], [[Arctic Kelp]], [[Luminescentkelp]] or [[Plek]])
# Go to the [[Uncertainty Cave]] and let your kelp be hit by the spores of a [[Mysterious Mushrooms]].
# Boom! Your kelp will now become corrupted!

=== Disclaimer! ⚠️ ===
If the tree gets hit '''only once''' it will turn into Corrupted Kelp, but if its hit again, it ill turn into regular [[Corrupted]] wood. This process is irreversible.

title: Daylight Sensor
wikitext:
''"Outputs a number [0, 24), depending on current time of day"''

The '''Daylight Sensor''' is a logic component that can be purchased from [[Alan's AutoLogistics]]. It outputs a signal of 0-23 (0 is equal to 24 in a 24hr clock) depending on the current in-game time.

The Daylight Sensors appearance is near identical to the [[Weather Sensor]], with an eyeball as the main feature. The only differentiating part visually is the colour of the eye's iris.

== Functionality ==
When placed, the Daylight Sensor outputs a value of 0 - 23 depending on the current in-game time, however, the Daylight Sensor does not show the minutes or seconds of in-game time, only the hours. 

The Daylight Sensor allows the user interact with structures such as the [[Electronic Billboard]] or [[14 Segment Display]], using wires. When connected to these structures, the output number [0-9] will be shown on a singular display, and if two displays are connected correctly, the output number [0-23] will be displayed.

The Daylight Sensor is an output logic system only. It has no input connection.

Dice are an item found in [[Fungi Finds]]. They can be purchased for a price of $2,150.

The dice come in different forms, such as a d4, d6, d8, d10, d12, and d20. They can also have different colors and materials.

The description reads: "Wow, it's like they WANTED us to play Dungeons & Dragons!"

Despite being named Dice, only one is included. The singular term is "Die," while the plural is "Dice."

The d10 is only ambiguous and unfair dice since release, up to this date. Because this dice is shaped as pentagonal bipyramid, and it's incorrectly labeled on sides, not edges. It would be fair dice if the labels are on edges.

title: Duck Shrine
wikitext:
{{Buildings|Island=Finlay Island|NPC=N/A|Purpose=Adult Ducky|image1=Duck shrine.png}}

== Introduction ==
The '''Duck Shrine''' is a small cave with an underwater entrance. The shrine contains a pedestal of which to place an item, and two duck statues to either side. Before use, the Duck Shrine has a green glow with particles floating around the air nearby. The entrance is located to the right of the short arch bridge between the ''Taiga'' and the ''Grasslands'' in [[Finlay Island]]. 

To access the entrance, players must swim through the water to the hole and emerge at the duck shrine. Players will need to bring the [[Baby Ducky]] along in order to receive the Adult Ducky. 

Once used, the Duck Shrine's particles and glow will turn yellow. There is a cooldown, and it will last roughly a minute before it can be used again.

In order to exit with an Adult Ducky, players must swim across to the exit. There is a large hole on the Grasslands side of the bridge. Players will find a ladder to climb out.<gallery>
File:Duck Shrine red.png
File:Duck shrine.png
File:Duckshrineentrance.png
File:Duckshrineexit.png
</gallery>

== Trivia ==
- The [[Pebble of Truth]] quest is linked to the shrine.
- The Duck Shrine is connected to the [[Crazy Man|Epic Duck event]].

- There is a very large duck located at sea not far from the island of Pi.

''<big>"Dragonfruit, also known as pitaya, is a tropical fruit with vibrant pink skin and white flesh speckled with black seeds."</big>''

== Description ==
The '''Dragonfruit''' is an item that can be found on [[Acacia]] tree leaves (Inside the Desert) and can spawn 4-6 per tree.

It may be sold to [[Jer Junkman]] for $350 per '''Dragonfruit'''. In its jam form it may be sold for $800.

Slightly boosts mining power when eaten.

When put into a [[Composter]], the fill level increases by ~4.7% per dragonfruit.

== Trivia ==
* Strangely enough, Dragonfruit does grow on cactuses, but it grows on trees and hangs on non-existent stem.

The '''Delay''' is a logic component sold at [[Alan's AutoLogistics]].

A delay takes in an input, and sends the signal after the selected amount of time.

The Delay will output the same logic value as inputted but it only sends after a certain period of time has passed.

The '''Electrified Tree''' is an uncommon rarity tree in Oaklands. This tree can spawn anywhere on the surface during a thunderstorm. It does not replace normal trees naturally. However, [[Michael's Copper Axe|Michael’s Copper Axe]] can be used to attract lightning near a tree (during a thunderstorm) to create an electrified tree. It is one of three tree types that can spawn from an [[Meteor|Electrified Meteor.]]

== Description ==
According to the developer, Electrified Trees and their counterparts have no specific equation to follow when spawning - it is a percent chance for one to spawn on the surface during a Thunderstorm.

Electrified Trees can spawn along side [[Eel Kelp]] or [[Electrified Bamboo]] at an Electrified Meteor crash site.

Electrified Trees have roughly the same toughness as a [[Birch]] tree.

== Trivia ==
* Patch v1.34.1 changed the color from greenish-blue to light blue.
* Electrified Tree has an alternative unused teal blue wood texture instead of the neon texture.
* When sanded or planked, Electrified Tree is the fourth-most valuable tree in the game, only coming short of [[Plek]], [[Magma Tree]]s, and [[Mysterious Mushrooms|Mysterious Mushrooms]].
* The electricity particle decal is [https://create.roblox.com/store/asset/3442350641/electric this] and/or [https://create.roblox.com/store/asset/3442503630/electric-2 this]

title: Emberbane
wikitext:
''"An Adurite battleaxe, repurposed to ignite trees with the flames inside of them."''
{{Axe |image1=Emberbane.png |Swing Power = 0.7 |Swing Distance = 15 Studs |Swing Time = 1.75 |Version Added = 1.37.0 |Date Added = 18/08/2023|Price=$51,800 (in materials and Large Bombs)|Tier=Mythic}} == [[File:Diamond_Main_Titles.png|75x75px]] Emberbane == The '''Emberbane''' is a double-bladed battle-axe forged from [[Adurite]]. It is obtained through completing a puzzle involving multiple separate side-quests. It is also part of the Expert Pack as a gamepass. The Emberbane is obtained by fusing a [[Meteor core|Meteor Core]], an [[Adurite Key]], and a [[Skull|Burning Skull]] together in a cave behind a secret destructible wall. This axe has the unique ability to strike 2-3 times in a single swing on all types of wood with the notable exception of the following trees: [[Hallow Tree]]s, [[Magma Tree]]s, and [[Ash Tree]]s. While each individual hit is roughly as powerful as those delivered by the [[Refined Axe]], these hits can stack together for a small boost in cutting speed. The Emberbane also has a special bonus against Magma Trees and Ash Trees. Instead of striking multiple times, the Emberbane gains massively increased power, allowing it to cut Magma Trees in 3-5 swings (a Tall Refined Axe typically takes 16-17 swings) and Ash Trees in 1-2 swings (compared to 4-5 swings from a Tall Refined Axe.) == [[File:Hexagon_Quests.png|50x50px]]Emberbane Quest == ''**While not necessary, it is advised to do this quest on a solo server to prevent item theft.'' Three special items are required to complete this quest. Before starting, note that to complete this quest, you must at least have the following: * $47,000 to buy a Refined Pickaxe, Refined Axe, and Refined Chisel. * Around $24,000 to buy enough Bombs to explode walls at the [[Magma Caves|Magma Cave]] entrance in [[Mike's Mines]], the wooden seal on [[Skull Rock]] in [[Ferwater]], the entrance to the [[Acidlands]] (or, alternatively, the [[Refined Scooba Tank]] to drive to the Acidlands beach), and the unmarked entrance to the Emberbane ruins. The following lists the first three steps required to accomplish the Emberbane quest. Complete them in any order. === [[File:Diamond_Subtitle.png|20x20px]] Meteor Core === [[File:Meteor Crash.png|thumb|A Meteor Core at the center of a Meteor impact.]] * Obtain a [[Meteor core|Meteor Core]]. ** Meteor Cores have been buffed to have a 100% chance to spawn in both Magmafied Meteors and Electrified Meteors. ** Meteors land about every hour or so. If you want to know when a meteor lands, ask the [[Junior Scientist|Jr. Scientist]] for $3500. === [[File:Diamond_Subtitle.png|20x20px]] Adurite Key Sidequest (Pedestal Puzzle v2) === * Obtain the [[Adurite Key]]. ** Initiate the Pedestal Puzzle by pressing the secret [[Mike's Mines|Red ? Button]] in the ceiling of the underground lake in [[Mike's Mines]]. *** You should hear a special sound effect that verifies the Pedestal Puzzle is activated. Three Pedestals across the entire map of Oaklands should now display a neon red ring around them. ** Purchase a [[Refined Pickaxe]], [[Refined Axe]], and [[Refined Chisel]] at the [[The Oak Depot|Oak Depot]] for $47,000. ** Travel to [[Alan's AutoLogistics|Alan's Auto-Logistics]] in the [[Finlay|Finlay Taiga]]. Find the pedestal on the rock in-front of the store. Place the [[Refined Axe]] on this Pedestal. ** Travel to the [[Lost woods|Lost Woods]] in the [[Finlay|Finlay Farlands]] (North Finlay). Find the pedestal in the center of the forest. Place the [[Refined Pickaxe]] on this Pedestal. ** Travel to the [[Oke desert|Oke Desert]] in [[Ferwater]]. Find the pedestal inside the Canyon in the center of Oke Desert. Place the [[Refined Chisel]] on this Pedestal. ** Once all three items have been placed in their respective pedestals, travel to the [[Acidlands]] via any route. Once inside, travel upwards and find the final Pedestal. ** Collect the [[Adurite Key]] that has spawned on this Pedestal. === [[File:Diamond_Subtitle.png|20x20px]] Burning Skull Sidequest === * Obtain the [[Skull|Burning Skull]].[[File:Skull Rock Location.gif|200x200px|Location of Skull Rock, starting from the entrance to Ferwater.|alt=Location of Skull Rock, starting from the entrance to Ferwater.|thumb]] ** Bring at least six Small Bombs or equivalent from a shop that sells explosives, such as [[Mike's Mines]] shop, [[Dugg's Digging]], or the [[Pirate Boat]] shop. Place the bombs in your truck. ** Travel to Oke Desert in Ferwater. Find Skull Rock with the explosives in tow. *** Use explosives on the wooden seal on Skull Rock. Retrieve the [[Skull]] quest item. Place the Skull in your truck. *** Alternatively, travel to the [[Acidlands]] and purchase a weapon. Kill Skeletons in the Acidlands or the [[Lost woods|Lost Woods]] until you receive a [[Skull]] mob drop. *Travel to the [[Magma Caves]] in [[Mike's Mines]] with the Skull. **Use explosives to unlock the entrance to the Magma Caves. ** Place the Skull next to any Lava pool. Watch the skull to see if it darkens. ** After a few minutes next to the Lava pool, the name of the Skull should change to the [[Skull|Burning Skull]]. * * Once you have all three materials, proceed with the following: === [[File:Diamond_Subtitle.png|20x20px]] Fusion into the Emberbane === * Acquire Two [[Small Bomb]]s, which can be purchased from [[Mike's Mines]] or any other explosives shop. * Travel to the Finlay Farlands (North Finlay). Look for the back entrance to [[Flowering Meadows]]. To the left of this entrance is an unmarked breakable wall. It is tinted a slightly different brown than the rest of the hillside. [[File:Emberbane Wall Location.gif|center|thumb|The location of the breakable wall for the Emberbane Quest, starting from the [[The Oak Depot|Oak Depot]], |200x200px]] * Use the two Small Bombs you brought to destroy the wall. The entrance will be a hole, make sure to take the crafting materials with you when you drop down, as the hole is very small. Make sure you have all three materials at once before trying to fuse them - they may despawn if placed outside of your base. This passageway is no longer a one-way drop and the Fusion/Gravity coil is no longer a necessity. * Lay the items in their correct slot as indicated by the images above it:[[File:The 3 items.png|thumb|233x233px|The three items required.]] ** The left spot holds the Meteor Core. ** The middle spot holds the Adurite Key. ** The right spot holds the Burning Skull. * Once all items are inserted into their corresponding spots, all of the slots will close, consuming the materials. The center wall will begin to raise, followed by an explosion. The Emberbane will fall onto the ground to be claimed. === [[File:Diamond_Subtitle.png|20x20px]] Other Tips === * Be sure to carry the supplies in a [[Small Crate|crate]] or using [[Grabby Grabber|one of]] [[Grabbiest Grabber|the grabbers]]. This way, all of the materials will be easy to transport up to the top of the plateau, and down into the crafting chamber. * If this guide was too confusing for you check out some of the following resources! ** This [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=E6awKaeVZ4g Youtube video] for a video guide by ''FrumpyPlays''. ** This [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nWtEXKqyOfs YouTube video] for a video guide by ''Theofficialbrick.'' == [[File:Hexagon_Question.png|50x50px]] Trivia == [[File:Yup.png|border|right|thumb|Old inventory icon]] * The Emberbane is the most difficult axe to obtain as of v1.36.0. * Prior to v1.51.0, the Emberbane's inventory icon was that of the Tall Refined Axe, albeit with a black handle and red axe head. * Using 8 Emberbane can make a [[DESTROYER OF WORLDS]]. * [[Category:Tools]] [[Category:Axes]]

title: Electronic Billboard
wikitext:
''"Displays an image depending on what the input signal is. The signal input has to be a Roblox image ID. An easy way to input this number is with a number interface."''
{{Logic |title={{PAGENAME}} |image= Electronic Billboard.png|Unboxed Electronic Billboard boxed.png|Boxed |Island=Finlay |Store=[[Alan's AutoLogistics]] |Cost=$1,600 |Object= |Purpose=Displaying images |Outputs= |Requires=[[Wire]] |Date Added=01/11/2023 |Version Added=1.43.0 |Status=Obtainable}} The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a structure that can be purchased from [[Alan's AutoLogistics]]. It accepts a logic signal to display any decal uploaded to Roblox. == Functionality == When placed, the Electronic Billboard has a size of 2×2×1, and displays nothing. The Electronic Billboard can be resized up to 15×15×1, and down to 1×1×1. The Electronic Billboard has a single input port on its back side. The signal sent to the Electronic Billboard will be interpreted as a decal ID; this makes a [[Number Interface]] a requirement. The image displayed by the Electronic Billboard, unlike a [[Painting]], is not affected by lighting and always displays at full brightness. Electronic Billboard example.png|Displaying an image using a Number Interface {{Logic Nav}}

== Description ==
Also known as ''Tutorial Island'', Pi Island contains ruins and huge chunks of [[Lightslate]] that are the biggest rocks that can be found in-game. The rocks unlike normal ones found on the mainland don't have any ores. The location is found roughly to the south-east of the beaches of the deserts of the [[Ferwater Island]]. With the desert revamp changing its locations, it is highly recommended to use vehicles rather than swimming all the way there, and using the Refined Scuba Tank to drive underwater.
On the center of the island spawns one [[GIGANTIC MOAI]], which will only respawn after an 1-2 hour, though it is recommended to use a private/solo server as the moai has no owner when it first spawns, meaning others can take and/or claim it.
[[File:Captura de tela 2024-07-25 212716.png|thumb|165x165px|A big chunk of [[Electrified Rock|electric stone]] in Easter Island]]
It's possible to use the [[Michael's Copper Axe]] to transform the chunks of Lightslate into [[Electrified Rock]].[https://discord.com/channels/865737627712749579/894303481421262923/1215061614076760126]<gallery>

'''Familiar Island''' (''Unofficial name'') was a tiny mass of land located west of the [[Finlay Island]]. <u>'''Any'''</u> ores and trees that spawned on [[Finlay Island]] could be found at Familliar Island as well. The main landmark of this island was a small washed-up cabin, straight up from the older Typical Developers' title - Woodmill Inc. Touching it will yield a badge called "A Familiar Place".

To reach this island, one must locate a hatch on the shore behind the [[Lighthouse]] and traverse a long tunnel under the ocean.

This island is no longer in the game after the map destruction event, if you are looking to achieve the "A Familiar Place" badge, please go to the [[Secret Shack]] entry.

== Appearance ==
Island mostly consists of a small grass hill and beach all around it. The only noteworthy things here are: a trapdoor acting as the entrance to said island, one of the three [[Key]] pedestals and a washed-up cabin.
