{{Under Construction}} {{Missing Info}} {{Outdated}} == [[File:Diamond_Main_Titles.png|75x75px]] Ferwater (formerly Ferwater Island) == {{Buildings |image1 = Ferwater Updated.png |Purpose = To chop more expensive wood, rocks and access new areas |Island = Ferwater |Music=[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DuH0pN7Ws20 Kevin MacLeod - Desert City] (Desert, old)}}'''Ferwater''', formerly known as '''Ferwater Island''', is a remote area accessed via a bridge from [[Finlay Island|Finlay]]. While some common materials like [[Oak]] and [[Birch]] appear here, Ferwater contains more different types of trees, rocks, and ores compared to Finlay. In general, the material on Ferwater may be considered more valuable than the default materials offered on the surface of Finlay. [[Scorpions]] and [[frogs]] can also be found here and be caught for money. == [[File:Hexagon_Location.png|50x50px]] Notable Locations == Ferwater is split into several biomes, the main ones being: * Ferwater Savanna, the lush grasslands of the island * Ferwater Desertlands, also known as Oke Desert * Desert Badlands, which is home to worms, scorpions, and harsh terrain * Desert River * Frozen Desert * Desert Oasis * Classic Biome/Archipelago * Desert Rift, which has an elevator you can go to the ground * Desert Mines, where scorpions and skeletons can spawn * Boomite Cave * Mushroom Cave, also known as Uncertainty Cave Ferwater is its own island, unlike in previous updates where it was connected to Finlay. Now, the bridge is the only way you can get to Ferwater. == [[File:Hexagon_Stores.png|50x50px]] Stores == Ferwater has four unique stores, but they are quite far apart: * [[Illumine Designs]] * [[Fungi Finds]] * [[Pirate Boat|Pirate Boat Shop]] * [[Mike's Mines|Dugg’s Digging]] As the most prominent shop, '''Illumine Designs''' is located towards the back end of the Oke Desert. This store offers a wider selection of doors, decoration items, water blocks, elevators, and more advanced schematics. [[File:Illumine Designs Updated.png|center|486x486px]] '''Fungi Finds''' is a secret shop located in Uncertainty Cave hidden behind a wall that can be broken with explosives, offering quality-of-life and decoration items.[[File:Screenshot 2023-08-26 093925.png|center|461x461px]] The '''Pirate Boat''' shop is a moving store that offers high-tier explosives, useful for breaking walls to access other areas in the map. It can be located at several points in Ferwater: * Directly to the left of the bridge entrance, on the normal sand beach. * On the northernmost past of the red sand beach, on the wooden plank bridge. * At the deepest point of Uncertainty Cave, next to the breakable wall for Fungi Finds. [[Dugg's Digging]] is the newest shop in Ferwater, located high in the Desert Highlands. It's accessible by driving to the rift and taking the path on the right. You'll enter a valley where the shop can be seen. This shop offers the highest-tier explosives, the [[Boom Blaster]], and other mining themed items. == [[File:Hexagon_Quests.png|50x50px]] Quests and Secrets == Ferwater has several notable locations and hidden secrets. There are many breakable walls in this area of the map, so be sure to have a bomb or two to access these areas. The Pirate Boat shop offers high-tier explosive supplies to break down these walls much quicker. The most notable locations related to quests are listed here: === [[File:Diamond_Subtitle.png|20x20px]] Skull Rock === '''Skull Rock''' is a secret quest location hidden at the top of a lone rock plateau. Inside of Skull Rock is a secret quest item called the [[Skull]], one of the three components for the [[Emberbane|Emberbane Axe]] quest. The Skull is hidden behind an unmarked breakable floor, which takes at least three low-tier explosives to break. The Skull can then be brought to the [[Magma Caves]] in [[Mike's Mines]] to turn it into the [[Skull|Burning Skull]]. [[File:Skull Rock Updated.png|center|352x352px]] === [[File:Diamond_Subtitle.png|20x20px]]Desertlands Pedestal === The Desertlands or Oke Desert '''Pedestal''', is used for completing the special quests for the Uncertain Pickaxe and the Adurite Key, is located at the northern side of the savanna. [[File:Oke Desert Pedestal.png|center|231x231px]] === [[File:Diamond_Subtitle.png|20x20px]] Mysterious Mushroom Spore Infusion === '''Uncertainty Cave''' is a special mining area, also known as the Mushroom Cave. There are several access points from the Desert Mines and the canyon in the center of the desert. The easiest way to access this area is by driving into the canyon and searching for one of its entrances. The easiest and closest exit point is by using the Desert Mines entrance in the plateau near Illumine Designs. It contains the secret [[Fungi Finds]] shop and a potential location for the [[Pirate Boat]] shop. Players can farm [[Mysterious Mushrooms]] at this location. In relation to quests and secrets, mushroom spore projectiles from Mysterious Mushrooms can be used to enchant, infuse, and corrupt certain items. The following list describes these unique quest items, using spore projectile you can infuse: * Refined or forged [[Inkstone]] into [[? ? ?]], for the [[Uncertain Pickaxe]] quest. * A [[Meteor Core]] into a [[Meteor Core|Corrupted Meteor Core]], for the [[Fusion Coil]] quest. === [[File:Diamond_Subtitle.png|20x20px]] Classic Biome/Archipelago Access === The '''Classic Archipelago''' is an area where you can harvest retro materials (which used to spawn on Finlay during anniversary events but have since been made permanent additions to Oaklands). You can find more detailed info on these resources on the [[Classic Biome]] page. The following materials are found here: * [[Tree|Classic Trees]], common rarity, early-game tree, spawn on grass stud textures in the [[Classic Biome]]. * [[Classic Cactus]], common rarity, early-game tree, spawn on sand stud textures in the [[Classic Biome]]. * [[Classic Purple Cactus]], common rarity, early/mid-game tree, spawn on sand stud textures in the [[Classic Biome]]. * [[Stone|Classic Stone]], common rarity, early-game ore, spawn throughout the [[Classic Biome]]. * [[Oreable]], common rarity, early-game ore, spawn on Classic Stone nodes throughout the [[Classic Biome]]. * [[Bombastic]], uncommon rarity, mid-game ore, spawn uncommonly on Classic Stone nodes throughout the [[Classic Biome]], spawn with high frequency near the [[Classic Store]]. * [[Classic Sand]], common rarity, early-game ore, spawn on sand stud textures in the [[Classic Biome]]. In relation to secret quests, the [[Classic Axe|Classic Store]] located here is important for the [[Fusion Coil]] quest, where you can buy a [[Speed Coil]], [[Healing Coil]], and [[Gravity Coil]] depending on the rotating stock of this store. All of these coils except the Fusion Coil can be obtained via Daily Rewards as well. === [[File:Diamond_Subtitle.png|20x20px]] Crown Monuments === There are several Crown Monuments scattered across Ferwater, with different associated Element Symbols (for example, a symbol for fire, a snowflake, wind, acid, and a black broken heart). These monuments also wear a crown that emulates the element, with the same color. There is an in-game topographical map in the Desert Mines that shows all the locations of the monuments, with differently colored particle effects. Most notably, there appears to be a main monument located at the very top of the Desert Oasis that can be reached with Freecam. Most of the monuments are covered with sand, like the Great Pyramid in the back of the Desertlands, suggesting that this quest is a Work-in-Progress. No known function is associated with these monuments at this time. == [[File:Hexagon_Axe.png|50x50px]] Lumberwork == === [[File:Diamond_Subtitle.png|20x20px]] Crossover Trees === Several tree species are found elsewhere more commonly. For example, [[Oak]] trees can spawn in Ferwater, but they spawn in much larger groups and with greater frequency in Finlay. To hopefully avoid confusion, these seemingly universal resources (for example, Oak trees, which would not be the first tree you think of when searching for info on Ferwater) are separated. This list contains trees that are more commonly found in '''[[Finlay]]''' and other areas, but can also be found in Ferwater: * [[Oak Rails|Oak]], common rarity, early-game tree, spawns near the bridge entrance to Ferwater from Finlay and surrounding the Desert Highlands Rivers, most common in [[Finlay]]. * [[Mysterious Mushrooms|Birch]], common rarity, early-game tree, spawns near the bridge entrance to Ferwater from Finlay and surrounding the Desert Highlands Rivers, most common in [[Finlay]]. * [[Willow]], common rarity, early-game tree, spawns near the Desert Highlands Rivers, most common in [[Flowering Meadows]] and the [[Acidlands]]. * [[Palm|Palm Trees]], common rarity, early-game tree, spawns sparsely on the surface of Oke Desert, spawns most frequently on beaches. * [[King Palm]], common rarity, early-game tree, tree variant, spawns in the Desert Highlands Oasis, spawns most frequently on beaches. * [[Mysterious Mushrooms|Kelp]], common rarity, spawns underwater in Ook Lake and on beaches, profitable early and mid game but is not truly viable without a [[Refined Scooba Tank]] (mid/late game quest item). Useful for making grass textures in schematics. * [[Electrified Bamboo|Bamboo]], common rarity, spawns near inland water sources, including Ook Lake and the Desert Highlands Oasis, also spawns in forests in the Ferwater Savannah across of Ook Lake. === [[File:Diamond_Subtitle.png|20x20px]] Trees in Ferwater Savannah === Unique tree species spawn on Ferwater. Due to the presence of multiple biomes in Ferwater, the tree species differ by which part of the map you are located in. The Ferwater Savannah offers four unique tree types: * [[Wanwood|Wanwood Trees]], common rarity, mid-game tree, spawns across Ook Lake in Ferwater Savannah. Not profitable, largely used for building and filling schematics with green wood textures. * [[Redwood|Redwood Trees]], common rarity, mid-game tree, spawns across Ook Lake in Ferwater Savannah. Not profitable, largely used for building and filling schematics with red wood textures. * [[Magma Tree|Acacia Trees]], common rarity, early-game tree, in Ferwater Savannah and Oke Desert, offers different fruits depending on the spawning location. Not profitable, largely used for the fruits it produces to make jams and filling schematics with orange wood. * [[Finlay Clover|Ferwater Clover]], uncommon rarity, early-game tree, relative uncommon spawn in Ferwater Savannah. Despite being rarer, it is less profitable than other trees in this location. === [[File:Diamond_Subtitle.png|20x20px]] Trees in Ferwater Desert (Oke Desert) === The Ferwater Desert (also known as Oke Desert), located behind the Savannah area, contains multiple tree/wood types, most being desert themed: * [[Acacia|Acacia Trees]], common rarity, early-game tree, sparsely compared to the Savannah region. * [[Deadwood]], common rarity, early-game tree, spawns sparsely on the surface of Oke Desert, spawns in clusters in the Canyon. Despite its high sell-value at over $40/stud, it is not profitable due to its small overall size (like bamboo). Used for filling schematics with darker wood textures and enhance the desert biome overall. * [[Cactus]], common rarity, early-game tree, spawns frequently on sand in Oke Desert and the Desert Highlands. Profitable early-game but there are much better options as you progress. * [[Purple Cactus]], uncommon rarity, mid-game tree, spawns sparsely on the surface of Oke Desert, spawns frequently on plateaus. Profitable early to mid-game but there are much better options as you progress, especially due to its inconvenient spawn location. * [[Olivine Clover|Frisply Clover]], uncommon rarity, early-game tree, relatively uncommon spawn on Oke Desert sand. Despite being rarer, it is less profitable than other trees in this location. === [[File:Diamond_Subtitle.png|20x20px]] Trees in Desert Mines and Uncertainty Cave === The Desert is connected with a very expansive cave system called the Desert Mines. It can be accessed by many entrances across the Desert, as well as simply falling into the Canyon at the center of the area. The following denotes the tree types that spawn in these underground areas: *[[Update Log/Version 1.40.0|Bone Trees]], common rarity, scattered in the Desert Mines and Canyon areas of Oke Desert, not profitable but useful for filling schematics which white wood. Uncertainty Cave offers multiple types of Mushrooms as well as Mysterious Mushrooms: * [[Mushrooms]] (Red, Blue, Green, Purple), common rarity, early/mid-game tree, spawn on the floor of the Mushroom Cave/Uncertainty Cave. Profitable early/mid-game, but there are better options. However, comes in several color variants, making it useful for simulating colored sand and grass textures. * [[Mysterious Mushrooms]], uncommon rarity, mid/late-game tree, only spawns on the ceiling of Uncertainty Cave. Extremely profitable - caps sell for ~$2500 each, and the wood sells for over $100/stud sanded or planked. * [[Plek|Oobmab]], uncommon rarity, mid/late-game tree, spawns in Oobmab Lake hidden behind an explodable wall in Uncertainty Cave. Higher sell value than regular Bamboo but lower that Mysterious Mushrooms makes this tree less viable to farm for profit (not to mention its smaller size). Largely for filling schematics that use a purple color scheme. === [[File:Diamond_Subtitle.png|20x20px]] Trees in Desert Highlands === The Desert Highlands serves as a completely different biome in Ferwater, offering a narrower but rather variety of trees and forage. The following lists the trees that spawn here: *[[Cactus]], common rarity, spawns more sparsely as you increase in altitude. *[[Purple Cactus]], uncommon rarity, tree variant, spawns more frequently up here. * [[Cactus|Red Cactus]], uncommon rarity, tree variant, spawns on only the west side of the Desert Highlands. Not profitable to sell, but a difficult material to find and retrieve initially. Used for filling schematics with a red color scheme. * [[Queen Palm]], uncommon rarity, tree variant, spawns only at the Desert Highlands Oasis. Extremely large size and twice as profitable as Sequoia, but much higher in difficulty to transport back to base. === [[File:Diamond_Subtitle.png|20x20px]] Special and Event Trees === Special types of trees can spawn during special events - typically describing a random weather event. Only Thunderstorm and Meteor event trees are active at this time in Ferwater. If you want to see meteor locations, see the updated Map of Ferwater on the wiki! The trees that fall into this category are listed below: * [[Magma Tree]], rare rarity, late-game tree, appears at [[Meteor]] impact sites in numbers of 2-5, but can also spawn in the [[Magma Caves]] naturally. High health, but also high-return value, sell processed for large profit. * [[Ash Tree]], common rarity, late-game tree, appears at [[Meteor]] impact sites in numbers of 2-5, but can also spawn in the [[Magma Caves]] naturally. Not nearly as profitable as Magma Trees, but can be used as a dark material in builds. * [[Electrified Tree]], uncommon rarity, tree variant, mid/late-game tree, appears during thunderstorms upon lightning striking any type of tree. Can spawn in an [[Meteor|Electrified Meteor]] in numbers of 2-5. High-return value, sell processed for large profit. * [[Electrified Bamboo]], uncommon rarity, tree variant, mid/late-game tree, appears during thunderstorms upon lightning striking Bamboo near Ook Lake. Can spawn in an [[Meteor|Electrified Meteor]] in numbers of 2-5. High-return value, sell processed for decent profit. * [[Eel Kelp]], uncommon rarity, tree variant, mid/late-game tree, appears during thunderstorms upon lightning striking Kelp in the ocean. Can spawn in an [[Meteor|Electrified Meteor]] in numbers of 2-5. High-return value, sell processed for decent profit. Ferwater is unique in that it also has some special variants using [[Mysterious Mushrooms|Mysterious Mushroom]] trees. The projectile that they send at the player can also be used to perform the following actions: #By letting a spore projectile hit a piece of refined or forged [[Ink tree|Ink]], it infuses it with a special pink color, becoming [[? ? ?]] (real name is Infused Ink), unique rarity. Required for certain quests. #By letting a spore projectile hit a [[Infused Core|Meteor Core]], it infuses it with a dark aura, becoming an [[Fusion Coil|Infused Core]], unique rarity. Required for certain quests. #By letting a spore projectile hit any tree (other than [[Mysterious Mushrooms]]), it corrupts it with a dark purple color, becoming a '''''Corrupted''''' variant. #By letting a spore projectile hit any stone (other than [[Fungoidite]] and [[Fungiviolet]]), it corrupts it with a dark purple color, becoming a '''''Corrupted''''' variant. #By letting a spore projectile hit a [[Tumbleweed]], it infuses it with a dark purple color, becoming a [[Flowers|Corrupted Tumbleweed]]. #*These corrupted variants of materials were originally part of the Halloween update, but have since been made permanent via this method. === [[File:Diamond_Subtitle.png|20x20px]] Ferwater Lumberwork Summary === For a quick at-a-glance explanation on the rarities and difficulties for obtaining each resource in Oaklands. == [[File:Hexagon_Forage.png|50x50px]] Foraging == '''**NEED HELP TO KNOW IF THESE ARE ALL THE FORAGEABLES. If you do not see one that should be here, please feel free to add them! Thanks!''' **Missing the specific types of Tree Burls, a rare forage item found on (seemingly?) any tree and is specific to that tree (e.g. an oak tree burl). Listed "tree burl", but please add the specific variants as well. There are several flowers and miscellaneous items that can be picked up from all over Ferwater. Most of these items can be composted and turned into dirt using the [[Composter]]. They can also be pressed into jams (for fruits) and dyes (for flowers/other forage items) using the [[Press Machine]] and a [[Jar]]. Both can be used as decoration items. Jams can be sold at a much higher profit than raw foraged items, and dyes can be used to change wire colors. Most forage items are not worth selling, unless processed (except for a raw [[Golden Apple]], and that should be processed to maximize profit). Most forageables are not worth very much - if you plan to farm with jams/dyes, you should pick a forageable with a high selling rate that is not too annoying to get. As a whole, they should be used as decoration - or for their unique colors. Ferwater has plentiful foraging items, and some of them can only be found in particular areas. Unlike Finlay, however, Ferwater forage items have slightly higher sell value when selling both raw and processed. The following is a comprehensive list of all the forageable items that can be found in this area. === [[File:Diamond_Subtitle.png|20x20px]] Crossover Forage === Many forage items are unique to Ferwater, but it still shares a lot of common forage with other areas. To hopefully avoid confusion, these seemingly universal resources (for example, Oak trees, which would not be the first tree you think of when searching for info on Ferwater) are separated. This list contains all forage items that are commonly found in '''[[Finlay]]''', but can also be found in Ferwater: * [[Lucky Clover|Lucky Clovers]], common rarity, on grassy ground in the Ferwater Savannah. * [[Blueberries]], common rarity, from bushes in the Desert Highland Rivers and the Desert Oasis. * [[Cranberries]], common rarity, from bushes in the Desert Highland Rivers and the Desert Oasis. * [[Grapes]], common rarity, from bushes in the Desert Highland Rivers and the Desert Oasis. * [[Acorn|Acorns]], common rarity, from [[Oak]] trees. * [[Apple|Apples]], common rarity, from [[Oak]] trees. * [[Golden Apple|Golden Apples]], rare rarity, forage variant, 1/1000 chance to replace an apple, from [[Oak]] trees. * [[Pear|Pears]], common rarity, from [[Birch]] trees. * [[Coconut|Coconuts]], common rarity, from [[Palm]] trees and across the beach floor. * [[Banana|Bananas]], common rarity, from [[King Palm]] and [[Queen Palm]] trees. * [[Beehive|Beehives]], uncommon rarity, from tree leaves whilst using a [[Rusty Saw|Saw]] or picking them by hand. * [[Pink Lotus]], common rarity, from Ook Lake or Desert Oasis. * [[Water Lily]], common rarity, from Ook Lake or Desert Oasis. === [[File:Diamond_Subtitle.png|20x20px]] Ground Foraging === Certain forage items in Ferwater only spawn on the ground without any bush, tree, or log to sprout from. Ground forage items that are found in Ferwater are listed here: * [[Sunflowers]], common rarity, on grassy ground, in Ferwater Savannah. * [[Tamed Mysterious Mushroom|Tamed Mysterious Mushrooms]], uncommon rarity, on stone, behind an explodable wall in the Mushroom Caves/Uncertainty Cave. === [[File:Diamond_Subtitle.png|20x20px]] Bush Foraging === Certain forage items spawn on bushes and are easier to see. They are typically flowers or fruits that, like ground forageables, can be composted or pressed. Bush forage items that are found in Finlay are listed here: * [[Marigolds]], common rarity, on most bushes in Ferwater Savannah. * [[Kiwis]], common rarity, uncommonly on some bushes in Ferwater Savannah. === [[File:Diamond_Subtitle.png|20x20px]] Tree Foraging === Certain forage items spawn on trees and are sometimes visible on the leaves of the tree. If the tree is cut down, the forage items can still be picked up. There is a percent chance that the forage item will ''rot and disappear'' if using a regular Axe. However, forage items are guaranteed not to rot if you ''pick them by hand'' or use the [[Living Axe]]. They are typically seeds or fruits that, like other forageables, can be composted or pressed. Tree forage items that are found in Ferwater are listed here: * [[Lemon|Lemons]], common rarity, on [[Acacia]] trees, in Ferwater Savannah. * [[Orange|Oranges]], common rarity, on [[Acacia]] trees, in Ferwater Savannah across Ook Lake (closer to the beaches). * [[Dragonfruit|Dragonfruits]], common rarity, on [[Acacia]] trees, in Oke Desert. * [[Green Cactus Flower|Green Cactus Flowers]], common rarity, on [[Cactus]], in Oke Desert. * [[Purple Cactus Flower|Purple Cactus Flowers]], uncommon rarity, on [[Purple Cactus]], in Oke Desert and the Desert Highlands. **Need more info on tree burls haven't found one yet. - Snowdin * [[Tree Burls]], rare rarity, forage variant, rare chance to spawn on any tree with wood. === [[File:Diamond_Subtitle.png|20x20px]] Miscellaneous Foraging === Certain forage items have unique spawn conditions. This includes mushrooms that spawn on tree bark and fallen trees/stumps (detritus). Others must have water to spawn on or have strange spawn conditions. Like other forageables, can be composted or pressed. Miscellaneous forage items that are found in Ferwater are listed here: * [[Chantarelle Mushrooms]], common rarity, on the ground or on tree bark and on tree detritus (mostly Acacia), in Ferwater Savannah. * [[Chicken Mushrooms]], common rarity, on tree bark and on tree detritus, in Ferwater Savannah. * [[Tumbleweed]], common rarity, rolling across Oke Desert at random. * [[Corrupted tumbleweed|Corrupted Tumbleweed]], uncommon rarity, forage variant, made by infusing a normal Tumbleweed with [[Mysterious Mushrooms|Mysterious Mushroom]] spores. === [[File:Diamond_Subtitle.png|20x20px]] Event or Weather Foraging === Certain forage items have unique spawn conditions. This includes spawning only at night, falling from the sky, or rarer events like Meteors. Seasonal foraging (E.g. ghosts (firefly reskin), St. Patrick's day, moon shards from Halloween, etc.) can also be included here. **Star Chances need testing for confirmation. Star chances and weather event calculations are ''estimated''. * [[Stars]] (Yellow/Green/Red/Blue/Purple), common rarity, forage variant, spawn anywhere on the surface of Ferwater at night. * [[Fireflies]] (Yellow/Green/Red/Blue/Purple), common rarity, forage variant, spawn anywhere on the surface of Ferwater at night. ** Yellow, common rarity, has a ~84% or ~8/10 spawn chance. ** Green, common rarity, has a 10% or 1/10 spawn chance. ** Red, common rarity, has a 5% or 1/20 spawn chance. ** Blue, uncommon rarity, has a 0.9% or roughly ~1/100 spawn chance ** Purple, rare rarity, is the rarest variant. Has a <0.1% or 1/1000 spawn chance. * Note that the frequency of star spawns depend upon the ''weather'': ** During ''stormy'' conditions (such as rainy or thunderstorm), star spawning is reduced by about 0.5X. ** A ''clear'' night has a 1/5 chance to be a star shower, where stars spawn 2X more than usual. * [[Meteor Core]], uncommon rarity, 100% spawn chance from both a [[Meteor|Magmafied Meteor]] and an [[Meteor|Electrified Meteor]]. Used for special quests. == Trivia == * Ferwater was the second island to be added to the game, after Finlay Island. * [[Blackstone]] nodes used to be able to only spawn in the [[Magma Caves]], but have been readded to Ferwater across Ook Lake. * There is a truck, supposedly the [[Sellner Explorer]], sunken with its nose buried in the sand in a lake that is to the left of the entrance to Ferwater, near where the [[Pirate Boat]] spawns. It appears to have ran through a fence, indicated by the tire marks, and plunged into the lake. {{Locations Nav}} [[Category:Locations]]

title: Fairway Island
wikitext:
{{Under Construction}}

== [[File:Diamond_Main_Titles.png|75x75px]] Fairway Island ==
{{Buildings|image1=Fairway Island.png|NPC=Mr. Golf|Purpose=Golfing materials and the Golden Golf Club Quest|Version Added=ver1.84.0}}
'''Fairway Island''', added to Oaklands in the 1.84.0 update alongside golf-themed items, is a special location connecting to the Grasslands Beach in [[Finlay]]. The island offers a golfing shop, which offers golf clubs, special turf materials, and other golf-related items. The island offers 18 holes in total. These 18 holes are based off of locations in other parts of Oaklands, including [[Ferwater]], the Desert Highlands, Mushroom/[[Uncertainty Cave]], Boomite Caves, the Finlay Taiga, the [[Snowy peaks|Snowy Peaks]], the [[Icelands]], the [[Acidlands]], the [[River Caves]], and [[Magma Caves]]. 

Note that all the stone/ore nodes and trees that are here serve as obstacles ''only''. You can not use any axe or pickaxe on any of the resources that spawn here. 

== [[File:Hexagon_Stores.png|50x50px]] Stores ==

=== [[File:Diamond_Subtitle.png|20x20px]] Hole in One ===
The '''Hole in One''' is the only shop on Fairway Island. The store is run by Mr. Golf. The store offers a wide variety of Golf-related items, specifically the golf clubs needed to complete the Golden Golf Club quest. Furthermore, he offers Seasonal Grass that changes with the biome you spawn in and dyeable golfing Turf. The store also offers special Tube schematics.

* Unlike cars, Golf Clubs and Drivers all have equal probabilities of color.
* Golf Clubs have a 1/100,000 or 0.001% chance to be a Neon variant (even ''rarer'' than Neon variant cars at 1/10000!). 
** Normal Golf Clubs sell for $1000. To have an estimated 100% chance of obtaining one, it would roughly cost <u>$10 million</u> for a Neon Golf Club, depending on RNG.
** Normal Drivers sell for $3000. To have an estimated 100% chance of obtaining one, it would roughly cost <u>$30 million</u> for a Neon Driver, depending on RNG.

== [[File:Hexagon_Quests.png|50x50px]] Quests and Secrets ==
[[File:Golden Golf Club, Golden Driver Golf Club, and Golden Golf-Tee.png|thumb|Golden Golf Club, Golden Driver Golf Club, and Golden Golf-Tee as reward for the Golf Quest.]]

=== [[File:Diamond_Subtitle.png|20x20px]] The Golden Golf Club ===
When talking with the NPC, Mr. Golf, in the shop, he reveals that he will provide a special reward to those who complete all 18 holes on Fairway Island. However, you do not need to talk to Mr. Golf to initiate the quest. After completing all 18 holes, talk with Mr. Golf to claim your reward. He will provide you with the Golden Golf Club, the Golden Driver Golf Club, and the Golden Golf Tee.

* This quest can take some time depending on how skilled you are at ROBLOX golf to complete.

=== [[File:Diamond_Subtitle.png|20x20px]] Secret Bonus Holes ===
[[File:Fairway Island 19th Hole.png|thumb|Secret Bonus Hole on a Rock]]
There are several secret holes on Fairway Island, but they <u>do not give any rewards</u>. Even so, these holes are typically much harder compared to the standard set of 18 holes for the Golden Golf Club quest. For example, one of these holes is located on a rock island.

Instead of following the normal path from the entrance, drive to the right - you should see a small brown rock island off a bit into the distance. There is, in fact, a golf flagpole on this small island. The golf tee for this secret 19th hole is on a stump; follow the signs in the small forest to reach it. A Driver Golf Club appears to be required to score on this hole.

Secret route 20 - from the magma caves to the IceLands peaks. In one of the corners of the magma cave, find a golf ball and bring it to the top of the left IceLands mountain.

Secret route 21 - from the peak of AcidLands to the oasis. Find a ball on one of the peaks in AcidLands and then bring it to the farthest edge of the oasis, to the hole below the waterfall.

Please note that there are no rewards for secret holes. Take your time at your own risk.

* If you are thinking of cheating by using blocks or crates to make these secret holes easier, think again! Golf balls on Fairway Island go through these items.
* You can only get to the secret hole 19 with one shot, as the distance from the shore to the hole is too long.

title: Finlay
wikitext: {{Buildings |image1 = Finlay Updated.png |Purpose = Player Spawn, Oak Depot |Island = Finlay |Version Added = v1.0.0 |Date Added = 14/01/2023}} == [[File:Diamond Main Titles.png|75x75px]] Finlay (formerly Finlay Island) == '''Finlay''', or Finlay Island as it was once known, is the part of the map where all players can load their properties in. Beginner Tree Species and Rock Nodes spawn on the surface. Finlay also offers immediate access to a few beaches. The area also serves as the main junction connecting all the various locales that Oaklands offers. Finlay provides eight different property plots for players to load in. After the Oaklands map update, player properties are now spaced apart, with a complete revamp of the starting area. They each have distinct advantages: * Plot 3 is the closest plot to almost everything in Oaklands, namely [[Ferwater]] and [[Snowy peaks|Snowy Peaks]]. It is especially nice due to its close location to the [[Resource Hub]] to quickly sell resources. * Plot 4 and Plot 5 are the closest plots to [[Snowy peaks|Snowy Peaks]] (and, consequently, the [[Icelands]]). Also quick access to [[Alan's AutoLogistics|Alan's Auto-Logistics]]. * Plot 1 and Plot 2 are placed in the center of the Grasslands, with quick access to [[Mike's Mines]], the [[The Oak Depot|Oak Depot]], and starter resources on Finlay. * Plot 6, 7, and 8 are often less contested due to their much farther distance from most relevant resources in the game, but they do have some small benefits: ** Plot 6 has an alternate entrance to [[Mike's Mines]] and a Meteor Spawn location right in front of it. Also the closest plot to [[Alan's AutoLogistics|Alan's Auto-Logistics]]. Can access the [[Magma Caves]] quickly. ** Plot 7 and Plot 8 are close to [[Flowering Meadows]] and the far side of the Finlay Taiga, so they are closer to the [[Acidlands]]. One of the plots has an alternate entrance to [[Mike's Mines]] too. Can access the [[Magma Caves]] quickly. == [[File:Hexagon Location.png|50x50px]] Notable Locations == === [[File:Diamond Subtitle.png|20x20px]] Finlay Overview === Finlay is connected to areas that are ''completely'' unique - they are highly essential to progression: * [[Ferwater Island|Ferwater]] is a Savannah/Desert biome connected to Finlay by a bridge, which in turn allows access to the [[Desert Highlands]] and [[Uncertainty Cave]]. * [[Flowering Meadows]] is a grassy flower biome fused to Finlay, and you can easily drive inside from the mainland. * An entrance to [[Mike's Mines]], a cave system located near player spawn, which in turn serves as the entrance to the [[Magma Caves]]. * An entrance to the [[Acid Wastes|Acidlands]], a mid/late-game area, is located behind [[Flowering Meadows]] near the Lost Woods. * An entrance to the [[Snowy peaks|Snowy Peaks]] can be reached by travelling through the Finlay Taiga. * Several entrances to the [[River Caves]], another separate cave system with a river spanning through it. They serve as a network of underground paths connecting disparate parts of the map together. According to the brand new update, Finlay has been completely rehauled once more. Finlay can be subdivided into the following areas: * Finlay Grasslands * Finlay Taiga * Finlay Farlands * Finlay Beaches * Oak Forest/Mythril Forest * Birch Forest/Birch Ridge * Maple Forest * Olive Forest * Dark Forest/Lost Woods === [[File:Diamond Subtitle.png|20x20px]] '''Grasslands (Finlay)''' === * Location of the [[Resource Hub]] and [[The Oak Depot|Oak Depot]]. * Has bright green grass. * Has several Player base spawn locations. [[File:Finland Landscape.png|center|thumb|566x566px|Finlay Grasslands]] ==== [[File:Diamond Subtitle.png|7x7px]] Oak Forest (Mythril Forest) ==== [[File:Mythril Forest Sign.png|thumb|262x262px|Mythril Forest]] * Also known as “Mythril Forest” according to signage. * Located just south of the [[Flowering Meadows]] entrance, or to the right of the [[Resource Hub]]. * Holds the remains of [[Jer's Junkyard|Jer’s Junkyard]]. * High spawn rate of [[Oak]] trees. * Despite the name sake, it is unlikely that [[Mythril]] spawns more commonly in this location. ==== [[File:Diamond Subtitle.png|7x7px]] Birch Forest (Birch Ridge) ==== [[File:Birch Ridge (Camera Shot).png|thumb|330x330px|Birch Ridge (Freecam)]] * Also known as "Birch Ridge" according to signage. * Located next to the bridge connecting Finlay to [[Ferwater Island|Ferwater]] and the smaller bridge that connects Finlay Grasslands to Finlay Taiga/Icelands. * High spawn rate of [[Birch]] trees. === [[File:Diamond Subtitle.png|7x7px]] Taiga (Finlay) === * May also be referred to as [[Icelands]] to some players. Otherwise, Icelands is equivalent to [[Snowy peaks|Snowy Peaks]]. * Location of [[Alan's AutoLogistics|Alan’s Auto-Logistics]]. * Has cerulean, blue-green grass. * Has several Player base spawn locations.[[File:Finlay Taiga.png|center|thumb|483x483px|Finlay Taiga]] === [[File:Diamond Subtitle.png|20x20px]] Farlands (Finlay) === The Finlay Farlands (as named in the game using the map boards in Mike's Mines) is comprised of the area behind Flowering Meadows. This area contains Maple Forest, the two Olivewood Forests, the Lost Woods, and an entrance into the Acidlands. * Contains the Elderwood Axe Quest, in Lost Woods * Contains the hidden Emberbane quest, in an unmarked explodable wall near the back entrance of Flowering Meadows. ==== [[File:Diamond Subtitle.png|7x7px]] Maple Forest ==== [[File:Red Maple Forest.png|thumb|330x330px|Maple Forest]] * Located between Flowering Meadows and the Finlay Taiga, stretches into the Acidlands Entrance. * High spawn rate of [[Red Maple]] trees. === [[File:Diamond Subtitle.png|7x7px]] Olive Forest === [[File:Olivewood Forest.png|thumb|281x281px|Olivewood Forest]] * There are two Olivewood Forests in the Finlay Farlands: first located on a small plateau just outside of a second entrance of Flowering Meadows and second located on the cliff near the Lost Woods. * The ''only'' spawn location of [[Olive|Olivewood]] trees. === [[File:Diamond Subtitle.png|7x7px]] Dark Forest (Lost Woods) === [[File:Lost Woods.png|thumb|258x258px|Lost Woods]] * Also also known as “Lost Woods” according to signage. * Located between Flowering Meadows and the Acidlands Entrance * Spawn location of [[Petrified Oak]] trees, along with a small lake. * Behind the waterfall is an exit from [[Mike's Mines]]. * The [[Lost woods|Elderbark Axe]] (early-game axe quest) can sometimes spawn on a Petrified Oak stump. === [[File:Diamond Subtitle.png|20x20px]] Beaches (Finlay) === With the new update, Finlay is now made up of several beaches - there are three distinct beaches shown on the map. * Grasslands Beach (South Finlay) ** A beach south of [[Flowering Meadows]]. ** Located near the Oak and Birch Forests. ** Location of a “[[Shifting Realities]]” Portal frame to visit the retro map of Oaklands. * Farlands Beach (North Finlay) ** A beach north of [[Flowering Meadows]], which is connected with the beach ''inside'' Flowering Meadows. ** Located near the Olive Forest, Maple Forest, and the Lost Woods. ** Location of an entrance to [[Mike's Mines]]. * * Finlay Taiga Beach ** A beach formed from Finlay Taiga on its north side. ** Location of the [[Radical Shack]]. ** Spawns [[Gravel|Grey Gravel]] nodes on the brown stone coastline. [[File:Finlay Beach South.png|center|thumb|564x564px|Finlay Beach South]][[File:Finlay Beach North.png|center|thumb|566x566px|Finlay Beach North]][[File:Finlay Taiga Beach.png|center|559x559px|Finlay Taiga Beach|alt=Finlay Taiga Beach|thumb]] == [[File:Hexagon Stores.png|50x50px]] Stores == === [[File:Diamond Subtitle.png|20x20px]] Finlay Stores === Finlay offers several functions as the main hub of Oaklands. Finlay has the [[Resource Hub]], which allows players to sell both processed and unprocessed goods. Finlay also contains five shops: * [[The Oak Depot|Oak Depot]]: sells all of the basic [[Schematics]], all starter and professional processing machinery, early and mid-game [[:Category:Vehicles|vehicle spawners]], various [[:Category:Tools|tools]], and various items. * [[Alan's AutoLogistics|Alan’s Auto-Logistics]]: sells high-end vehicle spawners and logistical/electrical components. * [[Mike's Mines|Mike's Mines Shop]]: sells low-tier explosives. * [[Lighthouse]]: sells various specialty items, both decorational and functional, and 3 different sizes of [[Small Crate|Storage Crates]]. * [[Radical Shack]]: sells beach/ocean oriented items and the [[Living Axe]]. == [[File:Hexagon Quests.png|50x50px]] Quests and Secrets == The land of Oaklands hides many secrets - some in plain sight, and others so obtuse that you will likely never find them without at least a hint. These secret puzzles offer powerful tools (some of the ''best'' in the game!). This offers a quick summary of secret quests that are active at least partially in Finlay, but note that most of these quests often require lots of resources, money, and map-wide navigation. === [[File:Diamond Subtitle.png|20x20px]] The Elderwood Axe === The [[Elderwood Axe]] is the easiest secret tool to obtain - and really should be the first quest item you look for when playing Oaklands for the first time. No need for any resources, no NPC's required, not even your truck is needed in any capacity. * This quest takes about 20 minutes (or less if you are lucky) to complete. * The Elderwood Axe spawns randomly on a [[Petrified Oak]] stump in the Lost Woods. Pick it up with at least one free inventory slot. * If one does not spawn, rejoin the game on a different server and check the Lost Woods again. Keep trying until you find one. === [[File:Diamond Subtitle.png|20x20px]] The Pedestal Puzzle === Finlay has two Pedestals, and Ferwater has one. The Pedestal Puzzle is used for the [[Uncertain Pickaxe]] and [[Key|Adurite Key]] secret quests. * Pedestal 1 is located near the [[Lighthouse]], in the center of the [[Lost woods|Lost Woods]]. * Pedestal 2 is located at the edge of a rock in front of [[Alan's AutoLogistics|Alan's Auto-Logistics]]. * Pedestal 3 is located in the center of the Desert Canyon in [[Ferwater Island|Ferwater]]. In short, first press the secret Red Button in [[Mike's Mines]] to activate the Pedestal Puzzle - causing the pedestals themselves to have a glowing ring. Place [[? ? ?]] (Infused Ink) on all three pedestals for the Uncertain Pickaxe. Place [[Adurite Key|Refined Tools]] on all three pedestals for the Adurite Key. The quest item will spawn on another pedestal in the [[Acidlands]]. * The Pedestal Puzzle takes about 30 minutes to more than an hour to complete. * For more detail on the Undertain Pickaxe and Adurite Key quests, click on their respective links. === [[File:Diamond Subtitle.png|20x20px]] The Emberbane Quest === [[File:Screenshot 2025-06-11 222812.png|thumb|Picture of the entrance to the Emberbane Ruins, after using two small bombs.]] The [[Emberbane]] Ruins are located inside a hilltop on the way to the [[Lighthouse]] behind an unmarked wall which can be identified by its indent and its discoloration. It can be broken with explosives. This is the location to fuse a [[Meteor Core]], a [[Skull|Burnt Skull]], and an [[Adurite Key]] into one of the best Axes in Oaklands - the [[Emberbane|Emberbane Axe]]. * This quest takes more than a few hours to complete, requiring time, money, upgraded tools, explosives, luck, ''and'' lots of resources. * This Axe can also be bought with Robux by using the Expert Pack Gamepass. === [[File:Diamond Subtitle.png|20x20px]] Shifting Realities === The Shifting Realities portal frame is located on the Grasslands Beach - the beach near player spawn. By entering this mineshaft, eerily reminiscent of the original location of the Red Button, you can enter a bright green portal. By touching this portal, you will teleport to an Oaklands server with a retro version of the map. This map is the first version of the Oaklands map, with most of the original trappings. A few things, such as [[Kelp]] and the lack of [[Magma Tree|Magma Trees]] near the retro Lighthouse, have been added and removed respectively. * This quest takes nearly no time to complete. * You will receive the "Shifting Realities" badge upon entering the retro server. == [[File:Hexagon Axe.png|50x50px]] Lumberwork == === [[File:Diamond Subtitle.png|20x20px]] Trees in Finlay Grasslands === Three default species of trees spawn on the '''Finlay Grasslands''', with other species spawning in specific places on the surface of the island. These trees are the main tree species that spawn on Finlay, not including those that spawn via special events. These trees are mainly for beginners to earn money or to be used as a cheap building material. The trees that fall into this category are listed below: * [[Oak]], common rarity, early-game tree, found across the Finlay Grasslands, spawns in clusters in the '''Oak Forest/Mithril Forest'''. * [[Birch]], common rarity, early-game tree, found across the Finlay Grasslands, spawns in clusters in the '''Birch Forest'''. * [[Finlay Clover]], uncommon rarity, early-game tree, found across all of the Finlay Grasslands. Only slightly more profitable than normal trees. === [[File:Diamond Subtitle.png|20x20px]] Trees near Flowering Meadows/Finlay Farlands === Near [[Flowering Meadows]], several different tree types can be found. These trees are similarly for beginners to earn money or to be used as a cheap building material, but are a little bit beefier in terms of health. The following list describes these tree types: * [[Red Maple]], common rarity, early-game tree, spawns in clusters in the Maple Forest, near the western side of [[Flowering Meadows]]. * [[Olive|Olivewood]], common rarity (*but spawns in a specific area ''only''), early/mid-game tree, found at a small plateau behind [[Flowering Meadows]], near its second entrance or the entrance to the [[Acidlands]]. === [[File:Diamond Subtitle.png|20x20px]] Trees in Finlay Taiga === Across from Flowering Meadows is the '''Finlay Taiga''', also known as '''Finlay Icelands'''. These trees are also mainly for beginners to earn money or to be used as a cheap building material, but are a little bit beefier in terms of health. The following describes these tree types: * [[Blue Pine]], common rarity, early-game tree, found across the Finlay Taiga. Also found more sparsely in [[Snowy peaks|Snowy Peaks]]. * [[Spruce]], common rarity, early-game tree, found across the Finlay Taiga. Also found more sparsely in [[Snowy peaks|Snowy Peaks]]. * [[Sequoia]], common rarity (*but spawns in a specific area ''only''), mid/late-game tree, found specifically near the small bridge entrance (close to the bridge to Ferwater) and towards the entrance to [[Snowy peaks|Snowy Peaks]]. Also found in hard to get areas in Snowy Peaks. Even though it is extremely large, its return value is relatively low compared to other, more profitable trees and has extremely high health. Can be processed for profit but will take a long time to transport, saw down into smaller chunks, process into planks, ''and'' sell it all - about $10K for a fully processed Sequoia. However, it is very useful for building as it can fill schematics easily with its larger mass. * [[Tundra Clover]], uncommon rarity, early-game tree, found across all of the Finlay Taiga. Only slightly more profitable than normal trees. === [[File:Diamond Subtitle.png|20x20px]] Trees in Finlay Beaches === Some trees can only spawn on the beaches of Finlay. These trees are very low-value trees, likely implemented for decoration purposes - with the exception of the high-value [[Kelp]]. The trees that fall into this category are listed below: * [[Palm]], common rarity, early-game tree, only on beach shores. Very low return value when selling - used for decorative and foraging purposes. * [[King Palm]], common rarity, mid-game tree, only on beach shores. Being a very beefy tree like [[Sequoia]], it is not recommended to cut down this tree and process it for profit. Unlike Sequoia, not as profitable due to its "smaller" comparative size. it is largely used for building and filling schematics. * [[Kelp]], common rarity, early/mid-game tree, in the ocean near beach shores, useful to farm for early to mid-game money as it has a moderately high return value. Can be used to create "grass" or foliage in your builds when processed. === [[File:Diamond Subtitle.png|20x20px]] Trees in the Lost Woods === A new area that was in previous versions of Finlay has been reworked into an area called the '''Dark Forest'''. The sign at the entrance states that this area is named the '''[[Lost woods|Lost Woods]]''', a sublocation on Finlay. This area is located near the entrance to the Acidlands, and it is very apparent when you enter it as it has a darker atmosphere and a lake. These trees are largely for building decoration because they have decent health (they are also protected by Skeleton and Zombie enemies!), so you should come later to this area if you want to use the wood-types here. The following describes these tree types: * [[Petrified Oak]], common rarity (*but spawns in a specific area ''only''), mid/late-game tree, found in the Lost Woods ''only''. Only slightly more profitable than beginner trees, and with ''much'' higher health too. For building purposes - not farming money. * [[Mushrooms|Red Mushroom]], common rarity, mid-game tree, found in the Lost Woods but also in Uncertainty cave. Somewhat profitable with mild returns, but easier to farm than Kelp - a solid middle progression tree that does not compare against late-game trees. Also, relatively low health, so easier to farm for newer players. * [[Bamboo]], common rarity, early/mid-game tree, found near lake shores, including the lake in the Lost Woods. Somewhat profitable with mild returns, but smaller overall size makes it less ideal to farm than other trees. Very low health, so an early-to-mid-game tree that offers some money. However, it is used mostly for its cool building materials. === [[File:Diamond Subtitle.png|20x20px]] Special and Event Trees === [[File:Screenshot 2025-06-08 145930.png|thumb|Example of a Meteor spawning Magma and Ash Trees.]] Special types of trees can spawn during special events - typically describing a random weather event. Only Thunderstorm event trees are active at this time in Finlay. If you want to see meteor locations, see the updated Map of Finlay on the wiki! The trees that fall into this category are listed below: * [[Magma Tree]], rare rarity, late-game tree, appears at [[Meteor]] impact sites in numbers of 2-5, but can also spawn in the [[Magma Caves]] naturally. High health, but also high-return value, sell processed for large profit. * [[File:Screenshot 2025-06-04 225754.png|thumb|An example of an Electrified Tree that spawned during a Thunderstorm.]][[Ash Tree]], uncommon rarity, late-game tree, appears at [[Meteor]] impact sites in numbers of 2-5, but can also spawn in the [[Magma Caves]] naturally. Not nearly as profitable as Magma Trees, but can be used as a dark material in builds. * [[Electrified Tree]], uncommon rarity, tree variant, mid/late-game tree, appears during thunderstorms upon lightning striking any type of tree. Can spawn in an [[Meteor|Electrified Meteor]]. High-return value, sell processed for large profit. * [[Electrified Bamboo]], uncommon rarity, tree variant, mid/late-game tree, appears during thunderstorms upon lightning striking Bamboo near Ook Lake or in the Lost woods lake. Can spawn in an [[Meteor|Electrified Meteor]]. High-return value, sell processed for large profit. * [[Eel Kelp]], uncommon rarity, tree variant, mid/late-game tree, appears during thunderstorms upon lightning striking Kelp in the ocean. Can spawn in an [[Meteor|Electrified Meteor]]. High-return value, sell processed for large profit. === [[File:Diamond_Subtitle.png|20x20px]] Finlay Lumberwork Summary === For a quick at-a-glance explanation on the rarities and difficulties for obtaining each resource in Oaklands. Percent chance to spawn during a thunderstorm OR use [[Michael's Copper Axe]] to create some. |- |[[Magnetite]]: |Rare |$600 |$595 |'''Difficult'''. 0.1% or 1/1000 chance to spawn at night on Lightslate nodes only. |} == [[File:Hexagon Forage.png|50x50px]] Foraging == '''**NEED HELP TO KNOW IF THESE ARE ALL THE FORAGEABLES. If you do not see one that should be here, please feel free to add them! Thanks!''' **Missing Tree Burls, a rare forage item found on (seemingly?) any tree and is specific to that tree (e.g. an oak tree burl). '''Disclaimer to Wiki Editors: Do NOT add if found ''only'' in [[Flowering Meadows]]! (i.e. tulips)''' === [[File:Diamond Subtitle.png|20x20px]] Foraging in Finlay === There are several flowers and miscellaneous items that can be picked up from all over Finlay. Most of these items can be composted and turned into dirt using the [[Composter]]. They can also be pressed into jams (for fruits) and dyes (for flowers/other forage items) using the [[Press Machine]] and a [[Jar]]. Both can be used as decoration items. Jams can be sold at a much higher profit than raw foraged items, and dyes can be used to change wire colors. Most forage items are not worth selling, unless processed (except for a raw [[Golden Apple]], and that should be processed to maximize profit). Most forageables are not worth very much - if you plan to farm with jams/dyes, you should pick a forageable with a high selling rate that is not so annoying to get. As a whole, they should be used as decoration - or for their unique colors. Finlay has plentiful foraging items, but most of them are common rarity. The following is a comprehensive list of all the forageable items that can be found in this area. === [[File:Diamond Subtitle.png|20x20px]] Ground Foraging === [[File:Screenshot 2025-06-04 223755.png|thumb|Dandelion forage on the ground of Finlay Grasslands.]] Certain forage items in Finlay only spawn on the ground without any bush, tree, or log to sprout from. These forage items are almost always extremely common and are largely used for their dye color. They are also not worth selling compared to selling processed lumber and minerals. Ground forage items that are found in Finlay are listed here: * [[Green Mums]], common rarity, anywhere on grassy ground in Finlay Grasslands. * [[Daisy|Daisies]], common rarity, anywhere on grassy ground in Finlay Grasslands. * [[Dandelion|Dandelions]], common rarity, anywhere on grassy ground in Finlay Grasslands. * [[Lucky Clover|Lucky Clovers]], common rarity, on grassy ground anywhere in Finlay Grasslands. * [[Blue Cornflowers]], common rarity, on on grassy ground near [[Snowy peaks|Snowy Peaks]] entrance in the Finlay Taiga, and in select areas of Finlay Taiga. * [[Nightshade]], common rarity, on on grassy ground in the wooded area of the Lost Woods. * [[Cattails]], common rarity, on sandy or grassy ground in areas surrounding the lake of the Lost Woods. * [[Lavender]], common rarity, most often spawn on grassy ground in or around the Finlay Farlands. === [[File:Diamond Subtitle.png|20x20px]] Bush Foraging === [[File:Screenshot 2025-06-04 223823.png|thumb|Blue Hydrangeas on a bush in the Finlay Grasslands.]] Certain forage items spawn on bushes and are easier to see. They are typically flowers or fruits that, like ground forageables, can be composted or pressed. Bush forage items that are found in Finlay are listed here: * [[Flowers|Hydrangeas]] (White/Purple/Pink/Green/Blue), common rarity, from any normal bush in Finlay Grasslands. * [[Blueberries]], common rarity, from most bushes in Finlay Grasslands. * [[Cranberries]], common rarity, from most bushes in Finlay Taiga. * [[Grapes]], common rarity, from some bushes in Finlay Grasslands, and from bushes in the Finlay Farlands near [[Flowering Meadows]]. Grapes can also spawn hanging on the foliage of the stone archways. === [[File:Diamond Subtitle.png|20x20px]] Tree Foraging === [[File:Screenshot 2025-06-04 225624.png|thumb|Acorn forage item hanging on a small Oak tree in the Finlay Grasslands.]] Certain forage items spawn on trees and are sometimes visible on the leaves of the tree. If the tree is cut down, the forage items can still be picked up. There is a percent chance that the forage item will ''rot and disappear'' if using a regular Axe. However, forage items are guaranteed not to rot if you ''pick them by hand'' or use the [[Living Axe]]. They are typically seeds or fruits that, like other forageables, can be composted or pressed. Tree forage items that are found in Finlay are listed here: * [[Acorn|Acorns]], common rarity, from [[Oak]] trees. * [[Apple|Apples]], common rarity, from [[Oak]] trees. * [[Golden Apple|Golden Apples]], rare rarity, forage variant, 1/1000 chance to replace an apple, from [[Oak]] trees. * [[Pear|Pears]], common rarity, from [[Birch]] trees. * [[Pinecone|Pinecones]], common rarity, from [[Blue Pine]] trees. * [[Sap]], common rarity, from [[Red Maple]] trees and detritus. * [[Coconut|Coconuts]], common rarity, from [[Palm]] trees and across the beach floor. * [[Banana|Bananas]], common rarity, from [[King Palm]] trees. * [[Olive|Olives]], common rarity, from [[Olive|Olivewood]] trees. **Need more info on tree burls haven't found one yet. - Snowdin * [[Tree Burls]], rare rarity, forage variant, rare chance to spawn on any tree with wood. === [[File:Diamond Subtitle.png|20x20px]] Miscellaneous Foraging === [[File:Screenshot 2025-06-04 225946.png|thumb|Agaric (Left) and Daedalea (Right) Mushrooms growing on Oak tree bark.]] Certain forage items have unique spawn conditions. This includes mushrooms that spawn on tree bark and fallen trees/stumps (detritus). Others must have water to spawn on or have strange spawn conditions. Like other forageables, can be composted or pressed. Miscellaneous forage items that are found in Finlay are listed here: * [[Beehive|Beehives]], uncommon rarity, from tree leaves whilst using a [[Rusty Saw|Saw]]. Can be sanded into Honeycomb and pressed into Honey. * [[Agaric Mushrooms]], common rarity, from several tree bark types, on several types of tree detritus, and from the ground. * [[Daedalea Mushrooms]], common rarity, from several tree bark types and [[Oak]] tree detritus. * [[Cremini Mushrooms]], common rarity, from [[Blue Pine]] trees and Blue Pine detritus. * [[Black Truffles]], uncommon rarity, sparsely spawns on the ground in the Lost Woods. * [[Celestial Flowers]], common rarity, from foliage in a cave and under a wooden bridge in the Lost Woods. Also found in [[Flowering Meadows]] and [[Mike's Mines]]. * [[Pink Lotus]], common rarity, from the lake in Lost Woods, or from the river flowing above it. Found in most lakes and rivers across the map. * [[Water Lily]], common rarity, from the lake in Lost Woods, or from the river flowing above it. Found in most lakes and rivers across the map. === [[File:Diamond Subtitle.png|20x20px]] Event or Weather Foraging === Certain forage items have unique spawn conditions. This includes spawning only at night, falling from the sky, or rarer events like Meteors. Seasonal foraging (E.g. ghosts (firefly reskin), St. Patrick's day, moon shards from Halloween, etc.) can also be included here. Star Chances need testing for confirmation. Star chances and weather event calculations are ''estimated''. * [[Stars]] (Yellow/Green/Red/Blue/Purple), common rarity, forage variant, spawn anywhere in Finlay at night. * [[Fireflies]] (Yellow/Green/Red/Blue/Purple), common rarity, forage variant, spawn anywhere in Finlay at night. ** Yellow, common rarity, has a ~84% or ~8/10 spawn chance. ** Green, common rarity, has a 10% or 1/10 spawn chance. ** Red, common rarity, has a 5% or 1/20 spawn chance. ** Blue, uncommon rarity, has a 0.9% or roughly ~1/100 spawn chance ** Purple, rare rarity, is the rarest variant. Has a <0.1% or 1/1000 spawn chance. * Note that the frequency of star spawns depend upon the ''weather'': ** During ''stormy'' conditions (such as rainy or thunderstorm), star spawning is reduced by about 0.5X. ** A ''clear'' night has a 1/5 chance to be a star shower, where stars spawn 2X more than usual. * [[Meteor Core]], uncommon rarity, 100% spawn chance from both a [[Meteor|Magmafied Meteor]] and an [[Meteor|Electrified Meteor]]. Used for special quests. == [[File:Hexagon X.png|50x50px]] Removed Assets == === [[File:Diamond Subtitle.png|20x20px]] Special Event Items === These items are no longer in game, whether due to a game update or a special event. As an example, these items have been removed from Finlay; they used to appear on April Fools and Oaklands Anniversary events. However, retro items are now a permanent addition to Oaklands as resources found in the [[Classic Biome]]. * [[Tree]] (Retro) * [[Stone]] (Retro) * [[Ore]] (Retro) === [[File:Diamond Subtitle.png|20x20px]] Removed Locations === These locations are no longer in the game since the Oaklands map update - their functions have either been reused in other assets/locations or removed entirely in the Main Oaklands servers. However, they are still accessible by using the Shifting Realities portal frame found at Finlay Beach. * [[Jer's Junkyard]] (Retro Version) - a dilapidated version of the junkyard is now in Mythril Forest. * [[Mike's Mines]] (Retro Version) - has been remade into a much more expansive cave system. * [[Ook Lake]] (Retro Version) - has be re-added to the game in [[Ferwater Island|Ferwater]] instead. == [[File:Hexagon Question.png|50x50px]]Trivia == * Finlay Island was the first island to be added to the game. * The [[Lighthouse]] on Finlay used to be broken in half and served as the spawn for [[Magma Tree|Magma Trees]]; after the map update, the [[Lighthouse]] returned to its former glory and as a result no longer spawns [[Magma Tree|Magma Trees]]. * After the map update, [[Jer's Junkyard]] and its functions have been split into two locations. The [[Resource Hub]] is now the area to sell goods and [[Jer's Junkyard|Jer's Junk]] has now been set up outside the [[Lighthouse]]. * Players used to be able to sell their materials at the [[The Oak Depot|Oak Depot]], but this feature has been removed in favor of the [[Resource Hub]]. * The [[Classic Store]] used to be on Finlay before being moved to [[Ferwater Island|Ferwater]] in the island expansion update. Currently, the Classic Store is in the [[Classic Biome]] from a following update. {{Locations Nav}} [[Category:Locations]]

title: Fireflies
wikitext: {{Missing Info}} -Firefly Chances need further testing for confirmation. == [[File:Diamond_Main_Titles.png|75x75px]] Fireflies == '''Fireflies''' are a resource in Oaklands; they provide an alternative means of making money that does not rely on trees or stone nodes. At night, fireflies will begin to spawn around the map in random locations (usually on the surface). These fireflies form clustered groups, illuminating the area around them. A player can use a [[Jar]] to catch them, and then can bring them back to the [[Resource Hub]] to sell them. * Jars can easily bought at the [[The Oak Depot|Oak Depot]], although many other stores offer them as well. * After an update, selling fireflies no longer consumes the Jar. Instead, it consumes the fireflies inside the jar and gives the jar back. Fireflies spawn in different colors, each variation having a different value. The table below is listed by rarity, with yellow being the most common and purple being the rarest. * {| style="margin:auto;"class="sortable article-table" |+Firefly Chances !Yellow, common rarity, has a ~84% or ~8/10 spawn chance. |- !Green, common rarity, has a 10% or 1/10 spawn chance. |- !Red, common rarity, has a 5% or 1/20 spawn chance. |- !Blue, uncommon rarity, has a 0.9% or roughly ~1/100 spawn chance |- !Purple, rare rarity, is the rarest variant. Has a <0.1% or 1/1000 spawn chance. |} * ''Unconfirmed'' if weather conditions changes the spawning of fireflies. * Location does ''not'' change the chances of a particular firefly color spawning. * Using Freecam, you can see that most Fireflies do not spawn until a player is in (or travels through) the area. ** As such, to maximize your chances of finding rare Fireflies, drive to unloaded areas and observe the new Fireflies that spawn there. * Blue and Purple Fireflies have higher value trading compared to just selling them. * All fireflies that are not bottled disappear at 6:30. {| style="margin:auto;" class="sortable article-table" !Image !Color Variant !Sell Value |- |[[File:Yellow_Fireflies_Jar.png|101x101px]] |Jar of Yellow Fireflies |$450 |- |[[File:Green_Fireflies_Jar.png|101x101px]] |Jar of Green Fireflies |$550 |- |[[File:Red_Fireflies_Jar.png|101x101px]] |Jar of Red Fireflies |$800 |- |[[File:Blue_Fireflies_Jar.png|101x101px]] |Jar of Blue Fireflies |$2,400 |- |[[File:Purple_Fireflies_Jar.png|101x101px]] |Jar of Purple Fireflies |$4,400 |} == [[File:Hexagon Special.png|50x50px]] Events == === [[File:Diamond_Subtitle.png|20x20px]] 2023 and 2024 Halloween Ghosts === During Halloween 2023/2024, fireflies were replaced by '''Ghosts'''. While they were otherwise functionally identical, Ghosts had the quirk of not disappearing during the day. Ghosts were sold for the event currency, Candy, instead of for money. Player would receive their empty Jar back. The chances for the colors of Ghosts is likely the same. {| style="margin:auto;" class="sortable article-table" !Image !Color Variant !Sell Value |- |[[File:YellowGhosts.png|center|101x101px]] |Jar of Yellow Ghosts |450 Candy |- |[[File:GreenGhosts.png|center|101x101px]] |Jar of Green Ghosts |550 Candy |- |[[File:RedGhosts.png|center|101x101px]] |Jar of Red Ghosts |800 Candy |- |[[File:BlueGhosts.png|center|101x101px]] |Jar of Blue Ghosts |2400 Candy |- |[[File:PurppleGhosts.png|center|101x101px]] |Jar of Purple Ghosts |3400 Candy |} == [[File:Hexagon_Question.png|50x50px]] Trivia == * For a time after the 2023 Halloween Update, fireflies inherited the quirk of ghosts, where they did not disappear during the daytime. This glitch was rectified in a later update. [[Category:Resources]]

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a structure that can be purchased from [[Alan's AutoLogistics]] for $280. It is a standard [[Straight Conveyor]] with additional filtering controls.

== Details ==
While the Filter Conveyor is otherwise identical to the Straight Conveyor, the Filter Conveyor has an additional filtering option. When a material is pressed up against the sensor, the Filter Conveyor can then begin filtering objects that pass through it.

The Filter Conveyor has two modes: allowing everything but the filtered item, and only allowing the filtered item. All items that are "caught" by the filter will be ejected out of the bottom of the belt. A player may wish to use a [[Material Laser]] hooked up to a [[logic]] system that controls an [[Intersection Conveyor]] if this functionality is undesirable.

== Description ==
'''Flameslate''' can be discovered deep within the depths of the [[Magma Caves]], nestled upon small islands surrounded by '''molten lava'''.

As of the 1.67.0 update, '''Flameslate''' can spawn [[Magmite]] in their rocks.

'''Note:''' Exercise caution when attempting to get '''Flameslate''', as the intense heat will scorch you as you travel the bridges and planks connecting the islands. Always ensure you have a [[Healing Coil]] or [[Fusion Coil]] ready to mitigate the effects of the heat.

The respawn time of Flameslate is unknown, although it does respawn in some servers, it is found that it frequently respawns every 5-10 minutes. Its recommended to farm Flameslate on solo Servers because leaving and rejoining will respawn the ores but you will have to blow up the rocks again.

== Appearance ==
[[File:Flameslate Location-Appearance.png|thumb|251x251px]]
'''Flameslate''' shares the same stone, refined and forged textures as [[Fungoidite]], but with a distinctive twist. Its textures emulate molten lava, and the raw stone appears to be ablaze.

title: Flowering Meadows
wikitext:
{{Buildings|Island=[[Finlay]]|NPC=[[Laura]]|Purpose=Flowers, Dye Machine/Press Machine, Trees, Ores, Butterflies, [[Flora Laura]]|image1=Revamped Flowering Meadows.png|Version Added=1.54.0}}

== Description ==
The Flowering Meadows is a subregion located in [[Finlay Island]]. It is located to the left of Finlay's beach, and behind the [[Resource Hub]]. It requires explosives, two [[Small Bomb|Small Bombs]] to be exact to enter. There is a entrance on the other side of [[Flowering Meadows]] that doesn't need any explosives to enter.

== Stores and Locations ==
The Flowering Meadows contains only one shop, called [[Flora Laura]].

[[Flora Laura]] is a shop that mainly sells items that relate to Flowers, such as the [[Dye Machine]] and [[Press Machine]], [[Jar|Jars]], [[Fabric Roll|Fabric Rolls,]] etc. The also contains the four towers required to obtain the [[Petalfall|Petalfall Axe]].

== Species of Trees ==
The Flowering Meadows contain many different types of trees, most notably [[Sakura]] trees, but it also contains [[Birch]], [[Oak]], [[Willow]] trees and uniquely the [[Olivine Clover]].

The [[Sakura]] and [[Willow]] trees are more efficient ways to earn money, as they sell more money than the beginner trees.

== Mining ==

=== Common Ores ===
The Flowering Meadows contain many different stone nodes, such as the [[Lightslate]] and [[Beigeslate]] nodes but also contain [[Marble]] nodes on the higher parts of the Flowering Meadows, around [[Flora Laura]].

In addition, many different common ores spawn in the Flowering Meadows, such as [[Inkstone]], [[Copper]], [[Tin]], [[Pyrite]], [[Iron]], [[Gold]], [[Rose Gold]] and exclusive to [[Marble]], [[Quartz]].

=== Rare Ores ===
Rare Ores can spawn in the Flowering Meadows as well, such as [[Rosa Flama Quartz]] being exclusive to [[Marble]] nodes. The Flowering Meadows can also contain [[Adurite]], [[Mythril]]<nowiki/>and [[Magnetite]], which is exclusive to [[Lightslate]] and only spawns at night (assumption).

'''New Ores'''

Amethyst ore can be found in marble stones. Amethyst ore looks like small purple crystals in marble. Also, you can see the blue stones from bloomite, this ore looks like little blue flowers.

== Flowers/Fruits ==

=== Flowers ===
Tulips are flowers that are the only and exclusive to the Flowering Meadows. These consist of [[Red Tulip|Red]], [[Orange Tulip|Orange]], [[Green Tulip|Green]], [[Blue Tulip|Blue]] and [[Purple Tulip|Purple]] tulips. These flowers are also sold at [[Flora Laura]].

Previously mentioned, [[Flora Laura]] also contains flowers that you can buy. They are the previously mentioned tulips, [[Sunflower|Sunflowers]], [[Daisy|Daisies]] and [[Rose|Roses]]. You can also buy already dyed tulips in a [[Jar]].

=== Fruits ===
Only one type of [[Fruits|Fruit]] can be found in the bushes of the Flowering Meadows, being the [[Blueberries|Blueberry]]. You can also find fruits in the trees of the Flowering Meadows, such as [[Pear|Pears]], [[Apple|Apples]] and the [[Golden Apple|Golden Apples]] (assumption){{Locations Nav}}

title: Fusion Coil
wikitext:
{{Objects|image1=Fusion Coil.png|Price=~$26,233 (in materials and bombs)|Function=Movement,Healing and Jump|Version Added=v1.39.5|Date Added=28/08/2023|Island=Ferwater|Shop=Classic store, Mike's MInes}}

== Description ==
The '''Fusion Coil''' is a quest coil that combines the effects of the [[Gravity Coil]], [[Speed Coil]] and [[Healing Coil]]. 

== Appearance ==
The Fusion Coil uses the same model as the classic Fusion Coil model from ''Roblox''. It also emits a purple glow, similar to [[Magnetite]] ore. It is slightly variegated and not uniform in its shades of purple.

== Obtaining ==
[[File:Infusing.png|thumb|273x273px|Fusion of the items]]
* Navigate to [[Uncertainty Cave]] and acquire the [[Infused Core]] by getting a [[Mysterious Mushrooms|Mysterious Mushroom]] to fire a spore at a regular [[Meteor Core]].
* Use bombs to detonate the wall blocking the entrance to the [[Oobmab]] Lake near the mushroom cave and navigate inside.
* Place the Infused Core along with the Speed, Gravity, and Healing Coil into the magenta-colored lake.
* If done correctly, all of the items will begin to emit a sparkling effect and slowly fade away, thus beginning the fusion process. About 40 to 45 seconds after, all of the items will fuse into the Fusion Coil, and it will be able to be claimed. If any of the items belong to different players, they will sparkle but not fuse. All items must be under the same name in order for the coil to fuse.

Note that if the server load is high, the fusion process may take more time than usual.

== Trivia ==
* Unlike the other coils, the Fusion Coil emits light, which may be useful for traversing dark areas.
* Having the coil equipped while driving any vehicle applies an anti-gravity effect on the vehicle as well. However, no speed or healing effect is applied. This also works with the [[Gravity Coil]].

== New information ==

* Fusion coil now can be fused anywhere in a purple lake, going to Oobmab location is not required.
* You may see the ruins in mysterious cave, they are partially revealing the combination of Fusion coil.
* When you put first materials, they will start sparkling with white, and go to magenta when you put the rest.
* Fusion is followed by a dark violet explosion, same as meteor core getting infused.

title: Fruits
wikitext:
== Spawning ==
Fruits spawn on various trees and bushes in Oaklands depended on type of tree, tree and bush location and biome. Fruits can be harvested by grabbing them from the tree or chopping the tree down. Some fruit will die (disappear not long after you cut the tree) if you chop down the tree (unless you are using the [[Living Axe]]), it's better to harvest by hand if you want to get more quantity (if you do not have the Living Axe). Fruits spawn on the leaves of trees or near the top of the tree on the bark.

== Uses ==
Fruit can be sold raw but will net a lower profit. It can also be turned into jam by using the [[Press Machine]] to convert the fruit to its respective Jam, by including the fruit as well as an empty [[jar]]. The Jam can be sold for profit; each type of jam will sell for 4x the base price of the fruit used. Note: Jams give back the empty jar when sold. Additionally, eating fruits gives temporary effects to the player. Consuming jam gives the same effect for significantly more time. (More research needed for effect durations)

title: Frogs
wikitext:
== Description ==
Frogs are a passive mob that can be found in different places around the Oaklands map, some of them spawn exclusively in these places and others can be found in multiple places. 

The only way to catch a Frog is by using the Bug Net or the Bug Catcher 3000, which are purchasable in [[Flora Laura]] Shop. If successfully caught a frog, they will transform into a draggable item and will stop making a croaking sound. Frogs aren't meant for Butterfly cages, but for some reason Gray Tree Frog can be put in it at this moment (31.05.26-12.07.26).

In the version v121.0, companions have been added. Frogs can now be equipped as little mascots, and players can give them unique names. The Frog will follow you around and make croaking sounds, but of course you can mute it. ''Some frogs have a perk/effect.''

Frogs can be sold in the [[Resource Hub]] depending on their type. 

<big>''(If you found a different type - please add it here.)''</big>

''"Oh boy, I sure hope nothing goes wrong! This gift can be unwrapped once the game transitions into Beta."''
{{Objects |image1= Gift_Of_Alpha_Uncertainty.png|Boxed Missing_Image.png|Unboxed | Island=Finlay | Shop=[[The Oak Depot]] | Price=$37,000 | Function=Will give the player an item once the game goes into Beta. | Version Added=v1.0.0 | Date Added=14/01/2023 | Status=Limited (Currently available) }} The '''Gift of Alpha Uncertainty''' is an object available for purchase at [[The Oak Depot]], for $37,000. == Details == The Gift of Alpha Uncertainty cannot be opened at this time. Initially introduced with a price of $17,000, the Gift of Alpha Uncertainty's historic pricing was completely random, fluctuating each day. After the map redesign, the Gift of Alpha Uncertainty was given its fixed price of $37,000. == Gallery == Test Gift.png|Test gift ==Trivia== * When first added, the Gift of Alpha Uncertainty was only available for purchase at the Lighthouse. After the map redesign, a small part of the countertop at The Oak Depot was set aside for these gifts. During some holiday events, the Gift of Alpha Uncertainty becomes unavailable for purchase from The Oak Depot due to other gifts taking its place. *The mesh used for the gift was commonly used for Roblox Christmas events, but the decal on the gift is unique to Oaklands. *Currently, the Gift of Alpha Uncertainty has an internal timer of when to open. Since there is currently no determined date of Beta release, this timer is set to release on 03:14:07 UTC on 19 January 2038, which is the maximum Unix time can get to. * Prior to the introduction of money donations, players would use these gifts as money equivalents, alongside other rare materials or objects like the [[Meteor Core]]. title: Ghost
wikitext:
{{NPC
|image = Ghost.png
|Island = [[Finlay Island]]
|Building = [[Property]]
|Version Added = v1.27.0
|Date Added = 19/07/2023}}
The '''Ghost''' is an NPC that spawns when a player loads a save for the first time. He provides a basic tutorial for playing the game.

== Details ==
The Ghost, when spawned, will immediately seek out the player. When he gets close enough, he will immediately start talking to the player, only introducing himself as "Ghost, your friendly neighbor." His entire purpose is to help the player get started in Oaklands.

Because of how the Ghost is programmed, even if the player had a save file from before the map update, the Ghost will still put them through the tutorial steps.

== Dialog ==

[[File:Ghost talking.png|right|thumb|100px]]
"Hey there, welcome to the island! I'm Ghost, your friendly neighbor. I will be helping you out with getting started here."

''Player advances dialog.''

"Great! I went ahead and gave you some gifts.  A [[Rusty Axe|Nice Axe]], a [[Rusty Saw]], and a [[Rusty Joop Barrow|basic vehicle]] to get you started. They are quite rusty, probably 1000 years old, but they do the trick just fine! To unbox and pick up the axe, go up to the box, and interact with it."

''Player unboxes the axe and collects it.''

"One more thing, would you like me to clean up these [[Ruins]] for you? Or would you like to use them to build off of."
* If the player selects "Yes please.": ''The entire plot will be cleared of all objects.''
* If the player selects "No thank you.": ''All objects on the plot will remain as they are.''

"Well, I think this is where I leave you off... Welcome to the island, be sure to have a lot of fun!"

''Dialog ends.''

title: Gift Wrapper
wikitext:
{{Tool | name=Gift Wrapper | unboxed_image=Gift Wrapper.png | location=Finlay | shop=Santa's Workshop | price=❄️32,500 | function=Turns items and structures into openable gift items. | version_added=1.97.5 | status=Obtainable }}
''"A special tool that lets you gift any item or structure into a present!"''
== Description == The '''Gift Wrapper''' is an exclusive [[2025 Christmas Event]] tool that behaves very similarly to the [[Material Gun]]. It does nothing without at least one of the four '''Wrapping Paper''' materials available at [[Santa's Workshop]] for ❄️99 each. Once you have a '''Wrapping Paper''' purchased, you can equip the '''Gift Wrapper''' and click it (there should be a highlight around it) to consume the paper. It will now be in the wrapper, allowing you to select the wrapping paper in the menu. Then, once a paper is selected, you can click on an item or structure to turn it into a boxed gift with the chosen wrapping paper texture, consuming the wrapping paper one time. == Wrapped Gift == Once an object or structure has been wrapped, it turns into a '''Wrapped Gift''' of a loosely similar size and shape. It will have the same '''wrapping paper texture''' as the one used to wrap it. These objects can then be '''stored''' or '''unboxed''' when held for 0.5 seconds, allowing for easier mobility and storage of some objects and structures. ('''Trading''' isn't recommended as the contents of the gift are never displayed, to allow for surprise gifts.)
''"A special present, just for you!"''
[[File:Wrapped Gift Before.png|left|thumb|The Baby Ducky and Number Interface before being wrapped.|512x512px]] [[File:Wrapped Gift After.png|left|thumb|The Baby Ducky and Number Interface after being wrapped in the Snowflake and Tree Wrapping Paper.|512x512px]]

The '''Gleam Harvester''' is a pickaxe that can be purchased from the [[River Shop]] for 200 Lumite Credits. The '''Gleam Harvester''' pickaxe has the largest impact radius on ore - meaning the impact is likely to spread throughout the entire ore deposit. But there is no guarantee that this pickaxe will mine every piece of ore or ordinary stone in one go. This pickaxe mines large chunks of ore in 2-4 hits +/- depending on size. '''Notes:''' -The [[Uncertain Pickaxe]] is a better pickaxe for everyday use. But even so, the '''Gleam Harvester''' pickaxe is not without its merits. -In terms of size, the '''Gleam Harvester''' pickaxe is the largest pick in the game relative to the player's height. -This pickaxe emits a light green glow (which may slightly illuminate the area around you no further than 1 meter) this is due to the material from which it is made ([[Lumite]]).
