title: Goblin Memorabilia
wikitext:
''""''
{{Objects|image1=Goblin Memorabilia.png|Island=Magma Caves|Shop=Magma Cave Shop|Function=Decoration|Version Added=v1.52.0|Price=$75,000}} ==Description== The '''Goblin Memorabilia''' stands as a unique statue, exclusively available for purchase at the [[Magma Cave Shop]] nestled within the depths of the [[Magma Caves]]. However, acquiring this item isn't as straightforward as browsing a shelf. To obtain the Goblin Memorabilia, players must climb along the wooden beams positioned just above the store's entrance. Utilizing tools like the [[Gravity Coil]] or [[Fusion Coil]] is essential to access the higher points unreachable by standard jump height. Upon climbing the beams you will encounter a small '''Greedy Greeb Goblin''' nestled within a small hole. Maneuvering into this hidden space, players will then navigate further, descending through another opening. Here, they'll discover multiple '''Goblins''' gathered around the statue. It can then be taken to the Store counter to be purchased for $75,000 == Trivia == The Description of the Goblin Memorabilia is encoded. Upon decoding it with Base64, then shifting it a couple of times in Caesars Cipher until the following sentence was built: ''According to all known laws of aviation, there is no way a greedy greeb goblin should be able to fly. Its wings are too small to get its fat little body of the ground. The greedy greeb goblin, of course, flies anyway, because greedy greeb goblins dont care what humans think is possible.''

title: Glass Ducky
wikitext:
''<big>"Don't drop it. Also, don't steal it!!! Dugg worked hard on that!"</big>''

{{Objects|image1=Missing_Image.png|Island=Ferwater Island|Shop=Dugg's Digging|Price=Free|Function=Very fragile, shatters easily.|optionalTitle=Glass Ducky}}

== Description ==
The '''Glass Ducky''' is an almost transparent special item that can be found in a hidden room within the attic of [[Dugg's Digging|Dugg's Digging.]] 

It is free and can be obtained if the player is able to retrieve it from the attic without destroying it; a hard task to accomplish since it is made out of glass and thus is extremely fragile. Dropping it or colliding it with other objects will cause it to shatter.

A glass duck will become an Adult if you place it in the [[Duck Shrine]]. Unlike a normal glass duck, the adult ones are completely ''indestructible''; they can never shatter from any impact regardless of how hard the impact is.

== Obtaining ==
Stealing the Glass Ducky is a difficult task and can be very time consuming. The player must navigate the duck through a narrow pathway in a room cramped with shelves, barrels and crates and back out from where they came from. 

A quicker; or perhaps more efficient method to obtain the Glass Ducky is by utilizing the hole near the stairs and carefully placing it on the barrel beneath the stairs, drop down, then proceed to grab it again and carefully move it through the hole you came from, and then carefully drop your way down and proceed to walk out of the store. 

 [[File:Glassduckroom.png|thumb|320x320px|The room where the Glass Duckys are stored.]]
[[File:Mini crate.png|thumb|The Mini Crate is recommended for taking the Glass Ducky home to your base.]]
The [[Mini Crate]] is recommended for taking the Glass Ducky home to your base, as it cannot shatter when it is inside. The Duckie can still break if the crate is dropped from a high distance or flipped upside down in some cases. 

A pillow can be used in the bottom of the inside of crates to prevent them from breaking as easily.

When trying to turn the Glass Ducky into an Adult Glass Ducky, you can put in the [[Duck Shrine]], the same place where [[Baby Ducky|Baby Ducks]] go; however, be aware of the narrow passageway and especially the lantern at the entry of the [[Duck Shrine]], you need to be very careful as you move it through, and it could easily be destroyed if you're not careful. 

(tip, when the glass duck is in the box and you're putting the duck on the shrine, do not remove it from the box and risk breaking it, instead put the entire box on the shrine and never take it out until it's an adult)

== Trivia ==

* There are boxes within the same room that contain Glass Duckys with red text which claims it is "not for sale" but inspecting it will show the price of $999,999,999 Money which is extremely difficult, if not nearly impossible to obtain.
* Unlike normal glass, you CANNOT dye the Glass Ducky (Bummer, I know)
* A player named Godkingman292 has an astonishing mini 38 crates with 4 duckies per crate. It would take an astonishing amount of time to do this. He is able to do this because he has no life other than him playing Oaklands.

[[File:Screenshot 2024-07-21 190159.png|thumb|The Glass Ducky successfully retrieved at someone's base.]]
[[File:Adult Glass Duck.png|left|thumb|164x164px|A glass ducky after being placed in the shrine, becoming an adult glass ducky.]]

{{Buildings|image1=Goblin_Town.png|NPC=Goblin|Version Added=v1.75.0|Date Added=02/01/2025|Island=Acidlands}}
The '''Goblin Town''' is a series of stores located in the [[Acidlands|Acidland]] Caves.

==Description==
The Town is mainly used as a hub full of passive Goblins that will not attack the player. Located directly behind the Goblin Arena.

To gain access to the Goblin Town you must prove yourself worthy by talking to the Goblin located within [[The Arena|the arena]]. He will give the player a Quest to kill the [[Skeleton King]] and retrieve the [[Acid Crown]]. After you complete the quest upon returning to the Goblin, it will initiate the Goblin Trials which is a challenge that consists of eliminating multiple waves of enemies in order to gain access to the town. 

The Goblins sell items that are mostly related to improving the player's ability to defeat mobs from the [[Acidlands]].

The Goblin Town is found by going in the [[Acidlands|Acidland]] Caves and following the path relative to the entrance from the main [[Acidlands]] entrance. Following the route will lead to a visible inner island inside the cave which crossing over will reveal the goblin arena tucked back in the inner part of the cave.

title: Grabby Grabber
wikitext:
<big>''"Some say it grabs, others say it grabby grabs! Use this tool to grab multiple objects at once with the power of wormholes!"''</big>

The '''Grabby Grabber''' is a tool which can be purchased for '''$26,000''' at the [[The Oak Depot|Oak Depot]]. It allows the user to project a small zone that lets them pick up multiple loose objects.

== Description ==
The Grabby Grabber is a makeshift power gauntlet with a claw on its end, built using a makeshift construction of wood and metal. Orange lights emit from it.{{Objects|image1=<gallery>
Grabby-Grabber.png|Unboxed
Grabby-Grabber-BOXED.png|Boxed
</gallery>
|Island=Finlay
|Shop=The Oak Depot
|Price=$26,000
|Function=Allows you to pick up multiple objects at once
|Version Added=v1.2.0
|Date Added=21/01/2023
|Status=Available
|Holding Time=12 seconds}}The main purpose of the {{PAGENAME}} is to pick up multiple objects at once. Using the tool causes it to project a small, transparent, shimmering orb a short distance away from the player in the direction they clicked/tapped. Any item within the orb at the moment of activation will be grabbed; any objects encountered after activation will not be added to the grabber's orb, and the grabber must be reactivated to grab more/different items. The grabber's orb and any objects caught in it follow the player's point of aim. Objects retain their mass while being grabbed. One notable difference from grabbing objects normally is that they will never rotate, only staying in the orientation they were in when they were grabbed. Because of the fact that objects cannot be rotated, this frees up the SHIFT key, allowing the player to run while moving multiple objects at once.

The Grabby Grabber will automatically drop held objects after 12 seconds.

== Gallery ==
<gallery>
File:Grabbygrabberusage.gif|The Grabby Grabber grabbing multiple [[Bloxy Cola]]s.
File:A user flying with a grabby grabber.gif|A player flying on a [[surfboard]] using a Grabby Grabber.
</gallery>

== Trivia ==
* Prior to the map revamp, the Grabby Grabber was sold at [[Jer's Junkyard]] for $22,569.
* The Grabby Grabber (and its [[Grabbiest Grabber|Grabbiest counterpart]]) have been involved with multiple in-game tricks/exploits that allow for flight. The developers frequently have to patch tricks players use to fly.
* The Grabby Grabber has a dim orange light that emits from the front when held, of which no counterpart exists on the Grabbiest Grabber.
* Prior to a recent update, the Grabby Grabber was sold at the [[Lighthouse]]
* The Grabby Grabber's design seems to take inspiration form the Gravity Gun from Half-Life 2.
** It's upgraded counterpart, the Grabbiest Grabber also greatly resembles the Physics Gun from Gmod (which is a modified version of Half-Life 2).

== Description ==
'''Greeb''' is found in [[Grimestone]] and previously in [[Marble]], pre the 1.37.0 update. It has a bright green color and a metallic material when refined. It can most easily be found in the [[Acid Wastes]] within Grimestone.

As of the most recent major update to Oaklands [<nowiki/>[[Version 1.17.0|1.17.0]]], Acidlands has been removed and replaced with the Icelands. The location of [[Grimestone]], [[Uranium]], and [[Greeb]] have all been moved to [[Mike's Mines]] behind a destructible wall near the entrance of the Farland's (according to the Mike's Mine map) as a temporary home.

'''Greeb''' was a joke ore and originated in the community Discord. '''''Proudism''''', a user in the community, had posted several fake pictures on 1/14/2023, Annual Greeb Day, of an "unknown green ore", which then started a chain of jokes and comments to add it to the game.

==Trivia==
*'''Greeb''' is referenced in the description of the [[Dark Alley|Dark alley]] vinyl disk.
*'''Greeb''' can drop from goblins
*'''Greeb''' features sound effects made by '''Theofficialbrick''', in a video titled 'Oaklands Greeb Sound Audition'.
*'''Greeb''' is the main focus point of the [[Gift of Greeb]].
*'''Greeb''' produces a much different sound when Refined or Forged, compared to most other materials.

wikitext:
<big>''"Harnessing the true ultimate power of refinedness... Using the coolness, and awesomeness of magic. Allows you to grab multiple objects with the power of wormholes, you can also buy a cheaper version at The Oak Depot!"''</big>

The '''Grabbiest Grabber''' is a tool which can be purchased for '''$75,000''' at the [[Lighthouse]]. It allows the user to project a large zone that lets them pick up multiple loose objects.

== Description ==
The Grabbiest Grabber is a power gauntlet with a two-pronged claw on its end, built using the same materials that the refined tools use. It emits a harsh blue glow from its internal components.

The Grabbiest Grabber functions identically to the cheaper [[Grabby Grabber]]. However, the Grabbiest Grabber projects a much larger sphere of influence to grab objects with, allowing it to do things like pick up entire ore nodes in one go. The field the Grabbiest Grabber projects also lasts for 60 seconds, compared to the 12 seconds of the [[Grabby Grabber]].

== Trivia ==

* The Grabbiest Grabber (and its [[Grabby Grabber|Grabby counterpart]]) have been involved with multiple in-game tricks/exploits that allow for flight. The developers frequently have to patch tricks players use to fly.
* Before the map revamp event, there was a sneak peak image of the Grabbiest Grabber in one of the thumbnails where [[Bob Fridman]] is at the counter. The Boxed Grabbiest Grabber was at the shelf where, in the game at that time, the [[Statistic Tool]]s and the [[Jar]]s belonged.
* During the map update, the description of the Grabbiest Grabber was changed to refer to the Lighthouse rather than [[Jer's Junkyard]] as the location where a player can buy the [[Grabby Grabber]].
* The Boxed image version of the Grabbiest Grabber doesn't look like the tool itself because it has a third grabber finger on the image, which bears more similarity to the [[Grabby Grabber]]'s appearance.
* In [[Version 1.5.0]], the Grabbiest Grabber was given a light-up bar, bringing it more in line with the [[Grabby Grabber]]. This was previously absent.
* The Grabbiest Grabber is likely to be inspired in the [https://refinerycaves.fandom.com/wiki/Proton-24 Proton-24] from [https://www.roblox.com/games/8726743209/Refinery-Caves-1 Refinery Caves] as it has got the same usage, idea, and it even references the game in its description as it mentions a word from the ''refine'' family.

== Description ==
The '''Hallow Tree''' is an exclusive tree introduced in the Halloween 2023 update, and readded in the Halloween 2024 and 2025 updates. In the HW 2023 event, it can only spawn when a Halloween Meteor crashes, but in the HW 2024 event, this meteor was renamed to the Skeletal Meteor.

The '''Hallow Tree''', not to be confused with the [[Bone Tree]], spawns in the middle of a crater as a rib-like structure with a [[Hallow Eye]] placed within its ribs. While attached to the tree, it will fire a laser that deals consistent damage at the closest player. The Hallow Eye can be collected once the tree is chopped down. The hallow eye is worth 250 candy.
== Tips ==
* Bring a [[Healing Coil]] or a [[Fusion Coil]] when the meteor lands. This allows you to take breaks from the Hallow Eye's damage and continue chopping it down.
* Hallow Trees are extremely tough. The [[Emberbane|Emberbane's]] special ability does not work if the tree hasn't been chopped off, although it will work once it has been chopped. A [[Living Axe]] is recommended for cutting the tree to make it easier to carry around (although you can use a Grabber) and a [[Tall Refined Axe]] is recommended for chopping the tree into smaller pieces.

== Trivia ==

* This tree was one of the only trees to have square logs, before it was changed to the normal cylinder log.
* The sawed form looks like and act like refined quartz.

== Description ==

The heavenly tree is a large pale yellow tree that has light rays emanating from its leaves and emits a bright yellow glow.

This tree only spawns for a period of 24 hours<ref>https://discord.com/channels/865737627712749579/1400637897945645266/1411376160914538506</ref>, starting the morning of Saturday<ref>https://discord.com/channels/865737627712749579/894303481421262923/1425627220650754200</ref> (12:00 AM, EST). This tree can spawn anywhere on the map, Although, it tends to spawn in more barren environments (Including underwater). However, any trees spawned before this time will remain until they’re either harvested or die. It is highly recommended to get a [[UFO]] and fly to the [[Heavenly Shrine]] at [[Snowy peaks]]. Alternatively a Freecam can be used. If one of the pedestals light up, that means a Heavenly Tree is in that direction.

(IMPORTANT): In order to harvest the tree, it requires you to use at minimum a [[Refined Axe]].
== Tip ==

[[File:Image 2026-04-12 144342341.png|thumb|A Helicopter carrying a Living Heavenly Tree]]

Heavenly Trees can sometimes spawn in awkward hard to reach places. Due to this it is recommended that you use a helicopter and its winch, added on update v.112.0 - April 11th 2026, to transport said trees easily.
== Trivia ==

Originally this tree was going to spawn on Fridays, but a poll made on 10/3/2025 changed that, it now spawns on ONLY Saturdays<ref>https://discord.com/channels/865737627712749579/894303481421262923/1423637719388651553</ref><references />

title: Heavenly Shrine
wikitext:
{{Missing Info}}
== Description ==

The '''Heavenly Shrine''' is a unique structure in ''Oaklands'' located in [[Snowy peaks|Snowy Peaks]] that serves as the primary method of spawning the rare '''[[Heavenly Tree]]'''. It uses a sundial and compass mechanism that activates several times per in-game day, each giving a small chance to generate a tree somewhere on the map.
== Overview ==

The '''Heavenly Shrine''' is a large sundial with five openings. As the sun moves across the sky, its light shines through these holes at specific times of day, causing the shrine to activate. When this happens, there is a 10% chance that a [[Heavenly Tree]] will spawn somewhere in the world. The shrine can activate up to five times per in-game day, meaning five opportunities for a tree to appear.

In addition to the sundial, the shrine also features a compass-like device. When a Heavenly Tree successfully spawns, the compass begins to glow and points in the direction of the tree’s location. This allows players to track the tree more easily, though careful searching is still required to locate it.
== Activation ==

The Heavenly Shrine only functions on '''Saturdays EST'''. On this day, the sun passes through the five holes of the sundial at fixed intervals, causing the shrine to activate. Each activation provides a 10% chance for a [[Heavenly Tree]] to spawn somewhere on the map.

The five activation times occur at '''07:00, 09:30, 12:00, 14:30, and 17:00''' in-game time. A maximum of five activations can occur during the day, giving players up to five separate chances to generate a Heavenly Tree each in-game day.

When a Heavenly Tree is successfully spawned and remains on the map, one of the shrine’s pillars will glow. The glowing pillar corresponds to the direction of the tree, acting as a compass to guide players toward its location.

[[File:Map2.png|alt=Map|thumb|Directions to help locate trees]]
== Halloweenly ==

[[File:Heavenly shrine corrupted.png|thumb|264x264px]]During the [[2025 Halloween Event]], the '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is partially corrupted.

When the sun aligns at the second and third rings of the sundial, exactly as '''9:30''' and '''12:00''' respectively, will activate the Heavenly Shrine with a purple glow and attempts to spawn a [[Halloweenly]] instead.

When a Halloweenly is successfully spawned and remains on the map, the glowing pillar that corresponds to the direction will have a purple glow instead.
== Trivia ==
* The Heavenly Shrine is the only structure in Oaklands that uses the sun’s position to function.

* It is the sole method of spawning the Heavenly Tree and Halloweenly.

* It is the only structure that functions at a specific day of the week.

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a structure that can be purchased from [[The Oak Depot]]. It is a T-shaped conveyor belt section that allows for advanced conveyor belt setups.

== Functionality ==
When placed, the Intersection Conveyor defaults to its center position. Toggling the switch determines the direction of the output; the other two conveyor sections will become inputs.

The Intersection Conveyor serves two separate purposes. The first purpose is merging two separate inputs into one output, such as bringing together both a wood processing line and a stone processing line together for a unified output to a truck or trailer. The second purpose is to create a filtering or sorting system, which generally involves the use of [[Logic]]. A rudimentary use would be to create a junction that sits between a Refinery and a Forge to allow [[Lithium]] and [[Magnetite]] to bypass the Forge, allowing them to retain their full value.

== Trivia ==
* Unlike almost all other conveyor belt sections, the Intersection Conveyor does not have a large version.

The '''Jar''' is a tool that is used to catch [[Fireflies]], storing [[Fruits|Jams]] and [[Flowers|Dyes]].

== Details ==
By equipping the Jar, the player can interact with swarms of Fireflies that will eventually fill up the Jar. A Jar that is full of Fireflies can be taken back to the [[Resource Hub]] and sold for a profit.

Using [[Press Machine]], Jars can be filled with [[Fruits]] and [[Flowers]] to corresponding Jams and Dyes. Both can be sold to gain profit, but Dyes are used as paint with [[Dye Machine]].

As of 1.54.3, Empty Jars cannot be sold. This is to avoid confusion.

== Outdated Tips ==
*Selling Jars is an easy way to earn cash early in the game. Even the cheapest Firefly variants will always turn a profit, so it is impossible to lose more than what is gained.

*There are two drawbacks to this method: Fireflies only spawn and persist at night, which means that they will disappear at sunrise, and this method also requires players to have enough money to purchase Jars.

== Tips ==

* Selling Jars is an easy way to earn cash early in the game. Jars now sell every firefly variant 2000$ cheaper than they were.  The fireflies empty out of the jar and the jar does not sell itself with fireflies anymore.

'''Blue Ice''' is an [[:Category:Ores|ore]] that was added in [[Update Log/Version 1.45.0|v1.45.0]]. It is exclusively found in the [[Snowlands]].
== Description ==
Blue Ice can only be found in a cave in the Snowlands. This cave has a frozen river passing through it. Its color is a light, cyan-ish blue. Icestone, in all of its forms, has greatly reduced friction. This can be used to build schematics on one's property with a slippery surface.

Unlike many other stone types, Blue Stone has no ores that spawn inside of it.

* Two Blue Ice filled schematics could be briefly seen in the first trailer<ref>https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UzDP_6s95GQ&t=115s&pp=ygUQb2FrbGFuZHMgdHJhaWxlcg%3D%3D</ref> of Oaklands. The material would release to the public only during the 2023 Christmas update with the addition of [[Snowlands]].

title: Interactor
wikitext:
''"Interacts with objects or structures within the world. Requires permissions from the user."''
{{Logic |title={{PAGENAME}} |image= Interactor.png|Unboxed Interactor boxed.png|Boxed |Island=[[Finlay Island|Finlay]] |Store=[[Alan's AutoLogistics]] |Cost=$100 |Object= |Purpose=Emulates human interaction with objects |Requires= |Date Added=01/11/2023 |Version Added=v1.43.0 |Status=Obtainable}} The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a logic component that can be purchased from [[Alan's AutoLogistics]]. It is used to interact with objects. == Functionality == The Interactor interacts with a neighboring object. While the Interactor itself is a 1×1×1 object, the probe on the front of the Interactor adds an additional 1.75 stud range that allows it to interact with an object. As of June 2025, the Interactor ability is depends on the region it controls. Players can change the size, postion of the region (merged into Size mode in Build Mode) to wherever they wanted - allowing to remote control various logics. All interactable items that hit or included in the region, will receive same output signal. The Interactor will activate a single time whenever the signal level changes, and this behavior may need to be accounted for when using activation devices such as the [[Commander]]. Interacting with the size buttons on machines like the [[Industrial Forge|Forge]] or [[Metal Planker|Planker]] acts as if the player was pushing the button a single time. This means that the Interactor will need to be pulsed multiple times if the user wants to automate selecting a size for their machines. Conveyors like [[Straight Conveyor]]s or [[Intersection Conveyor]]s can have their directions switched with an interactor. A signal of 5 turns off the conveyor, less than 5 sets the conveyor to the default direction and more than 5 sets the conveyor to reverse. Note that, since interactors activate when the input signal changes, you must use a constant signal to toggle conveyors; a switch or slider will send a constant signal, while a button sends a pulse that then changes back to zero. The slider is the best choice for this as it requires no other logic to set up, while a switch needs 3 number interfaces, 3 relays, and 3 switches. A signal of 10 allows you to respawn vehicles, signal of 15 allows you to change the vehicle type, and a signal of 20 despawns vehicles. A [[Number Interface]] can be used to control this. With Elevator, a signal between 0 and 10 will decide the length ratio of the Elevator - 0 for normal deactivated state, 10 for fully extended state. This allows player to do multiple flooring using the same elevator. Signal larger than 10 (more specifically, 20) will deactivate the Elevator.{{Logic Nav}}

title: Lab Card
wikitext: {{Stub}} ''"LabCard_description"''{{Objects |image1=Lab Card.png |Island=Snowy Peaks |Function=Granting access to the second floor of the Observatory }}The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is an item that is obtained as part of the Hidden Vials quest in the [[Snowlands|Snowy Peaks]]. == Description == The '''Lab Card''' is an item that allows players into the second floor of the [[Gizmo's Observatory|Observatory]]. It is a blue card with a white strip and white text. The text states "C-09" on the right side of the card, and [[Alan Burk]]'s name on the left side of the card. On the reverse side of the card, the text is mirrored, but there is an additional barcode. Most of the barcode is obstructed, leaving only two thin strips of red dots. Connecting these to each other vertically reveals the full barcode, which is encoded using [[wp:Code 39|Code 39]]. The barcode resolves to *HERRING*. The barcode is a reference to a [[wp:Red herring|red herring]], something deliberately intended to mislead or distract from the original question. The barcode itself is red, and the encoded text is *HERRING*. File:Lab Card code.png|Connected dots File:HERRING code.png|*HERRING* barcode == Obtaining == Obtaining the Lab Card requires the player to get into the [[Snowlands|Snowy Peaks]]. They must find the [[Lab]], and speak to to the [[Unknown Person]] within the lab. They must then find ''five'' separate vials within the Snowy Peaks, and return them to the Unknown Person, who will give them the Lab Card in return for the vials. These vials can be collected in any order the player desires, as long as they are all returned to the Unknown Person at the same time. WARNING: this quest will expire with time. If you take too long to gather all of the vials they will respawn and you will need to go back to the lab and talk to the [[Unknown Person]] again. ---- == The locations of the vials are as follows: == Vial #1 is located on the far left of the biome. Starting from the map at the desert entrance take the path to the left and take the immediate ramp on the right to the very top, go down the dip then up the ramp on the left, follow it to the corner of that area and the first vial will be waiting for you to claim Starting from the Lab, go between the two ramps on either side, and continue upwards, when at the two ramps go up the right one, and continue upwards until you get to the frozen Y lake, follow the shore left and cross the lake once arriving at the part where it becomes a waterfall, from that point on, take the first ramp on your left and go all the way upwards, once at the dip, go down, up the first ramp on your left and follow the edge till the corner, your vial will be waiting [[File:Vial image 1.png|none|thumb|478x478px]] Vial #2 is located on the right side of the biome. From the Lab, Follow the same directions as mentioned in Vial #1 to get to the frozen Y lake, cross immediately, be careful not the fall in the holes in the ice! Hug the right wall until you reach the ramp and head up it. Continue along the path and take the first ramp on the left, follow the series of ramps until you reach the top. Once at the top travel straight ahead to the edge of the cliff where the vial should be sitting. From the desert map, head up the slope past the ramps until you arrive at the frozen Y lake, cross it and continue straight, staying on the snow until you get to the ramp after the ski lift, head up the ramp and follow the walls until you take the next ramp on the left following the series of ramps until you reach the top. Once at the top, travel straight ahead to the edge of the cliff where the vial should be sitting [[File:Vial 3.png|none|thumb|480x480px]] Vial #3 is on the right of the biome near Vial #2 Starting from the first ramp from Vial #2's Taiga directions, Follow the lake until you see what looks like a cliff, but the edge is snowy, this is where the path dips down extremely sharply. Most cars do not have the acceleration to get back up this cliff after going down, so if you are driving, make sure to leave your vehicle at the top of the dip and carry the vial back up manually. Down the cliff on the rocks to the left, the Vial is sitting in the middle of the rock. Starting from the Frozen Y lake, Follow it until you get to an area where the edge looks like a snow covered cliff ledge, the path dips down extremely sharply, but if you scoot forward car near the edge, you will see the vial, do not drive down however as most cars do not have the appropriate acceleration to go back up. Instead walk down the path and carry the vial back up [[File:Vial 4.png|none|thumb|485x485px]] Vial #4 is also located on the right side of the biome near Vial #2. From the first ramp in Vial #2' s Taiga directions, turn left and Head up to the Ski Lift, sharply turn right once you reach the [[Snowdrift Station A & B|cable car]] station. Hug the right wall until you see the vial! From the sharp dip for vial #3's Frozen lake Directions, continue following the lake until you see the sign for the ski lift, turn left and Head up to it, sharply turn right once you reach the [[Snowdrift Station A & B|cable car]] station. Hug the right wall until you see the vial! [[File:Vial 5.png|none|thumb|491x491px]] Vial #5 is located on the far left of the biome on the ramp above the entrance to the lab. From the Lab, hug the left wall until you pass a ramp, head up this ramp and when possible turn right, there you will see a vial waiting for you to bring to the stranger. [[File:Vial 2.png|none|thumb|478x478px]] It is encouraged to use the free cam option if players struggle to find the vials. ==Trivia == *When hovering over the Lab Card, one of the interaction options is "? ? ?". This option currently does nothing. *When inspecting the card, the description says "LabCard_description". This is likely due to the fact that the item is new, and no localized strings for the description have been made. * The card is equippable in a new "pocket" slot, which currently can contain either this or the Red version. Although it still has no function * The vials can not be saved onto your plot, kept in crates, or stored in drawers.

title: Joystick
wikitext:
''"Has four output signals, which can go up to 10.0 depending on how close the joystick is to that direction."''
{{Logic |title={{PAGENAME}} |image= Joystick.png|Unboxed Joystick boxed.png|Boxed |Island=[[Finlay Island|Finlay]] |Store=[[Alan's AutoLogistics]] |Cost=$2,400 |Object= |Purpose=Human interface device with multiple outputs for each axis |Requires= |Date Added=01/11/2023 |Version Added=v1.43.0 |Status=Obtainable |Outputs=}} The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a logic component that can be purchased from [[Alan's AutoLogistics]]. It is a joystick with outputs for both axes. ==Functionality== The Joystick's ball can be clicked on to drag the joystick with; releasing one's grip on the joystick causes it to return to center. As the Joystick moves, it emits a signal from its four ports depending on the direction the joystick is moved in. As there are only positive values in Oaklands's logic system, there is a port for both the positive and negative parts of each axis. Each of these ports can output any signal level between 0 and 10 in steps of 1 depending on where the joystick is positioned. The Joystick inherits the color of the ''first'' wire that is attached to any of its output ports.{{Logic Nav}}

title: Junior Scientist
wikitext:
{{NPC |image = Junior Scientist.png |Island = [[Finlay Island]] |Building = |Version Added = |Date Added = }} The '''Junior Scientist''' (written in game as '''Jr. Scientist''') is a NPC located on [[Finlay Island]]. She is a budding astronomer. == Description == The Junior Scientist can be found by taking the right turn just before crossing the drawbridge, then taking a left turn before crossing the small arched bridge leading to the northern part of Finlay Island. There is a small rock ledge that can be climbed up to reach the Junior Scientist. Talking to the Junior Scientist will cause her to explain that she is "... a scientist! Well... Future scientist!" She explains that she and Giggles (the non-interactible rat standing beside her) are out looking for meteor showers. Should the player ask to know when the next meteor is coming, she will "ask Giggles what he thinks" before demanding the player pay $3,500. If the player pays up, she will give the number of minutes before the next meteor spawns. If the player declines, she will express her disappointment, saying that she "wanted a new telescope". == Dialog == ''Interacting with the Junior Scientist:'' : "Hello I'm a scientist! Well... Future scientist! I love science, don't you? Me and Giggles are looking out for a meteor shower!" * If the player selects "Cool..?": ''Dialog ends'' * If the player selects "When's the next meteor?":
"Hmmm, let me ask Giggles what he thinks... We don't tell strangers right away! *snickers* OK! WE HAVE CAME TO THE DECISION. $3,500 AND I'LL TELL YOU" * ''If the player selects "No thanks":''
"Aww... I wanted a new telescope..." * ''If the player selects "Deal":''
"AWWW TYSM!!! You are so sweet. The next meteor will be in ~[number] minutes!"
''Player loses $3,500.'' {{NPC Nav}} [[Category:NPCs]]

title: Lab
wikitext:
The Lab is a location in the [[Snowy peaks|Snowy Peaks]] associated with the [[Lab Card]] quest. 

The Lab can be accessed from a cave entryway in the Peaks, near the Taiga entrance to the biome. Most of the lab is non-interactible, but the [[Unknown Person]] can be spoken to through a small grate in the wall, behind the broken glass. Speaking to them gives you the option to begin the quest.

There is an exit to the [[River Caves]] through a nearby vent, however it is nearly impossible to get back up to it from the Caves, so do not use it unless you are certain your business is finished in the Lab. Amusingly, a poster of a kitten with the text "BELIEVE" over its head can be found in this area.

title: Lightningbane
wikitext:
''"A lightning infused pickaxe, repurposed to smash and destroy any electrified rock."''
{{Pickaxe|Swing Power=7.5|Swing Distance=24 studs|Swing Time=0.4|AOE Distance=2.5 studs|Version Added=1.95.0|Date Added=11/8/2025|Status=Obtainable|image1=Lightningbane.png|Pickaxe Power=2 (can mine [[refined pickaxe]] requiring stones)|Price=$44,000 ([[Reinforced Pickaxe]])|Shop=N/A}} == Description == The Lightningbane is an extremely speedy pickaxe with a decent area-of-effect. A full charge only takes about a quarter second, making this the fastest swinging pickaxe in the game. It is comparable to the [[Petalfall|Petalfall Katana]] in pickaxe form. == Appearance == The Lightning Bane Pickaxe looks like a staff with the '''Lightning Core''' affixed to the top, and the head being transparent and blue. Two glowing lightning bolt symbols protrude from the bottom of the handle. An electricity particle flows down both sides of the head and the handle from the core in the middle. == Obtaining == # Obtain the following materials: ## [[Zapium]] (Must be Forged) ## [[Reinforced Pickaxe]] ## [[Lightning Core]] ## [[Michael's Copper Axe|Copper Axe]] (You will likely need more than one due to it having a 50% chance to lose it's lightning-summoning ability) # Head to the area a ways behind [[Alan's AutoLogistics]] until you find the [[Lightning Shrine|copper shrine]] with 4 lightning rods surrounding it. # Wait for a thunderstorm to begin. # Hold the '''Copper Axe''' inside of the outermost lightning rod until it is struck and activates. ## Do this for all 4 Lightning Rods. # Carry the '''Zapium''', '''Reinforced Pickaxe''', and '''Lightning Core''' down the now-opened hole into the shrine, and place them into the blue bowl inside of the Cave. For a simple and quick tutorial showing these steps, see [https://youtu.be/gqwZEawUp54 this video]. [[Category:Tools]] [[Category:Pickaxes]]

wikitext:
The '''Lightning Shrine''' is a crafting location behind [[Alan's AutoLogistics]] added in [[Secret Update 1.95.0]].

To access this location, you will need the [[Michael%27s_Copper_Axe|Copper Axe]], and then you will need to approach the far obelisk during a thunderstorm while holding it. wikitext:
The Lightning Bane Cave is a located in the [[Finlay]] Taiga, behind [[Alan's AutoLogistics]]. It is unlocked by having lightning strike 4 lightning rods (done by using [[Michael's Copper Axe|Michael's copper axe]]. Once opened it stays open for the entirety of the server's runtime.

title: Landhauler
wikitext:
[[File:Landhauler.png|thumb|A landhauler in an open field.|434x434px]]
[[File:Landhauler-Dump Truck.jpg|thumb|431x431px]]
The '''landhauler''' is a vehicle that can be bought from [[Alan's AutoLogistics|Alan's autologistics]] for $50,000. It has a top speed of 75 studs per second going both forward and backward on flat land. 

It features two wheels in the front and four more in the back. It also has one drivers seat paired with a passenger's seat right next to it, with two windowed doors on each side and a big windshield on the front.

It also has a sort of bin on the back of it that allows for easy transportation of various materials such as wood and ores. The bin has two options for interaction of it which are lowering and raising the bin. When the bin is fully raised, it temporarily removes the back wall of the bin so the materials inside flow out, Effectively working as a dump truck.

The description of the landhauler ingame is as follows: 

"''This dump of a truck can carry loads of objects, like ores, and dump them! Comes with a special ability to raise and lower the bin, where the back will automatically open.''"

Type: Structures              Cost: $50,000

title: Logic
wikitext:
[[File:LogicExample.png|right|thumb|300px|An example of a logic system using [[Number Interface]]s and [[Calculator]]s to control [[Intersection Conveyor]]s with [[Interactor]]s. Colored wires are used for human readability. The red and blue wires lead to [[Switch]]es on the other side of the panel.]]
'''Logic''' is a system in Oaklands used to create systems powered by advanced logic. This can be as simple as automating components of one's property, or as complex as something like calculators or displays.

== Overview ==
All logic-related structures can be purchased from [[Alan's AutoLogistics]], located on [[Finlay Island]] near the entrance to the [[Acid Wastes]].

Logic structures can be separated into four loose groups:
* Inputs, which generate a signal for a logic system;
* Gates, which are used to compare signals;
* Processors, which manipulate signals;
* Outputs, which convert a logic signal into action.

All structures that can interact with logic feature small square ports on the side of the device. Depending on the device, there may be a single port, or multiple ports. Whether a port is treated as input or output is not known until a user attempts to run a wire to it.

A full list of structures is available at [[:Category:Logic|Category:Logic]].

== Signals ==
Logic components generate signals. Most human interface devices, such as the [[Switch]] and [[Slider]], generate signals between 0 and 10. Specialized devices like the [[Weather Sensor]] emit signals at different scales. Components that accept a signal for output, such as the [[14 Segment Display]] and [[Music Note]], accept signals well above 10, necessitating the usage of specialized inputs and/or processors to achieve signals high enough to perform certain functions.

== Wires ==
Wires instantly carry a signal from their origin to their destination. A wire can be placed anywhere on one's property as long as it is initially attached to a solid surface. Wires can also be run through solid objects. Wires can be given any color while they are being placed, though the entire run of wire will be one single color. A premade palette of colors is available to all players; completely custom colors, as well as the option to enable neon wiring, can be unlocked via purchasing the "Creative Wiring" game pass for 400 Robux. When running a wire, the user must terminate the wire by connecting it to another logic component, otherwise the entire wire will be deleted. Wires can be cloned and cut, but cannot be modified once they have been placed. Moving or destroying a structure with a wire attached to it will also destroy the wire.

Certain input components will inherit the color of the wire attached to it. These are usually human interface devices.

title: Lore
wikitext:
{{Cleanup|This article is written like a blogpost (i.e. informally) and is in desperate need of someone who knows more about the lore to structure things more sensibly.}}
More information is needed to finish this page and lore is in question however there will be a few points mentioned that seem to imply lore.

The updates seem to be going backwards in time! Let me explain: the game started as one island; having few buildings and a lot of ruins scattered around. [[Mike's Mines]] was caved in. [[Mike Miner]] was there however and had dialogue along the lines of ''"Oh woe is me, Jenna'' [supposedly Mike's wife] ''has disappeared. My life is miserable without her."'' There was also a wanted poster for [[Jerry Junkman]] offering a [[Tall Refined Axe|tall refined axe]] reward; posted at [[The Oak Depot]]. A tunnel was seen behind the lighthouse leading you to a [[Familiar Island|small island]], that, when found, gives you the badge "A Familiar Place".

[[Ferwater Island|A new Island]] was introduced, adding new buildings and more ruins atop pillars of sandstone connected by ropes. Another update later, the lighthouse was in burning rubble.

Update! We got a single island with a ravine, bridged by the same operators as before; the [[Hyper Bridgeman]] and the [[Sleepy Bridgeman]]. The same old structures remain in the desert and plain new ruins are now found hinting that [[Alan's AutoLogistics]] is all rusty and looks like it's been closed forever. [[Mike's Mines|Mike's mines]] is no longer caved in and Jenna is now standing beside the shack just outside the mine. You can speak with her; she says "Have a safe travel down those mines!" The game gives you the option to say "Where have you been?" She responds with "What do you mean, silly? I have always been here!", which hints at deeper lore. 

Another update and Alan's AutoLogistics is open for business, and now looks like the ruins went in reverse— no detail is left out. Half of the store is still closed, however. 

If this is indeed a reverse time line the automobile half closed and logistics half remained. An earthquake closed the shop and it was left to rust. The island started sinking and <u>Jenna</u> disappeared and pirates stopped coming. The island continued to sink and became two separate islands. [[Lighthouse|The light house]] was destroyed suspect being [[Jerry Junkman]] a warrant for his arrest was made and he hid at [[Jer's Junkyard]] later it was rebuilt. The bridge collapsed severing connection to [[Ferwater Island]]. The source of the backwards timeline (if there is any) is unknown.

title: Lock
wikitext:
''"A structure that comes with a key! Outputs a signal of 10.0 when the lock is turned. The signal may stay activated if the key is taken out while the lock is turned."''
{{Logic |title={{PAGENAME}} |image= Lock.png|Unboxed Lock boxed.png|Boxed |Island=[[Finlay Island|Finlay]] |Store=[[Alan's AutoLogistics]] |Cost=$860 |Object= |Purpose=Outputs a signal that can be locked on/off with a physical key |Requires= |Date Added=01/11/2023 |Version Added=v1.43.0 |Status=Obtainable |Outputs=}}The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a logic component that can be purchased from [[Alan's AutoLogistics]]. It is a keyhole with an included key. ==Functionality== When first placed, the Lock includes a skeleton key in its keyway. It is similar in appearance to the [[Adurite Key]], albeit silver in color. As long as the key is still in the keyway, the user can turn the key by pressing V. If the keyway is perpendicular to the output port, the Lock emits a signal of 0. If the keyway is parallel with the output port, the Lock emits a signal of 10. If the key is removed from the keyway by pressing F, then the Lock can no longer be operated. A separate object, the '''LogicKey''', will eject from the Lock when this happens. This key cannot be added to one's inventory. To reinsert the key, the user must drag the LogicKey back on top of the Lock, where it will insert itself similar to placing a record on the [[Blue Vinyl Player]]. Any LogicKey can be inserted into any open Lock. LogicKey.png|The LogicKey. == Trivia == * The LogicKey has a description of "LogicKey_description", which is a placeholder value for an unlocalized string. {{Logic Nav}}

To mine '''Lumite''', you need a '''[[Refined Pickaxe|refined pickaxe]]''' or greater. [[Industrial Refinery|'''Industrial Refineries''']] and '''[[Industrial Forge|Industrial Forges]]''' are required to process it.

* '''Lumite''' can '''not''' be exchanged for '''credits''' in its '''forged''' or '''refined''' variant.
*'''Lumite''' needs to be refined and forged by '''[[Industrial Refinery]]''' and [[Industrial Forge|'''Industrial Forge''']]

The Luminescent Mushroom is a type of [[Mushrooms|Mushroom]] found underwater within an underground cave system below the Azure Fields. This cave lies beneath the cluster of small, interconnected islands characterized by blue-colored grass and surrounded by large formations of [[Azurite]] crystals, which also densely line the cave entrance and interior.

The Luminescent Mushroom is notable for its glowing cap and tall, slender stem, but it poses environmental hazards to those who approach it. When disturbed, it releases bubbles from beneath its cap that travel toward nearby players, causing the player to be launched upwards and be damaged while partially replenishing oxygen. Due to these conditions, harvesting Luminescent Mushrooms is considered hazardous and is typically undertaken using scooba equipment, such as a [[Rusty Scooba Tank]] or the more efficient [[Refined Scooba Tank]], particularly when gathering large quantities or transporting them by vehicle.

== Trivia ==
* If the Luminescent Mushroom is hit once, it acts dormant and stops shooting bubbles. This can be very useful for grinding Luminescent Mushrooms.

}}Magnetite is one of the many ores that can be found around [[Finlay Island]] and The [[The Moon|moon]]. Magnetite ore can only spawn in [[Lightslate]] nodes. The raw form of Magnetite takes on a purple color with a fluorescent glow in cubic shapes. Putting Magnetite through a Refinery increases its value to $600 per stud. The price will remain the same even if refined Magnetite is forged. Despite having a 1/1000 chance to spawn only at night, Magnetite is relatively common to find on the surface. Magnetite will persist into the day if it spawns at night and despawn later, similar to other ores.
[[File:Magnetite on pi island.png|thumb]]
The ore stands out due to its vibrant color and glow, which is lost after being refined, or forged

As with any other material in the game, you can use refined and forged Magnetite to complete schematics. But is NOT recommended. Magnetite does not glow at all when used to complete schematics.

== Trivia ==

* Refined Magnetite used to sell for $1,000 per stud before it was debuffed in the update on August 8, 2023, which revamped the map.
*Magnetite can be found on the moon! This is most likely very rare due to the rarity of the ore itself, and the placement.[[File:Magnetite on the moon.png|thumb|230x230px|Magnetite on the moon]]Magnetite is the only ore in the game that decreases in value when forged. This is in reference to how in real life when magnets are heated to high temperatures, they lose their magnetic force, thereby devaluing their efficacy. In other words, only refine Magnetite, DON'T forge it.
*Magnetite, [[Ore]], [[Pyrite]], [[Lithium]], and [[Stone]] are the only square-like ores in the game.
*In the Typical Developers Discord server, Magnetite has reputedly been "eaten" by various users.
**This is possibly due to how Magnetite can resemble candy, regardless of which form it is in—ore, refined, or forged.

== Description ==
The '''Magma''' tree is a fiery tree that grows in the [[Magma Cave|Magma Caves]], located in the lower section of [[Mike's Mines]]. Like [[Plek]] or [[Mysterious Mushrooms]], Magma trees are incredibly valuable due to how difficult it is to obtain, requiring the successful navigation of the precarious and deadly Magma Caves.    

It can be identified by its irregularly shaped burnt black trunk and glowing neon orange leaves.

'''Requires a [[Refined Axe]] or greater.'''

==Obtaining ==
Magma trees are found in the Magma Caves, located behind a wall in Mikes Mines that that can be broken with explosives. Magma Trees also spawn at the site of a [[Meteor|Meteor Crater]], typically spawning 2 trees.

==Trivia ==
*The Magma tree is one of the few trees that have had their main spawn location moved, having previously been located around the [[Lighthouse]]. Their location was moved as a result of the map revamp on 21/07/2023.
*Magma trees are currently one of the better ways to farm cash, with a full grown, multi-branched tree selling for ~$20-30K if sanded and planked. However, due to spawning in a dangerous and tedious location and trees falling in the lava causing losses, farming Mysterious Mushrooms can be an easier method of farming money.
*The easiest way to access Magma trees is to find them from [[Meteor|Meteors]]. Each meteor produces 2 trees, and can be sold for a lot of quick cash.
*Due to its unique neon orange color, sanded Magma tree is ideal for use in builds that involve lava-like elements or neon lighting.
*The Magma tree used to have opaque leaves, but they became translucent after the map revamp.
*Magma tree leaves become lighter in color as colder seasons approach.
*There is a bug that can generate double trunk Magma trees. Hese bugged trees require chopping both trunks to take it down. This bug often occurs with Magma trees spawned from a meteor crash site.

title: Magma Caves
wikitext:
{{Buildings
|image1 = Lava Cave 400x800.png
|Island = Finlay, Mike's Mines
|Purpose = Magma Trees, Burning Skull Quest, Flameslate, Burning Blossom(Petalfall quest)

== Description ==
The '''Magma Caves''' are a subarea of [[Mike's Mines]], locked behind a rock wall that can be broken with explosives. Players can use three [[Small Bomb|Small Bombs]] from Mike Miner's shop to gain access into this area. The Magma Caves are characterized by dark rock pillars, lava pools, and red patches of dirt. 

Note that having a [[Healing Coil]] from the [[Classic Store]], an [[Obsidian Skull]], or a [[Fusion Coil]] is strongly recommended, as you ''will'' take damage when passing over lava pools. (driving skills are also required) 

To get to the Magma Caves, go to Mike's Mines and try to follow the directions on the map next to the wall.   

== Lumberwork ==
At the deepest point of Magma Caves, players can find the spawn point for [[Magma Tree|Magma Trees]], [[Burning Blossom|Burning Blossoms]] and [[Ash Tree|Ash Trees]]. Many of the sections in the Magma Caves require parkour, so it is difficult/near impossible for the player to bring their car to this point. It is recommended that players walk on foot to reach this area. While not necessary, a [[Gravity Coil]] and a [[Speed Coil]] (bought from the [[Classic Store]]) can prove helpful when traversing the Magma Caves.

* Magma Trees are an especially profitable tree that can also spawn from meteorites. However, note that the Magma Caves are difficult to farm due to the sheer distance away from player spawn, so farming Magma Trees from this location is not as expedient as farming [[Mysterious Mushrooms]].

* When sanded, Magma Tree wood displays a neon orange color that is useful in making lava and futuristic builds. Ash Trees offer a deep black coloration that can be used for framing other colors. 

== Mining ==
Upon areas with red dirt/grass, two types of rock nodes can spawn: [[Lavaslate]] and [[Blackstone]]. On small islands in the lava lakes near the bottom of the caves, [[Flameslate]] nodes can also spawn. While not completely unique to this area, the rare ores for Magma Caves are:
* [[Adurite]], in Lavaslate nodes (but can spawn in other stone types).
* [[Palladium]], in Blackstone nodes (but can spawn in other stone types).
* [[Obsidian]], in Lavaslate and Blackstone nodes (but can also be found in Flameslate after Magmite freezes).
* [[Rosa Flama Quartz|Rosa Flame Quartz]], in Lavaslate nodes (but can spawn in other stone types).
* [[Magmite]], in Flameslate nodes only.
[[File:Magma_Cave_without_Flashlight.png|thumb|160x160px|Without a flashlight, ores are difficult to see.]][[File:Magma_Cave_with_Flashlight.png|thumb|With a flashlight, this ore is visible.|157x157px]]Note that Blackstone nodes have a dark coloration, making it difficult to see if any ores spawned in them. Moreover, the Magma Caves are dark, with a deeper black fog compared to Mike's Mines. A [[Flashlight]] from the [[The Oak Depot|Oak Depot]] is very useful in identifying any ores in the nodes.

== Special Quests ==
As part of the [[Emberbane|Emberbane Axe]] quest, players can obtain the [[Skull|Burning Skull]] in this area. By placing a [[Skull]] next to a Magma Tree or lava pool, it will gradually redden and turn into a Burning Skull, used to unlock the Emberbane Axe.

=== Other ===
On the right side of Magma Caves there is another cave that leads to [[The Void]].

== Description ==
'''Magmite''' is an uncommon, bright yellow ore found in the [[Magma Caves]] within [[Flameslate]] nodes.

This ore is unique, as when it is not in contact to heat, it will start cooling down, transitioning to a redder hue up until it completely cools, turning the ore into [[Obsidian]]. This process takes '''2 Minutes and 45 Seconds''' to complete, so be sure to keep the ores warm and bring them to a heat source quickly.

To heat up the ore, you can make the ore sit over a lava pool, keep it in contact with [[Boxed Lava]], or put it in a [[Storage Drawer]] or [[Large Crate|Crate]], as it will not cool down and will stay the color it is. When this ore is refined or forged, it will no longer cool down, similarly to how [[Boomite]] wont explode after refining or forging.

It is recommended to heat the ore until it turns yellow before leaving the cave. While it turns  red fast, it stills take some time to turn into obsidian.

A special tool that can vacuum up materials from resources or schematics, and can be used to selectively fill schematics to the required amount!
== Introduction ==
The '''Material Gun''' is a specialized tool that assists with building. It can store materials up to its storage limit. The gun has three modes; consume, swap, and fill. This tool is not necessary to fill schematics but will benefit players by saving materials. The manual way of filling schematics (placing loose material into a schematic) has a risk of overfilling. The Material Gun is able to fill schematics precisely.(note: Once items are consumed they cannot be removed in item form ) The "consume" mode will store any material from loose items (i.e. logs, rocks, ore, fabric rolls, stained glass) or from filled schematics. The "swap" mode will take the selected material from the gun's selection UI and replace any filled or unfilled schematic with said material. The "fill" mode will fill any empty schematics. It will not work on filled schematics. The base pricing of the Material Gun is $99,999. The upgrades start at $5000.
== Upgrades == {| class="sortable mw-collapsible mw-collapsed fandom-table" |+Material Gun Upgrades ! ! ! |- |'''Upgrade #''' |'''Pricing''' |'''Results''' |- |Upgrade 1 |5000 | +50µm |- |Upgrade 2 |5000 | +50µm |} As you pay $5000, you gain +50µm space in your material gun.

wikitext: {{Buildings |image1 = Mike'sMines.png |Island = Finlay, Main Area |NPC = Mike Miner |Purpose = Magma Caves,Pedestal button |Music = [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3vPHIDPEwm8 Kevin MacLeod - Night Cave]}} == [[File:Diamond_Main_Titles.png|75x75px]] Mike's Mines == '''Mike's Mines''' is a location where players can mine several rocks for ore. At the entrance to Mike's Mines, an NPC named [[Mike Miner]] sells an array of low-tier explosives that can be used to access hidden and blocked-off areas around the map. A [[pillow]] and [[Rusty Axe|rusty axe]] can be found behind Mike, but neither can be interacted with. The Mines are shrouded in darkness with only a vestigial amount of light coming from the hanging lanterns, so it is recommended that players use the headlights of their car or a [[flashlight]] while venturing into Mike's Mines. Only [[Lightslate]], [[Darkslate]], [[Smokeslate]], and [[Beigeslate]] nodes can spawn in Mike's Mines. It is more common for certain ore types to spawn in Mike's Mines compared to the [[Finlay Island|Finlay Grasslands]], notably [[Mythril]] and [[Gold]] nodes. == [[File:Hexagon_Location.png|50x50px]] Notable Locations == Mike's Mines can now be divided into several sublocations, with one major location that is connected directly to Mike's Mines. This unique location is the: * [[Magma Caves]], found at an explodable entrance at the center of the Low Mines. Mike's Mines also has less important but still useful biomes. These include: * Mike's Mines (known simply as the Mines) * Low Mines, located deeper inside the Mines. * Quartz Cave, located directly left from the main entrance. * Underground Lake, located directly right from the main entrance. [[File:Screenshot 2025-06-09 210837.png|center|thumb|445x445px|Mike's Mines, with the "normal" Mines depicted at the bottom, and the Low Mines depicted at the top of the map.]] === [[File:Diamond_Subtitle.png|20x20px]] '''Mike's Mines (the "Mines")''' === * Immediately accessible from all entrances on the surface to Mike's Mines. * Spawns [[Beigeslate]] and [[Lightslate]]. [[Marble]] also spawns here when driving closer to the Quartz Cave. * [[Copper|Raw Copper]] and [[Iron|Raw Iron]] nodes spawn on the walls and ceiling in particular areas, useful for farming large amounts of these metals. === [[File:Diamond_Subtitle.png|20x20px]] '''Low Mines''' === * The Low Mines are continuous with the normal Mines, except denoted by a darker atmosphere and louder, more cacophonous soundtrack. * Spawns [[Darkslate]] and [[Smokeslate]] in addition to Beigeslate and Lightslate. * [[Tin|Raw Tin]] and [[Gold|Raw Gold]] nodes spawn on the walls and ceiling in particular areas, useful for farming large amounts of these metals. * Has the entrance to the [[Magma Caves]]. === [[File:Diamond_Subtitle.png|20x20px]] Quartz Cave === * From the main entrance of Mike's Mines, follow the in-game map by taking the left pathway to reach the Quartz Cave. * Spawns Marble with guaranteed ores of either [[Quartz]] or [[Rosa Flama Quartz]]. [[File:Screenshot 2025-06-09 211345.png|center|thumb|648x648px|Quartz Cave]] [[File:Screenshot 2025-06-09 211543.png|center|thumb|631x631px|Rosa Flama Quartz at the lowest point of Quartz Cave.]] === [[File:Diamond_Subtitle.png|20x20px]] Underground Lake === * Has several entrances across Finlay; allows access to Mike's Mines from [[Flowering Meadows]] and the Finlay Taiga. * Has a potential location for the [[Pirate Boat]] shop. * One of the spawn locations of [[Celestial Flowers]]. * The only spawn location of [[Luminescent Kelp]]. == [[File:Hexagon_Stores.png|50x50px]] Stores == === [[File:Diamond_Subtitle.png|20x20px]] Finlay Stores === [[File:Screenshot 2025-06-06 144623.png|thumb|Pirate Boat Shop in Mike's Mines[[File:Screenshot 2025-06-06 145136.png|thumb|Red button hidden in the ceiling of the Underground Lake.]]]] Mike's Mines has two stores: * [[Mike Miner|Mike's Mines Shop]], located at the main entrance to Mike's Mines. The following chart lists the items that Miner Mike offers. * The [[Pirate Boat]] shop, a moving shop that sells high-tier explosives, located in one of the offshoots of the Underground Lake. {| class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed fandom-table" ! Price of the Item |- | [[Dynamite Stick]] | [[File:Dynamite_Stick_1x.png|120x120px]] | $500 |- | [[Small Bomb]] | [[File:Bomb_boxed.png|128x128px]] | $1,000 |- |[[Miner's Lamp]] |[[File:Miner's_Lamp_Unboxed.png|123x123px]] |$600 |- |[[Lantern]] |[[File:Lantern_unboxed.png|121x121px]] |$320 |- | [[Sun Dry]] | [[File:Sun_Dry_Vinyl.png|118x118px]] | $2,400 |} == [[File:Hexagon_Quests.png|50x50px]] Quests and Secrets == **Rewrite in progress. * Red Button to activate quest pedestals is located here for the [[Uncertain Pickaxe]] quest, - you need to use the scaffolding on the ceiling to parkour to it. * [[Skull|Burning Skull]] can be made in [[Magma Caves]]. == [[File:Hexagon_Axe.png|50x50px]] Lumberwork == With the name, Mike's Mines, it is immediately clear this area is not intended for lumberwork. However, there are still two tree types (not counting Magma Caves) located in the Underground Lake of Mike's Mines: * [[Kelp]], common rarity, underwater in the Underground Lake. * [[Luminescent Kelp]], common rarity, underwater in the Underground Lake. == [[File:Hexagon_Pickaxe.png|50x50px]] Mining == === [[File:Diamond_Subtitle.png|20x20px]] Mike's Mines Stone Types === Mike's Mines is an early-game mine used for farming common ores and stones. It is more convenient than farming nodes on the surface of Finlay as this area is almost entirely dedicated to ores. Using a [[Metal Detector]] allows you to easily identify what ore, if any, occupies a stone node. Using a [[Flashlight]] or your vehicle's headlights is a useful strategy to identify ores early-game, as Mike's Mines (and the Low Mines especially) are much darker compared to the surface. On another note: the "raw" ore variant (for Copper, Iron, Tin, and Gold) spawn on the walls and ceilings - making them much more difficult to mine. You can sometimes get lucky and mine these nodes if they spawn close enough to the ground, but the nodes that spawn on the ceiling require either a [[Gravity Coil]] (or [[Fusion Coil]]), a taller vehicle to stand/jump off from (such as the new [[Freyliner Transporter]] vehicle), or the [[Boom Blaster]] from [[Dugg's Digging]] whilst using [[Sticky bomb|Sticky Bombs]] from the [[River Shop]] as ammunition. Easy to find in River Caves and Desert Oasis. |} === [[File:Diamond_Subtitle.png|20x20px]] Mike's Mines Ore Types (Detailed) === Ores spawn in a particular stone type. Due to an update to the way in which ores and stone nodes are generated, different ores can not spawn on the same node - for example, Pyrite can not spawn on Lightslate. Using a [[Metal Detector]] allows you to easily identify what ore, if any, occupies a stone node. The rarity listed depends on the ore's sell value and its difficulty in retrieving it. This is a comprehensive list of all ores that could spawn in Mike's Mines disregarding glitches: * [[Copper]], common rarity, found in [[Beigeslate]]. * [[Pyrite]], common rarity, found in [[Beigeslate]]. * [[Gold]], common rarity, found in [[Beigeslate]]. * * [[Iron]], common rarity, found in [[Lightslate]]. * [[Inkstone|Ink]], common rarity, found in [[Lightslate]] (Low spawn rate in Mike's Mines). * * [[Tin]], common rarity, in [[Darkslate]]. * [[Lithium]], common rarity, in [[Smokeslate]]. * [[Mythril]], uncommon rarity, found in [[Darkslate]] and [[Smokeslate]]. * * [[Quartz]], common rarity, in [[Marble]]. * [[Rose Quartz|Rosa Quartz]], common rarity, in [[Marble]]. * * * [[OpalBlue|Blue]], [[OpalRed|Red]], and [[OpalBrown|Brown Opal]], uncommon rarity, in [[Blue Clay|Blue]], [[Red Clay|Red]], and [[Brown Clay]] (low spawn rate in normal waters; guaranteed spawn in Desert Oasis and certain areas of the River Caves) == [[File:Hexagon_Forage.png|50x50px]] Foraging == Once more; with the name, Mike's Mines, it is immediately clear this area is not intended for foraging. However, there is one forageable (not counting Magma Caves) in the Underground Lake of Mike's Mines: * [[Celestial Flowers]], on the foliage hanging from the ceiling above and around the Underground Lake. == Trivia == * Behind The small shack you can find a rock with an X on top, which can be exploded to gain access to buying the [[Sun Dry]] Vinyl. * During the Halloween 2023 event [[Candycorn]] and [[Sweetstone]] were able to be found inside of Mike's Mines {{Locations Nav}} [[Category:Locations]] [[Category:Stores]]

'''Mike Miner''' is a NPC in Oaklands, and the proprietor of [[Mike's Mines]].

== Description ==
Prior to the map revamp, Mike Miner had a small shop on the far side of Finlay Island. He sold low-grade explosives, [[Lantern]]s, and [[Miner's Lamp]]s. His wife had gone missing, and the man had been left dejected.

In the current version of the map, Mike Miner runs a shop out of a shack at the entrance to his self-named mines. These mines run deep beneath the earth. The shop itself sells the same low-grade explosives as before, though Mike himself is far more upbeat. Mike speaks with a stereotypical "cowboy" accent. He is accompanied by his wife Jenna, who stands outside the shack.

The '''Meteor Core''' is an object in Oaklands. It can be found in the crash site of a fallen [[Meteor]].

== Details ==
Meteor Cores are spherical objects appearing in variegated red-to-orange colors with a luminescent glow. They are found in the middle of crash sites, with a relatively common spawn rate. In and of itself, the Meteor Core exhibits no function. However, it is an imperative component in crafting the [[Emberbane]]. It can also be [[Infused Core|infused]]; the infused core is an imperative component in crafting the [[Fusion Coil]].

== Tips ==
* Holiday-themed meteors typically override standard meteor spawning mechanics, meaning that the Meteor Core will become more difficult to obtain in the case of a Halloween Meteor and be completely unobtainable during Christmas. Selling the Meteor Core to Players can be more Profitable. Many people pay about 20K each.

title: Meteor
wikitext:
[[File:Crater2.png|right|thumb|300px|A crash site.]]
[[File:Сrater.png|thumb|346x346px]]
[[File:RobloxStudioBeta N0FF4dKWZT.png|thumb|Recently leaked Green and blue meteor]]
'''Meteors''' are a random event that occurs in Oaklands. A meteor will fall from the sky before crashing into the ground, being either red or blue, sinalizing the type of wood it contains.

== Details ==
[[File:New meteor spawns.png|right|340px|thumb|Possible spawn locations for meteor craters]]
Meteors spawn in random intervals between 15 - 75 minutes. (fact check please!) Paying the [[Junior Scientist]] for her prediction will give the player an accurate amount of time until the next meteor spawns.

When a meteor spawns, the first indication anyone has will be a low rumbling sound as the meteor falls from the sky. The meteor will fall in a random direction at a shallow angle towards the crash site. While it usually takes approximately 30 seconds for the meteor to crash into the ground once it spawns, the meteor is driven by server-side physics and will move slowly in busy servers.

Once the meteor crashes into the ground, it plays a server-wide crashing sound, and causes everyone's screens to shake, no matter how far away they actually are from the crash site. The crash site itself forms massive embankments of dirt; inside the crater, 2 [[Magma Tree]]s and 3 [[Ash Tree|Ash Trees]] of varying size will spawn. If you are caught in the spawn radius of the crater, it will instantly kill you. A [[Meteor Core]] also has a 100% chance to spawn at this crash site.

=== Holiday variants ===
During Halloween 2023, there was a high chance to spawn a special Halloween meteor instead of a standard meteor. The Halloween meteor was green instead of red. The crash site contained a [[Hallow Tree]] at the center, topped with a [[Hallow Eye]] that would constantly deal damage to the closest player in the crash site. It was surrounded by 4-5 [[Bone Tree]]s.

During Christmas 2023, the meteor was replaced by Santa's sleigh. Rudolph's glowing red nose could be seen even through terrain. When Santa passed directly over one of the crash sites, he would drop a gift, which would impact the ground and roll out into a shallow depression. This contained various Christmas 2023 items (including gifts,) as well as 4-5 [[Candy Cane Tree]]s.

== The Blue Meteor ==
[[File:1582541544 9938675423 1726953440309.png|thumb|the meteor's crash site]]
The Blue Meteor or also known as The Electrified Meteor is just like the magma meteor instead it spawns: [[Electrified Tree]], [[Electrified Bamboo]], and [[Eel Kelp]]. The [[Lightning Core|Lightning core]] spawns at 100% rate. Originally suggested by WhiteRoams.

== Tips ==
* Solo lobbies are the best way to prevent other players from claiming unclaimed meteors you're searching for.
* Raising graphics to the maximum setting will allow the player to see meteors as they approach and get a general idea of where they will land.
* Being ready in a fast vehicle, such as the [[Oakmobile]] (or [[Classic Joop]]), will allow the player to reach the crash site first. They can then claim the Meteor Core and/or any of the trees in the crash site.
* Bring an [[Emberbane]]; all of the trees in the crash site will be much easier to chop as a result.
* Hit all of the Magma trees once so you claim them as yours and pick up the meteor core if you are in a public server.

== Trivia ==
* Meteor crash sites were first teased with the map destruction event prior to the map remake, where a meteor crashed into the original [[Lighthouse]], causing Magma Trees to grow from it.
* At one point the meteor was nerfed, having a chance to replace some or all of the Magma Trees inside with Ash Trees. This has since been reverted.
* A full haul from a meteor crash site, when completely processed with a [[Industrial Sander|sander]] and a [[Metal Planker|planker]], can net the player anywhere between $35,000 and $50,000 depending on tree size and quantity.

title: Monstrous Manor Trophy
wikitext:
[[File:Monstrous Manor Trophy.png|thumb|407x407px]]''"Happy Halloween!"''
In-game description

The '''Monstrous Manor Trophy''' is an event-exclusive collectible trophy introduced during the Halloween 2025 update. It is an extremely rare drop obtained from defeating enemies that appear during the [[Blood Moon]] event.

== Details ==
The Monstrous Manor Trophy serves purely as a decorative collectible, rewarding players who successfully defeat enemies during the [[Blood Moon]]. As one of the rarest obtainable trophies in the game, it symbolizes victory over the corrupted forces that emerged throughout the Halloween 2025 event. The trophy cannot be repurchased or found in stores, making it a highly sought-after item among players who participated in the event.

== Appearance ==
The Monstrous Manor Trophy features an intricately designed golden base with twisting ornamental stems that rise to support a miniature model of the Monstrous Manor, the central structure of the Halloween 2025 event. The manor sits prominently atop the pedestal, with the word “Halloween” floating above it in crimson letters, while “2025” is embossed on the front of the base in matching red. Its bright, metallic sheen and detailed craftsmanship make it stand out as both a memento of the event and a mark of rare achievement.

== Trivia ==

* The Monstrous Manor Trophy is the only trophy to directly feature a structure from its respective event.
* It was first introduced alongside the return of the Blood Moon mechanic in the Halloween 2025 update.
* Because of its extremely low drop rate, few players managed to obtain the Monstrous Manor Trophy during the event, making it one of the rarest decorative trophies in ''Oaklands''.

'''Meteorite''' is a relatively uncommon ore that can only spawn in Meteorite nodes inside of [[Meteor]] Crash Sites.

The raw form of '''Meteorite''' has two different appearances, rock and ore. '''Meteorite''' rock is reminiscent of [[Flameslate]], but darker. '''Meteorite''' ore is the same as the rock but also has small spherical nodes of slate containing bright red chunks of ore, which have a pulsing particle effect. Refined '''Meteorite''' is distinctly reflective and bright red, appearing to be the only ore in the game that has reflections like it does. Forged '''Meteorite''' is simply bright red metal.

== Description ==
Mysterious Mushrooms are a type of [[Mushrooms|Mushroom]] found in [[Uncertainty Cave]] (Inside Desert Canyons). They are found scattered on the ceiling of the cave. These mushrooms shoot projectiles toward players who come close to them. The projectiles themselves do little damage; since there are many of these mushrooms in the cave, however, the collective damage received is considerable. Note that the mushrooms can't shoot projectiles without their cap, albeit chopped down caps don't shoot projectiles.

When a player is hit by a Mysterious Mushroom's projectile, the player is launched upwards. This allows the player to reach the anti-gravity zone, where the player can cut Mysterious Mushrooms down from the cave ceiling. While in the anti-gravity zone, the player can "swim" or float in the air.

Mysterious Mushroom wood can take 3 to 4 hits using the [[Tall Refined Axe]]. Depending on the size, the mushroom can yield anywhere from $2,000 upward to $6,000.  With recent update (as of the date of this edit), every tree can have various size, and Mysterious Mushroom's cap can get to $9,000 a cap at rare chance (!)

=== Quest Information ===
For the special quest in obtaining the [[Uncertain Pickaxe]], [[? ? ?|Infused Ink]] is needed. If refined or forged [[Inkstone]] comes into contact with a projectile fired from a Mysterious Mushroom, it will turn into Infused Ink.

For the special quest in obtaining a [[Fusion Coil]], an Infused Core is needed. If a [[Meteor core|Meteor Core]] comes into contact with a projectile fired from a Mysterious Mushroom, it will turn into an [[Infused Core]].

On other cases with normal trees, the projectile turned them into [[Corrupted]] wood - a general wood defined for all trees being hit (not just Mushroom, but every tree. Have tested with [[Palm]] tree)

== Gallery ==
<gallery>
Mysterious Mushrooms.png|Shooting
Mystery mush on ground.png|Growing on ground glitch
</gallery>

== Trivia ==
* Prior to the Oaklands map update, players used to be able to use the [[Grabby Grabber]] or the [[Grabbiest Grabber]] to easily reach the harder-to-reach Mysterious Mushrooms by "grabby-hopping" using a mushroom cap. Grabby-hopping has been removed in the Oaklands Map update, thus this method has become obsolete.
* The [[Gravity Coil]] can be used to retrieve lower-hanging mushrooms. When hit by a mushroom's projectile while holding the Gravity Coil, the anti-gravity effect caused by the projectile becomes much stronger.
* Refined or planked Mysterious Mushroom wood was the most valuable wood type in the game hitherto the introduction of [[Magma Tree|Magma]].
* Sanded Mysterious Mushroom wood is one of several sources of neon material in the game, alongside sanded [[Electrified Tree]], sanded [[Magma Tree|Magma]], all forms of  [[Electrified Bamboo|Electrified Bamboo,]] and forged [[Uranium]].
* There is a rare glitch whereby the Mysterious Mushrooms can grow from the ground. Due to weird spawning logic (and/or improper value which includes this), the mushrooms can spawn on the ground, flipping over time while growing; they stop when the lowest stem is fully grown. They still can be harvested as normally, only they are hidden inside the ground. This phenomenon can also happen when growing on the ceiling, except it's normal.
* The Mysterious Mushroom is one of three wood types that aren't made of wood, the other being [[Mushrooms]] and [[Kelp]].
* The Internal Name of the Mysterious Mushroom is called "AlienMushroom," which could be the reason why it glows a neon texture and grows on the ceiling.
* If the Mysterious Mushroom is hit once, it acts dormant and stops shooting. This can be very useful for grinding Mysterious Mushrooms.

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a logic component that can be purchased from [[Alan's AutoLogistics]]. It can play back a single musical note.

== Functionality ==
The Music Note plays a single note whenever a signal greater than 0 is applied to it. The signal sent to the Music Note determines the pitch that the note is played back at, with a maximum pitch at a signal value of 25. The Music Note does not sustain its note, and must have a signal constantly pulsed to it in order to approximate sustaining a note.

The instrument that the Music Note uses can be cycled by interacting with it. However, there is no indication as to what instrument is selected. The instruments are selected from the list as follows, wrapping around after the last instrument is selected:

* Piano
* Violin
* Brass
* Xylophone
* Woodblock
* Timpani
* Guitar

title: Neon Tube
wikitext:
"A neon tubing that provides a valuable source of light."
 {{Objects|image1= Neon Tube Boxed.png |Island=Ferwater Island |Shop=Illumine Designs |Price=$450 |Function=Decorational, Lightning}} ==Description== The Neon Tube is a glowing wire that supports logical brightness control. Instead of a simple on/off state, it responds to numerical logic values: * '''0''' — light is turned off * '''1–10''' — light is turned on, with brightness increasing gradually as the value rises This allows Neon Tubes to function as a '''brightness-controlled light source''', enabling smooth lighting effects, dimmers, indicators, and automated visual systems when connected to logic components. You can buy it at [[Illumine Designs|'''Illumine Designs''']] for $450. The placing system is the same as any other item that depends on some kind of wire. When placing Neon tubes know that: * They cannot be placed on non-solid surfaces. * The maximum node count for (1x) box of Neon Tubes is 15 nodes. [[Category:Schematics]] [[Category:Structures]]
