title: Oak
wikitext: {{Wood |image = Oakm.png|Tree Oak log.png|Log Image-removebg-preview (2).png|Sanded Oak Plank.png|Plank |Island = [[Finlay Island|Finlay]] |Hardness = 0.5 |Log = $1.14/stud |Sanded = $14/stud |Version Added = v1.0.0 |Date Added = 14/01/2023 |Status = Obtainable |Planked=$17.5/stud}} == [[File:Diamond_Main_Titles.png|75x75px]] Oak Tree == The '''Oak Tree''' is a tree found in [[Finlay Island]] and [[Ferwater Island]] at the ''Grasslands, Farlands,'' and the ''Savannah''. Other trees that can be found with this tree include [[Spruce]], [[Birch]], [[Red Maple]], and [[Acacia]]. Its characteristics include a medium-brown bark, green leaves, and a beige wood. Like all trees, ores, and rocks, the Oak Tree can be used for filling [[schematics]] and [[Blueprint Fabricator|blueprints]]. == [[File:Hexagon Dollar.png|50x50px]]Selling Price == The selling price of Oak trees (raw, sanded, and planked) can vary day to day. See the stock market located in the [[Resource Hub]] to see the exact price of Oak on a particular day. The price listed on the wiki is the default price for selling raw or processed Oak. * Logged (Raw) - $1.14/stud. * Sanded - $14/stud. * Planked - $17.5/stud. == [[File:Hexagon_Forage.png|50x50px]] Foraging == Oak Trees offer several forageable items, including the following: * [[Acorns]], common rarity, on Oak tree leaves. * [[Apple|Apples]], common rarity, on Oak tree leaves. * [[Agaric Mushrooms]], common rarity, on Oak tree bark. * [[Daedalea Mushrooms]], common rarity, on Oak tree bark. * [[Beehive|Beehives]], uncommon rarity, on Oak tree leaves. * [[Golden Apple|Golden Apples]], rare rarity, 1/1000 or 0.1% chance on Oak tree leaves. == Accessibility == Certain trees require specific conditions to obtain them, whether it be a specific axe or a weather condition. Detailed spawn conditions and other concerns (such as the relative difficulty of farming this tree) are also listed in the following: * Oak is a common rarity tree. * Can be logged using the [[Rusty Axe]] or higher. * Can be sanded using the [[Rusty Sander]] or higher. * Can be planked using the [[Steel Planker]] or higher. * Oak spawn conditions include the following: ** Oak trees must spawn on the surface. ** Oak trees must spawn on grass. ** Oak trees are localized to [[Finlay]], [[Flowering Meadows]], and the entrance to [[Ferwater]]. ** An Oak tree forest called "Mythril Forest" spawns Oak trees in large clusters; it is located in Finlay. == Textures == The various textures of the Oak Tree in its raw, sanded, and planked states. title: Oakmobile
wikitext:
{{Vehicles|image1= Oakmobile-V109.0.png|Unboxed File:Oakmobile.png|Unboxed-Old File:Boxed_Oakmobile.png|Boxed |Island=Finlay Island |Building=The Lighthouse |Price=$6,500 |Speed=101 studs/s |Version Added=v1.0 |Date Added=18/07/2023 |Status=Obtainable}}
''"BLUE SHELL NOT INCLUDED. 100 TOP SPEED. MUCH FAST. MUCH WOW."''
The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a vehicle that can be purchased from the [[Lighthouse]] for $6,500. It is a small runabout. == Details == Unlike other vehicles in the game, the Oakmobile has no cargo space to store wood. Instead, the Oakmobile has a bench seat that can seat four players (including driver). Additionally, the Oakmobile has its hitch on the front rather in the back. The Oakmobile used to have fastest top speed of any vehicle in the game at 101 studs/s, with no slowdown for going offroad. However, due to the vehicle's incredibly short wheelbase, the Oakmobile is incredibly unstable and will flip over with ease. It also has limited steering angle to prevent it from simply flipping over while turning under acceleration. Unusually, the player can grab the headrest of the Oakmobile, allowing the user to lift it and move it. This allows the user to unflip the Oakmobile at any time. It cannot be moved by a [[:Category:Grabbers|grabber]], however. == Trivia == * The Oakmobile used to be 125 stud/s originally, but the speed was lowered due to it mostly spinning out of control. ** The Oakmobile received a further patch to improve its stability by reducing its maximum steering angle and acceleration. * The Oakmobile is the only vehicle to have no cargo space, more than two seats, and a hitch on the front. * The Oakmobile's description contains a few references: ** "BLUE SHELL NOT INCLUDED" references the Blue Shell powerup from ''Mario Kart''. ** "MUCH FAST, MUCH WOW" references the Doge meme, in which a picture of a Shiba Inu dog is edited with grammatically incorrect phrases and sentences. * The hitch can be used on trailers and you can move by reversing, however its better to use the Sellner Explorer or the Joop grand Barrow for trailers *Using the gravity coil while on the Oakmobile makes a large diffrence in how it drives.. The car becomes bouncy and is hard to actually even drive. ** The car will bounce around, does a wheelie when you accelerate fowards, gets a bit more air time, and is just silly to use. ** If you run into a wall, it will flip on its side, possibly do a backflip, and then go on its side if you move. **Holding W will make it spin out eventually. It will not go straight, no matter what you do. *You can use the Oakmobile to find meteor crash sites, then hit each tree with your axe to claim ownership of all the trees that spawn in it. title: Number Interface
wikitext:
''"Allows you to input large numbers directly, outputting that number as the signal value."''
{{Logic|title={{PAGENAME}}|image= Number Interface.png|Unboxed Number Interface boxed.png|Boxed |Island=Finlay|Store=[[Alan's AutoLogistics]]|Cost=$520|Object=|Purpose=Generates a signal of arbitrary strength|Outputs=|Requires=[[Wire]]|Date Added=01/11/2023|Version Added=1.43.0|Status=Obtainable}} The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a logic component that can be purchased from [[Alan's AutoLogistics]]. It outputs a signal depending on what is entered into its interface. == Functionality == When placed, the Number Interface starts with a value of 1.0. Interacting with it allows the user to input any arbitrary positive whole number into the Number Interface. It will then output a signal of the same value on its output port. This allows the user to quickly generate large numbers for structures like the [[Electronic Billboard]] or [[14 Segment Display]], or to pack a decimal representation of a binary value for use with a [[Binary Output|Bit Out]].{{Logic Nav}}

''"Forged from the depths of below, this skull holds the darkest of sins, and grants the ability to walk on lava"''
== Description == The '''Obsidian Skull''' is available for purchase at the [[Magma Cave Shop]] situated within the depths of the [[Magma Caves]], priced at $200,000. When equipped, it grants the player the ability to walk on lava with a 45 second heat resistance. It also grants the ability to drive a car on lava, though this is substantially less useful as the car will immediately sink if the player exits. == Appearance == When equipped, the '''Obsidian Skull''' shows as a belt around the players waist with a [[skull]] serving as its buckle. The bands of the belt is metal, along with fire esc ornaments positioned on either side of the skull. == Trivia == * While wearing the Obsidian Skull, the player will hear an evil laugh while loading their save. * The Obsidian Skull is the fourth most expensive item, after Flamethrower, [[Nuclear Warhead]] and [[Glass Ducky|Glass ducky]]. * It was added to the game as a reward for hitting 2 million visits. 
**It was added back on June 28th for hitting 3 million visits, and was removed on July 3rd.
**It was added back on July 16th for hitting 4 million visits, and was removed on August 1st, 2023.
** It was again, added back on January 26th, 2024 for hitting 10 million visits, and removed on February 14th, 2024.
** It was added back on August 30th, 2024 for hitting 20 million visits, and Hoofer didnt give an ETA for when they will be removed.
**It was not confirmed if it is limited or not, but it most likely is due to its long removal periods.
**It was originally unobtainable unless trading with another player or waiting for another visit milestone to be hit, but has since become indefinitely obtainable on the dedicated classic area off the shore of [[Ferwater Island]].

Palladium ore can spawn on Ferwater island with chance 1/650 and is commonly found in the rock nodes of [[Beigeslate]], [[Limestone]], [[Blueslate]], [[Chalkyslate]], [[Terracotta]], [[Sandslate]], and [[Blackstone]].

Raw Palladium can be easily mistaken for Gold if not given a second glance. To see the difference, pay close attention to the brightness of the ore before mining, as Palladium is slightly darker than [[Gold]]. Otherwise, its appearance is much like Caramel - a golden brown color.

Like any other materials in the game, you can use refined and forged Palladium to complete schematics.

==Trivia==

*While [[Pyrite]] is what's known as "Fool's Gold" in real life, [[Gold]] and Palladium share the same node model and a very similar color. This makes [[Gold]] more likely to be confused with Palladium rather than with [[Pyrite]], whose model resembles more of a square.
*Palladium appears to be a combined [[Gold]] and [[Lithium]], but can also be considered a mix of [[Cobalt]] and [[Gold]].

== New information ==

* Palladium can now be found by breaking vases in Desert Temple, sublocation of Ferwater
* The refined variant of Palladium is now used in quests for getting Dune Devourer Helmet & Chestplate

The '''Pebble of Truth''' is an item purchasable from [[The Oak Depot]] for $565,656. ==Details== The Pebble of Truth is an intentionally cryptic item. The description is ciphertext, and the Pebble emits a quiet whispering sound. For those who wish to try to solve the mystery themselves, the rest of the details will be hidden in a spoiler section:
:'''⚠ WARNING! This section contains spoilers. Read at your own discretion.'''
The description of the Pebble of Truth is encrypted using a Caesar cipher, rotated 11 positions to the right. The actual description is as follows:
The whispers. . . They're everywhere. . . Only a shift in time may reveal when the true meaning will show. . .
( Edit: The clue is the words 'shift in time'. The duck shrine turns baby ducks into adult ducks which means it shifts time. ) While the description nor the whispers provide any hints as to where to take the Pebble of Truth, if taken to the [[Duck Shrine]] beneath the short arch bridge in [[Finlay Island|Finlay]]. The Duck Shrine emits the same whispers as the Pebble of Truth does. Placing the Pebble or [[Glass Ducky|Adult Glass Ducky]] there causes the shrine to begin charging up before letting out a massive explosion of energy, turning the Shrine's light red. The Pebble of Truth will not be consumed. The altar cannot be activated again by any other Pebble of Truth, but the same Pebble of Truth can be used to activate shrines in servers where it has not been activated. The '''Petalfall''' is an axe obtained through completing a puzzle involving multiple "flowers" (one is only classified as a flower in the game), It has a swing power bonus towards [[Sakura|Sakura Trees]].

==Details==
The Petalfall is obtained by placing 4 special, glowing eukaryotes ("flowers") (three flowers and one mushroom) inside temples around the flowering meadows.

It has a passive ability to fell sakura trees with one swing.

== Notes ==
The Petalfall Katana has a swing power of 0.7 making it only ever so slightly weaker than the Reinforced Axe with a 0.8 swing power, however, it's swing time being more than four times faster actually makes it significantly better than any other axe in the game excluding the [[Emberbane|emberbane]] because of it's ability to randomly strike a tree multiple times in one swing.

'''-- OUTDATED --'''

The [[Gravity Coil]] may be needed to obtain the axe.

You can go to Flowering meadows via Mike’s mines to avoid spending money on bombs.

==Obtaining ==
:''Notes:''
:* ''If all the flowers are owned by the same person, Petalfall will be in that player's ownership when it spawns. Otherwise, it will spawn with no owner and could potentially be stolen.''
:* ''*When the first Flower in one of the Towers it starts a timer of 15-20 minutes before all temples reset.''
Tutorial on how to get it linked below:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VYqpjV9hEj4 - OUTDATED

And the whole tutorial written here

Gather the '''four flowers''':
*The [[Blizzard Bloom]]
*The [[Tamed Mysterious Mushroom]]
*The [[Corpse Flower]]
*The [[Burning Blossom]]

With the flowers acquired, proceed to the next steps.

Go to the area around [[Flora Laura]] called the [[Flowering Meadows]]. Here you find 5 temples the 4 smaller ones are the ones you place the flowers. After placing a [[Flowers|Flower]] the top of the temple should show a purplish beam.
[[File:Ice flower temple.png|thumb|Blizzard Bloom temple]]

* Take the [[Blizzard Bloom]] to the beach area underneath the [[Flowering Meadows]]. You will find a waterfall, behind that there's a temple where you place the flower inside the bowl.

[[File:Purple Shroom Temple.png|thumb|188x188px|Tamed Mysterious Mushroom temple]]

* Next go up to the same level as [[Flora Laura]]. On a large rock which you can only climb by foot is the temple for the [[Tamed Mysterious Mushroom]]. Once again place the flower into the bowl and a purplish beam should emerge on top.

[[File:Corpse Flower temple.png|thumb|Corpse Flower temple]]

* For the third flower you drive to the other side of the valley staying on the same level as [[Flora Laura]]. The green temple is for the [[Corpse Flower]]. Drive over the rock bridge and up to the temple and place the [[Corpse Flower]] into the bowl. Another purplish beam should appear.



* The last flower is the [[Burning Blossom]]. I advise you to do this one last as driving down there will shake up your truck or force you to walk all the way around. 
** Jump WITH the flower to the same level as the temple, place the flower and reset to base <small>(''This is currently the least frustrating way some people found without extra tools).''</small>

[[File:Burning Blossom Temple.png|thumb|Burning Blossom temple]]







After all flowers have been placed they should disappear and the sword should appear in the brown temple at the highest peak of the [[Flowering Meadows]]. Pick it up from the same kind of bowl as you placed the flowers.[[File:Petalfall Spawn temple.png|thumb|The brown temple where the sword spawns|251x251px]]


:''Note: The temples have a cooldown which prevents the creation of multiple Petalfall Katanas in a short time. One may place as many flowers as they like in their respective temples, but only one set of flowers (one of each flower) will be consumed, and only one Petalfall will spawn - on an interval of fifteen minutes after the last Petalfall was spawned.



[[File:Petalfall Temple.png|thumb|Petalfall spawn|265x265px]]













[OUTDATED]
* Take the [[Blizzard Bloom]] and go to the tower near [[Flora Laura]]. There will be visible steps. Once on top place the flower inside the tower.
<gallery>
File:FirstPFTower.png
File:FirstPFTower1.png
</gallery>
*Take the [[Tamed Mysterious Mushroom]] and head to the cave. Near the entrance there should be a pink-broken piece of wall. Above it there's a hole in the ceiling. Climb the stone ledge with the mushroom, make your way to the top of the cave. Every jump should lead you higher and higher. Once on top, place the mushroom inside the tower.
**In Alpha Version 1.5.5, this was near impossible, as the cave would lead you out of bounds.
<gallery>

* Take the remaining flowers, and make your way to a pole with rope. To locate the pole head to Flora Laura from the cave but take the first turn to right, taking you of the brown path. Walk on the rope with both flowers, then take the incline to the left and take another rope. 
**Take the [[Burning Blossom]] and head underwater, there's a hole in the bottom. Once inside the room place the flower inside the tower.
<gallery>
File:ThirdPFTower.png
File:ThirdPFTower1.png
</gallery>
*Take the [[Corpse Flower]], and walk across the tightropes making your way to the mountain as shown below. Grab your corpse flower and then swim up the waterfall making your way to the shrine, then place it down.

title: Ownership Manager
wikitext:
<blockquote>''"Allows you to clear & transfer ownership of items! Providing a power input of 10.0 will clear the ownership of items, and providing a user id will transfer the ownership to that player."''<blockquote>
{{Logic
|Store=[[Alan's AutoLogistics]]
|Purpose=Transfers or removes ownership of items based on power input. Will only work with your own items.
|Version Added=idk man (1.65.0)
|Status=Obtainable
|title={{PAGENAME}}
|image=<gallery>Missing Image.png|Unboxed
Missing Image.png|Boxed
</gallery>
|Island=[[Finlay Island|Finlay]]
|Object=$100}}The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a logic component that can be purchased from [[Alan's AutoLogistics]]. It changes ownership of items.
==Functionality==
The Ownership Manager can remove ownership or transfer ownership of items freely, but only one at a time. The probe in front of it is purely decorational, as well as the case with the [[Interactor]], as you now select a range/area of an item that will have its ownership changed. However, to change or remove ownership of items in a range, any and all items within the range must be owned by you, either causing, or having the problem of it only being able to change the ownership of one item at a time(May change in a later update, not fixed as of 1.66.2). To remove ownership, the Ownership Manager requires a signal of 10.0.

However, to change ownership of an item to another player, the required signal must be the player ID of the player you wish to transfer item ownership to, making it very ineffective to change ownership to other players in this way, as it would require a number interface(orthodoxically).

==Trivia==
As Roblox IDs are 64 bit integers, this means that any accounts with a user ID that are, or greater than 10*10^14 or, 15 or more digits long, they will not be able to have ownership transferred to them, at least not very easily through the same number interface method, as number interfaces can only output 14 digits of signal, or, up to 999,999,999,999,999.

== Description ==
The '''Petrified Oak''' is a tree type that is found on '''Finlay'''. It's located at the waterfall southwest of the [[Lighthouse]].

Like any other material in the game, you can use logs, sanded, and planked Petrified Oak to complete '''schematics'''.

The '''Petrified Oak''' tree is a less common tree than the Birch trees but are easy to find. It's distinctive by the leaves and wood being darker than the '''Oak''' tree.

Once cut down, you can sell the log for '''$2 per stud.''' If you use the saw or a sander, you will create the sanded version of the wood which sells for '''$24.4 per stud.''' You can also use a Planker to get the '''Planked''' version, which sells for '''$30.5 per stud.'''

This tree type is ideal for '''building''', due to its ability to obtain compared to its sell price.

Like any other material in the game, you can use logs, sanded, and planked Petrified Oak to complete '''schematics'''. 

== Trivia ==
* The petrified oaks are the hardest trees to cut down on the [[Finlay Island|Finlay]] island, taking less than a six full swings to cut down by the base via [[Tall Refined Axe]].

}}'''Pyrite''' can spawn in '''[[Lightslate]]''', '''[[Beigeslate]]''', '''[[Darkslate]]''', '''[[Blueslate]]''', and '''[[Limestone]].''' 

The raw form of '''Pyrite''' takes on a darker yellow color that '''could''' be mistaken for '''[[Gold]]''', which is '''much''' more valuable. 

Putting '''Pyrite''' in a '''refinery''' raises the sell price to '''$22/stud'''. Putting that '''refined Pyrite''' through a '''forge''' further increases the price to '''$24/stud'''.

Like '''every''' other '''material''' in the game, you can use '''refined''' and '''forged''' '''Pyrite''' to complete '''[[Schematics]]'''.
== Trivia ==
*Because of its similarity in appearance to '''[[Gold]]''', in real life and in game, '''Pyrite''' has been titled "'''Fool's [[Gold]]'''".
*To remember the difference between '''Pyrite''' and '''[[Gold]]''', '''[[Gold]]''' is in a nugget-like shape and '''Pyrite''' is cubical.
*Even if it's '''refined''' or '''forged''', '''Pyrite''' looks almost exactly like '''[[Gold]]''', and the only difference is that '''[[Gold]]''' is darker in tone than '''Pyrite'''. 
*In the real-life gold rush, People often tricked other gold buyers by giving them '''Pyrite''' instead of '''[[Gold]]''' because of the resemblance. With the victim thinking it is real gold and, in the end, getting scammed.

title: Property
wikitext:
== Description ==

=== Ground ===
The Property is the Piece of land every player gets when they start a save, it allows players to customize their property by giving them the ability to use [[Schematics]] to build whatever the players can dream.

The Property starts off very small and players need to work hard to earn money to upgrade the size of it. 

It costs $450/stud to expand up to a maximum expansion of 165 studs, costing $74,250 in total. The maximum size is currently 200 studs. 

=== Basement ===
The basement is an extension to the property that can be purchased for $125,000 (you can also get free basements on all slots with a gamepass). It adds a basement with the same footprint as the ground level. The basement is 120 studs deep measured from ground level to the bottom, with 104 studs of vertical height from the basement roof to the bottom. The entrance to the basement can be edited in the Edit Property menu using the “Edit Entrance” button.

The combined price of the maximum expansion and the basement is $199,250, or $200k.

|Status = Obtainable}}The '''Red Maple''' tree is a tree found in [[Finlay Island]] at the ''Grasslands'' and ''Farlands.'' Other trees that can be found with this tree include [[Spruce]], [[Birch]], and [[Oak]]. Its characteristics include a red-purple bark, red leaves, and a pale beige inside. The Red Maple tree cannot spawn fruit.

The raw form of this tree will sell for '''$1.2''' per stud. Once sanded, it sells for '''$13.22''' per stud. If it is planked it will sell for '''$16.53'''. Due to the market updates, these values may change day-to-day. Make sure to check the market at the [[Resource Hub]] in game for current pricing.

Like all trees, ores, and rocks, the Red Maple tree can be used for filling [[schematics]] and [[Blueprint Fabricator|blueprints]].

== Obtaining ==
Red maple can be cut or mined using a rusty axe or any higher-quality tool. It requires '''4 swings''' with a rusty axe, '''2 swings''' with a steel axe,                                                                                                                                                                        '''2 swings''' with a refined axe, and only '''1 swing''' with a celestial hammer or a reinforced axe. 

For processing, it requires a rusty sander or a steel planker or higher.

- This tree can be considered common due to the difficulty level of obtaining.

- The Red Maple tree is one of the base game tree types.

- The Red Maple tree is heavier than the average tree. It may need to be dragged and/or picked up using the [[Grabby Grabber]] or the [[Grabbiest Grabber]].

- The Red Maple tree stands roughly 25-31 studs tall, slightly taller than the Oak tree on average.{{Wood Nav}}

[[File:Planked Rainbow Wood.png|thumb|266x266px|Planked Rainbow Wood]]
The '''Rainbow Tree''' is a tree added during the [[Update Log|2025 April Fools update]], and was removed 7 days later. The tree requires dynamite to cut it down. It can prove to be a challenge to gather as its gravity is inverted. The only way to make the gravity of the wood normal is to plank it, however the wood loses it's rainbow color when sanded or planked and turns white.

* This tree was available from 4/1/2025 Until 4/7/2025.
* It is impossible to cut this tree with any axe, you must use dynamite to cut it down.
* The tree's Gravity is inverted to regular Trees

title: Refined Axe
wikitext:
{{Axe|image1= Tallrefinedaxe.png|Unboxed tallrefinedaxebox.png|Boxed GTRA.png|Legacy |Island=Finlay |Shop=[[The Oak Depot]] |Swing Power=0.5 |Swing Distance=15 Studs |Swing Time=1.75 |Price=$21,000 |Version Added=1.1.0 |Date Added=17/1/23 |Status=Purchasable}}
''"After many months of hard work, the axe was finally completed. Eron named it the "Tall Refined axe," (later mistranslated to Refined Axe) and it was truly a work of art. The axe has a long, slender handle made of the strongest fiberglass, and a blade forged from the rarest steel."''
The {{PAGENAME}} is an axe that is sold at [[The Oak Depot]]. It can be bought for $21,000. While it has no special abilities, it is a powerful axe. == Description == The Refined Axe is a tall hatchet with a headpiece made out of steel, using the default legacy metal material for its appearance. The handle is made of wood that has been painted blue, and a rubber grip at the bottom of the handle. The Refined Axe has a swing power of 0.5, which the second most powerful axe available for purchase. == Trivia == *When first being added, it was advertised as being a limited time item only, being sold for only 2 days with a ridiculous price tag of $80,000. It went off-sale before returning a few days later: this iteration was hidden on a glass stand without its box, and was being sold for approximately $20,000. Later it was stolen by [[Jerry Junkman|Jerry]] and taken to [[Jer's Junkyard]] with another price change to $40,340, only to later be brought back to [[The Oak Depot]]. In the first Secret Friday Update, the Refined Axe was boxed once more, and the original boxed version has turned golden. With this, the price changed to $8,450, where it has remained since. *The Refined Axe is based on a real [https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/307284025205194762/1132109810721095770/image.png Kobalt axe] that Kinder had laying in his garage. '''Refined Chisel''' is a third tier chisel, being sold on the shelf by the entrance of [[The Oak Depot]] for $5,000. 

Chisels are tools used to slice refined and forged ores into pieces and shave rocks to fit into processors. Do note, that shaving will reduce yield of the ore/rock, so it's advised to save them to be processed in a bigger machine later.

== Appearance ==
'''Refined Chisel''', like the name implies, is a typical looking chisel made out of refined steel and wood. It's blade is made out of refined steel; using the default legacy metal material as it's coating. It's handle is made out of wood, painted blue; using the default legacy sand material as it's coating.
== Trivia ==
* Chisels are the only tools that do not have their stats listed in their descriptions, probably due to to the fact different tiers of chisels only vary in speed they can slice/shave an ore.
* '''Refined Chisel''' was added significantly later than [[Tall Refined Axe|Refined Axe]] and [[Tall Refined Pickaxe|Refined Pickaxe]].

title: Relay
wikitext:
''"When the right input is higher than 0.0, the output will be the left input value."''
{{Logic |title={{PAGENAME}} |image= Relay.png|Unboxed Relay boxed.png|Boxed |Island=Finlay |Store=[[Alan's AutoLogistics]] |Cost=$550 |Object= |Purpose=Allows a signal to pass if another signal activates it |Outputs= |Requires=[[Wire]] |Date Added=01/11/2023 |Version Added=1.43.0 |Status=Obtainable}} The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a logic component that can be purchased from [[Alan's AutoLogistics]]. It outputs one input signal when the other input is enabled. == Functionality == The Relay is used to activate to send one signal ONLY when both inputs have a signal. By using a number interface (Num Int) a relay can be solely used to change signal strength. This means that you can use signals other than 0 and 10. On the side with two ports, the left input is used as the signal that will be passed through the relay. The right input is used to activate the left input's signal’s output. File:Relay guide.svg|A guide on how to interpret the Relay. File:RELAYComponent.png|The RELAYComponent, as seen when beta testing the Logic system. {{Logic Nav}}

wikitext:
{{NPC|Island=[[Finlay Island]]|Building=[[Resource Hub]]|Version Added=1.60.0|image=rej-junkman.png}}

== Description ==
Rej Junkman is an NPC who expands your land in your property. He can be found in the [[Resource Hub]]. 

== Appearance ==
Rej's appearance is the same as [[Jer Junkman]], albeit with different clothing. He has yellow sunglasses, a black cap, a stopwatch and a tuxedo, unlike [[Jer Junkman]] which wears overalls.

== Dialogue ==
"Buy land here, right now!" - interaction prompt

When interacted with:

* "Hey, I'm Rej. Do you want to buy some property?"
** Okay! (enters expand property menu)
** No, thank you. (leaves conversation)

== Trivia ==

* Rej's name is [[Jer Junkman|Jer's]] name backwards.
** This could imply that Rej Junkman is some sort of doppelganger to [[Jer Junkman]].
* In theory, Rej, [[Jer Junkman|Jer]] and [[Jerry Junkman|Jerry]] Junkman could be siblings.
* As of now, Rej Junkman is practically useless, as you can expand land using the Build Menu.

The '''Resource Hub''' is a primary location and an important aspect of gameplay. Speaking to [[Jer Junkman]] will allow the player to sell any of their resources that they have placed within the checkered yellow lines for convenience. Selling your goods in the fireplaces located on either side of the Resource Hub avoids this tax. Speaking to Rej Junkman will allow the player to expand their property and buy [[Property|basement]] for $125,000.

Material prices in the game dynamically update every '''6 hours (00:00, 6:00, 12:00, 18:00 EST)''' according to the in-game stock market. If a large number of players sell a particular material, the increased supply causes its price to drop. For the list of in-game materials can be sell click [[Resource Hub (Material list)|here]].

title: River Shop
wikitext:
{{Buildings|image1=River_Shop.png|NPC=Lumi Laurence|Version Added=v1.51.0|Date Added=01/03/2024}}
The '''River Shop''' is a store located in the [[River Caves]].

==Description==
Rather than dealing directly in cash, the shopkeeper [[Lumi Laurence]] deals in Lumite Credits. This currency is earned by bringing '''raw''' pieces of [[Lumite]] to the exchange station and talking to [[Lumi Laurence|Lumi]], who will buy each piece of Lumite in exchange for 1 Lumite Credit.

Lumi sells items that are mostly related to improving the player's ability to harvest resources from the River Caves.

The River Shop is found by going in the River Cave and following the middle path upstream relative to the entrance from the main waterfall. Following the route will lead to a visible hidden entrance behind the waterfall with fluorescent clusters of Lumite crystals.

At the top of the desert cave, also reachable from the River Cave, in the water, there's a side cave that'll also lead directly into the River Shop.

== Description ==
The '''River Caves''' are between [[Ferwater Island|Ferwater]] and [[Finlay Island|Finlay]].
They are characterized by its thick fog. Along with the other River biomes, it is accessible via explodable walls right after the curved bridge leading to another section of [[Finlay Island]] or also accessible via big waterfall to the right of the [[Bridge]] that leads to [[Ferwater Island]].

There is a [[Lab]] , a [[River Shop]] and a possible [[Pirate Boat]] spawn.

== Resources ==

* [[Prismarine]] nodes , found on land.
* [[Blue Clay]], [[Red Clay]], [[Brown Clay]] nodes , found in water.
* [[Lumite]] nodes , found in prismarine.
* [[Plek]] , found in a smaller seperate cave in an underwater section , near the [[River Shop]]
* In one of the fishing sneak peeks on Discord, Hoofer displayed a fish being caught with the name Stone fish. It had a stone texture.

title: Ribmaul
wikitext:
{{Objects|image1=Ribmaul.png|Function=Weapon used to attack Goblins or Skeletons.|Version Added=1.75|optionalTitle=Ribmaul}} == Ribmaul == The '''Ribmaul''' is a weapon that can be found in the [[Acidlands]], it can be used to fight mobs and drops exclusively from the [[Skeleton King]]. The attack is similar to that of the [[Rust Breaker|Rust breaker]] with heavy knockback and damage but a high cooldown, it deals slightly more damage. The large size of the weapon makes it great for clearing swarms of mobs quickly. Although the drop chance is unknown it's estimated to have a drop chance of about 20%. Or about 1 in 5 kills (1/5). Similar to that of the [[BIG Skull]]. == Trivia ==
-It is the largest weapon added to the game so far.
-Due to the other items dropped from the [[Skeleton King]] such as [[BIG Bone|BIG Bones]], [[BIG Skull|BIG Skulls]], and [[Acid Crown|Acid Crowns]] it can be a decent source of income, especially if one sells the Ribmaul, [[Skull|BIG skulls]], [[Acid Crown|Acid Crowns]] and other [[skeleton]] drops to other players or as a side income while trying to get [[Trophies|Skeleon Trophies]]

title: Rusted Piercer
wikitext:
''"A bow so old even skeletons remember its glory days. Still deadly."''{{Objects|Island=Acidlands|Shop=Goblin Town Shop|Price=$36,000|Function=weapon|image1=Rusted Piercer.png}}The Rusted Piercer is a Ranged weapon, it a metal bow and arrow that deals moderate damage to a singular enemy, it can be bought from the [[Goblin Town Shop]] in the [[Acidlands]] after [[The Arena]] has been defeated

== Tips ==
-It can be an effective weapon for fighting the [[Skeleton King|King Skeleton]] due its slow speed and the bows range and damage

-like all ranged weapons the Rusted Piercer will Automatically lock on to nearby enemies, this can be harmful when wanting to deal with a specific target

title: Rock Candy
wikitext:
== Description == The '''Rock Candy''' is a holiday rock that spawns during the '''2025 Christmas Event''', inside [[Mike's Mines]] and near the [[Lost Woods]]1. As they are a seasonal rock, they may be sold for the seasonal currency, '''Snowflakes (❄️)'''. They '''do not''' sell for cash. The Rock Candy appears in two variants: '''Purple Rock Candy''' and '''Yellow Rock Candy'''. The variants are identical in functionality, with the latter being slightly more expensive. [[File:Rock Candy Transparency.png|alt=An image of Lightslate placed behind three chunks of Yellow Rock Candy. Raw (Left), Refined (Middle), and Forged (Right).|thumb|Lightslate placed behind Rock Candy to demonstrate transparency]]Rock Candy is also '''transparent in all forms''', with the transparency decreasing as the rock is processed. It is the most transparent when Raw, and the least transparent when Forged. This transparency also carries over to blueprints. {{Clear}} Unlike other nodes, Rock Candy may also form in a tall cluster of interlocking cubes, rather than a standard cluster, making it easier to spot in darkness. Rock Candy is currently '''unobtainable''' naturally, and may only be obtained by trading with another player, or, another Christmas event occurs, re-adding Rock Candy nodes. == Variants == === Yellow Rock Candy === {{Stone |image = File:Yellow Rock Candy (Raw).png|Stone File:Yellow Rock Candy (Refined).png|Refined File:Yellow Rock Candy (Forged).png|Forged File:Yellow Rock Candy (Node).png|Node |Stone = $37.4 ❄️/stud |Refined = ~$34 ❄️/stud |Forged = ~$37 ❄️/stud |Version Added = v1.97.5 |Date Added = ? |Status = Obtainable |Island=Finlay}} '''Yellow Rock Candy''' is the yellow-coloured variant of Rock Candy. It is worth slightly more per stud than its purple counterpart. {{Clear}} === Purple Rock Candy === {{Stone |image = File:Purple Rock Candy (Raw).png|Stone File:Purple Rock Candy (Refined).png|Refined File:Purple Rock Candy (Forged).png|Forged File:Purple Rock Candy Node.png|Node |Stone = $33.8 ❄️/stud |Refined = ~$31 ❄️/stud |Forged = ~$34 ❄️/stud |Version Added = v1.97.5 |Date Added = ? |Status = Obtainable |Island=Finlay}} '''Purple Rock Candy''' is the purple-coloured variant of Rock Candy. It is worth slightly less per stud than its yellow counterpart. {{Clear}} == Notes == * It is recommended to sell the candy raw as the increase in price when forged is minimal and the process is simpler and quicker. * Ores will not spawn in the Rock Candy. * A full semi-truck (Freyliner Transporter) of Raw Yellow Rock Candy sells for about $60,000 ❄️.2 * Due to the fact the Rock Candy is transparent, a Grabby/Grabbiest Grabber's field can clip through, creating a transparent region. {| class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" !See the image below for an example |- |[[File:Rock Candy & Grabby Grabber Field.jpg|thumb]] |} 1 - User 'ImCubeNotBall' mentioned the fact it spawns near the Lost Woods on another page.
2 - User 'Pou2.001' mentioned this on another page. It hasn't been verified. {{Stone Nav}} [[Category:Stone]] [[Category:Limited]] [[Category:Events]]

title: Root Froot
wikitext:
== '''''Description''''' ==
{{Objects|image1=Root.png|Island=Ferwater Island (River Cave)|Function=Grants Levitation for 7 - 10 seconds.|Version Added=Version 118.0 on May 30, 2026|optionalTitle=Raw and Jammed Root Froot}}
'''''<nowiki>''Can be eaten for a short levitation effect.''</nowiki>'''''

'''Root Froot''' is a consumable in ''Oaklands''. It is primarily gathered to create preserves or used directly for its '''unique mobility effects'''.

== ''Spawning & Location'' ==
Found underground within the [[Lumite]] and [[River Caves|River Cave]] networks.

* Grows exclusively on the branches of '''Root Trees.'''

* A single Root Tree spawns between '''1 and 10''' individual Root Froots.

* Regrows over time along with tree node resets.

== ''Economics & Processing'' ==

* $180 when sold raw.
* $720 when processed in a Canning Station.
* Processing Root Froot into jams offers one of the highest profit multipliers. (4x raw value)

== ''Player Effects & Gameplay Use'' ==

* '''Raw Consumption''' Grants a short '''Levitation''' effect when the player jumps, lasting roughly 7 to 10 seconds.
* '''Jarred Consumption''' Grants an extended '''Air Swimming''' effect, allowing vertical and horizontal directional movement through the air for approximately 40 seconds.

== Notes(cons&pros) ==

* It is not worth to grind it for money.
* It's difficult to acquire at first, but once you get it, it's easy.
* Levitation is good for collecting [[Celestial Blossom]].
* Jam version is an early-stage plane/helicopter for flying but its slow.

Sand ore can uniquely spawn in [[Sandstone]] nodes. Sand ore can spawn on the beaches of [[Finlay|Finlay Island]].

The raw form of Sand takes on a yellow color similar to [[Sandstone]].

Putting sand into a refiner will raise the sell price to $22 per stud. Putting that refined Sand through a forge will further raise the sell price to $24 per stud and create clear glass.

Like any other materials in the game, you can use sand and glass to complete schematics.

== Trivia ==

* Sand is the only ore to spawn in [[Sandstone]] nodes.

{{Vehicles |image1= Rusty-Putter-UNBOXED-V109.0.png|Unboxed Rusty-Putter-UNBOXED.png|Unboxed-Old Rusty-Putter-BOXED.png|Boxed | Island=Finlay | Building=The Lighthouse | Price=$50 | Speed=54-55 Stud/s (Base on when it bump) | Version Added=v1.0.0 | Date Added=14/01/2023 | Status=Available }}
"It may be missing a few bolts and be slightly unsafe for driving, but it'll get you to where you need to go (slowly)." -The ingame description.
== Description == The '''Rusty Putter''' is a vehicle that can be bought at [[Lighthouse|The Lighthouse]] for $50. It used to be the beginner vehicle when starting the game until it was replaced by the [[Rusty Joop Barrow]]. == Trivia == * This is the cheapest vehicle that can be bought ingame. * It is also the slowest, bumpiest (unstable) vehicle in the game and has the least usable storage. * This vehicle can be often buggy. * Unless you lose your starter vehicle, there is absolutely no reason to use this vehicle for everyday use unless you want to suffer. [[Category:Vehicles]]

==Description==
The '''Rusty Forge''' is the first obtainable tier of forges. It can be found and purchased at [[The Oak Depot]]. It is used to smelt refined ores/rocks (which can be done through a refinery) into forged ingots/rocks by putting them through its conveyor. 

== Appearance ==
The forge appears to be rusty (as the name may suggest) and bears a slight resemblance to the sawmill from Lumber Tycoon 2, another game of a similar genre.

==Trivia==
*The forge bears a faint resemblance to the Sawmill from Lumber Tycoon 2.
*The only ore not to increase in value if put through it is [[Magnetite]].
[[Category:Structures]]

title: Rusty Sander
wikitext:
''" Used for turning logs into a milled form, the automated handsaw! "'' - Item description
{{Objects |image1= Rustysander.png|Unboxed Rustysanderbox.png|Boxed | Island=Finlay | Shop=The Oak Depot | Price=$2,500 | Function=Removes bark from wood | Version Added=v1.0.0 | Date Added=14/01/2023 | Status=Obtainable }} == Description == The Rusty Sander is the first obtainable tier of sanders in-game. It turns normal wood into sanded wood by removing its bark. Compared to the higher tiers of sanders in the game, it can only sand small pieces of wood. == Appearance == As the name may suggest, the rusty sander appears to be rusty and damaged, with a tan sanding pad and six individual sprinklers Blasting Sand. == Description ==
The '''Rusty Refinery''' is the first obtainable tier of refineries. It can be found and purchased at [[The Oak Depot]], in the basement. It is used to smelt raw ores/rocks into refined ores/rocks by putting them through its conveyor. Some ores/rocks will not fit through, so a [[Rusty Chisel|Rusty]], [[Steel Chisel|Steel]], or [[Refined Chisel|Refined]] Chisel may be needed.  

The description says: Used for processing ores into refined material!  

==Appearance==
A rusty and damaged refinery that has holes boarded up by wood and metal.

==Trivia==
*This is the smallest and cheapest refinery in-game.
*If an object blocking the output, it will not produce (same with forgers and plankers).
**During blockage it will save entered materials (the amount of them is shown in stat info menu), after removing blockage it will produce all queued materials from first entered to last entered.
[[Category:Structures]]

title: Rusty Axe

''"It's definitely better than a wooden one, that's for sure"''
{{Axe |image1= Rusty-Axe-UNBOXED.png|Unboxed Rusty-Axe-BOXED.png|Boxed |Island=Finlay |Shop=The Oak Depot |Swing Power=0.24 |Swing Distance=12 studs |Swing Time=0.85 |Price=$390 |Version Added=v1.0.0 |Date Added=14/0/2023 }} ==Description== Rusty Axe is an axe that players start with when creating a fresh save. It's the second worst axe in the game, being also sold in basement of [[The Oak Depot]] for $390. == Appearance== Rusty axe is acting as an improvised grip, while being made out of typical yellow wood, using the default legacy wood material. ==Trivia == *The Rusty Axe replaced the [[Wooden Axe]] as the best axe. * A Rusty Axe can be found at [[Mike's Mines]] but cannot be picked up and bought. * The Rusty Axe can also be found on stumps. title: Rusty Pickaxe
wikitext:
''"A somewhat unreliable pickaxe."''
{{Pickaxe |image1= Rusty-Pickaxe-UNBOXED.png|Unboxed Rusty-Pickaxe-BOXED.png|Boxed |Island=Finlay |Shop=The Oak Depot |Swing Power=0.2 |Swing Distance=12 Studs |Swing Time=1 |AOE Distance=1.25 Studs |Price=$960 |Version Added=Pre-release |Status=Available }}==Description== '''Rusty Pickaxe''' is a pickaxe that new players have to buy in order to progress with the tutorial. It's the worst pickaxe in the game, being also sold on the shelf by the entrance of [[The Oak Depot]]. ==Appearance== '''Rusty pickaxe''' is a short sized pick, showing signs of minor damage. It's headpiece is clearly corroded, using the default legacy rust material. It's handle is covered in old bandages acting as an improvised grip, while being made out of typical brown yellowish wood, using the default legacy wood material. == Trivia == *Initially, player started off with a [[Wooden Axe]] and a [[Rusty Putter]]. Only after the 1.27.0 update, new players would start with a set of a [[Rusty Axe]] and a [[Rusty Saw]], being then directed by the tutorial to buy a '''Rusty Pickaxe''' as well. *In early pre-release, players could buy a [[Stone Pickaxe]], alongside other "starter" tools. These being: [[Wooden Chisel]], [[Wooden Saw]] and [[Wooden Axe]]. Only the latter would ever see the release. [[Category:Tools]] [[Category:Pickaxes]]

title: Rusty Saw
wikitext:
''"Can be used to remove bark of logs, NOTE: LOGS MAY HAVE TO BE CUT UP"''
{{Saw |image1= Rusty_Saw.png|Unboxed Rusty_Saw_Boxed.png|Boxed | Island=Finlay | Shop=The Oak Depot | Saw Distance=15 Studs | Loop Range=3 | Version Added=Pre-release | Status=Obtainable |Price=$90}} ==Description== '''Rusty Saw''' is the saw that players start with when creating a fresh save. It's the worst saw in the game, being also sold on the shelf by the entrance of [[The Oak Depot]] for $90. Saws are tools used to cut off the bark of trees, increasing their price. Essentially, '''Rusty Saw''' is a worse handheld version of [[Rusty Sander]]. == Appearance == '''Rusty Saw''', like the name implies, is a typical looking saw with noticeable signs of corrosion present on it's blade. It's handle is made out of the same wood other rusty tools use for their handles. Blade is gray in color with the default legacy rust material applied to it. Handle is using a brown yellowish coloring, having the default legacy wood material applied. == Trivia == * Initially, player started off with a [[Wooden Axe]] and a [[Rusty Putter]]. Only after the 1.27.0 update, new players would start with a set of a [[Rusty Axe]] and a '''Rusty Saw''' * In early pre-release, players could buy a [[Wooden Saw]], alongside other "starter" tools. These being: [[Wooden Chisel]], [[Stone Pickaxe]] and [[Wooden Axe]]. Only the latter would ever see the release. [[Category:Tools]] [[Category:Saws]]

title: Rusty Chisel
wikitext:
''"Used for slicing refined and forged ores into pieces, and can shave your rocks to fit them into smaller processors."''
{{Chisel template|image1= Rusty Chisel.png|Unboxed BoxedRustyChisel.png|Boxed |Island=Finlay|Shop=The Oak Depot|Price=$727|Version Added=1.0|Date Added=?|Status=Obtainable}} == Description == Rusty Chisel is a chisel new players recieve while going through the tutorial. It's the worst chisel in the game, being also sold on the shelf by the entrance of [[The Oak Depot]] for $727. Chisels are tools used to slice refined and forged ores into pieces and shave rocks to fit into processors. Do note, that shaving will reduce yield of the ore/rock, so it's advised to save them to be processed in a bigger machine later == Appearance == '''Rusty Chisel''', like the name implies, is a typical looking chisel with noticeable signs of corrosion present on it's blade. It's handle is made out of the same wood other rusty tools use for their handles. Blade is gray in color with the default legacy rust material applied to it. Handle is using a brown yellowish coloring, having the default legacy wood material applied. == Trivia == * Chisels are the only tools that do not have their stats listed in their descriptions, probably due to to the fact different tiers of chisels only vary in speed they can slice/shave an ore. * For one update, Rusty Chisel, [[Rusty Refinery]], [[Rusty Axe]] and [[Rusty Pickaxe]] were found in the basement of [[The Oak Depot]]. This was changed due to players getting confused. [[Category:Tools]] [[Category:Chisels]]

title: Sellner Explorer
wikitext:
{{Vehicles|image1= Sellner Explorer Unboxed V109.0.png|Unboxed Sellner Explorer Unboxed.png|Unboxed-Old Sellner Explorer.png|Boxed Sellner-explorer-new.png|Unboxed-Older |Island=Finlay |Building=The Oak Depot |Price=$27,000 |Speed=81 studs/s |Version Added=1.3.0 |Date Added=11/02/2023 |Status=Obtainable}}
''All you could ever need for spacious storage! Beautiful oak planks for holding up all your resources.''
The '''Sellner Explorer''' is a vehicle that can be purchased from [[The Oak Depot]] for $27,000. It is a large heavy-duty pickup truck. == Details == The Sellner Explorer is a vehicle well suited for hauling cargo. Its bed measures 7 by 14 studs, with the guards on the side having a depth of 5 studs. However, the tailgate is only 2 studs tall. Unlike other vehicles, the Explorer is virtually unaffected by going off-road, while still maintaining a relatively high speed at all times. Only the [[Oakmobile]] consistently outspeeds the Explorer. The Explorer comes in a total of 24 colors; 12 common and 12 rare. The common colors include pink, black, gray, purple, bronze, teal, turquoise, sand yellow, olive green, sage green, dark gray, light gray. The rare colors include white, vibrant red, gold/orange, Pyrite yellow, lime green, vibrant green, cyan, vibrant light blue, vibrant blue, vibrant purple, Magnetite purple, and cherry red/pink. All the common colors possess equal rarity, as do the rare colors; however, unboxing a rare color possesses a 1 in 100 chance. Additionally, there are neon variants of both the common and rare colors. Unboxing a neon common color possesses a 1 in 10,000 chance, and unboxing a neon rare color a 1 in 1,000,000 chance. The Explorer's spawn pad measures 31 by 0.65 by 15 studs. == Trivia == * Prior to v1.52.0, the Explorer was $18,025 * In v1.52.0, the Explorer was $36,050 * In v1.54.3, the Explorer's model changed. * An Explorer can be found sunken in a lake in Ferwater near where the [[Pirate Boat]] spawns. [[Category:Vehicles]]

The Secret Shack can be accessed by climbing one of the spikes located in [[Acid Wastes]] biome.

Touching it results in obtaining the "⬟ A Familiar Place" badge.

== Appearance ==
Secret Shack is a small booth with a shelf, a kicked down door, a rusted golden axe, and a shriveled up potted cacti housed inside. Before the map revamp, it also contained a rubber duckie nearby. It was once located on the [[Familiar Island]], but after the map revamp, it got impaled atop one of the spikes in the [[Acid Wastes]].

* This shack is a reference to the previous Typical Developers project called Woodmill Inc.

title: Sequoia Burl
wikitext:
[[Burls]] are a sub-resource of trees. '''Sequoia Burls''' rarely spawn on [[Sequoia|Sequoia Trees]]. title: Skull
wikitext:
''“Wow! That must've costed a fortune. 💀💀💀”''
{{Objects| image1= Skull.png|Normal redskull.png|Burnt |Island=Ferwater |Shop=The Skull Rock |Price=$3,000 (In small bombs) $1,200 (In Large bomb) |Function=Emberbane axe quest |Version Added=v1.25.0, v1.46.0 for burnt |Date Added=14/07/2023 |Status=Obtainable |Sell Price=250$ At both states.}} The '''Skull''' is a quest object. It can be obtained from the top of [[Skull Rock]] by destroying the hatch using explosives (3 [[Small Bomb|small bombs]]). You can also obtain it at the acidlands by killing some skeletons, with a still not confirmed drop rate. it sells for 250$ being burnt or not, at the resource hub. It also could be obtained from the '''2024 Halloween event''' from the blood moon event. == Details == The Skull, in its initial state, is simply a decorative object. However, if taken down to the [[Magma Caves]] and left near a heat source, the Skull will begin to burn. As it burns, it turns a deeper, darker shade of red, until it has completely burnt. At this point, the skull will emit a black flame particle and be renamed the '''Burning Skull'''. This can take a variable amount of time, usually about 5-10 minutes, which can greatly increase if the server is lagging. The Burning Skull is used to acquire the [[Emberbane]]; should a player wish to acquire the Burning Skull, it is best to check the object to see if it is making progress, or if the name has changed. == Gallery == Festive skull.png|The Skull during December 2023. title: Sign
wikitext:
Wowee, that's a load of text! This sign supports '''rich text'''!
{{Schematics |image1= Sing_Schematic.png|Boxed Signs without materials.png|Placed Signs with materials.png|Filled |Island=Finley, Ferwater |Shop=[[The Oak Depot]], [[Illumine Designs]] |Price=$340 |Version Added=? |Date Added=? |Status=Obtainable}} The '''Sign''' is a schematic that can be purchased from [[The Oak Depot]] or [[Illumine Designs]]. It is a block that can show text. == Functionality == Until the schematic is completely filled, the Sign will only display placeholder text that says "Fill me with material to edit text", instructing the user to fill the schematic with a material in order to edit the text. The text on the Sign will always attempt to fill the sign completely to its edges. Once filled, the Sign will be auto-filled with "This is some text!" as a placeholder. A player with the correct permissions can edit the sign, and set the text to whatever they want. Signs support a subset of [https://create.roblox.com/docs/en-us/ui/rich-text#supported-tags Roblox's rich text formatting][[Version 1.2.0#Changes: 6]]. For details on how to use Rich Text in signs, go to [[Sign Text Formatting]]. [[Category:Schematics]]

You can get the King sitting in a vehicle, which will prevent it from moving (In latest versions, he is capable of "jumping" out).

You can stand on the other side of a vehicle, and he won't be able to hit you, while you can still hit him.
You can stand on one of the nearby pillars and shoot at him from range.

The Skeleton King can also drop a "[[Ribmaul]]", roughly 20% of the time. 

The Skeleton King can also drop a "[[BIG Skull]]", roughly 10% of the time.

There can sometimes be two Kings at once.

title: Sign Text Formatting
wikitext: This page is for '''Sign''' Text Formatting. For '''Speakers''', go to [[Speaker Text Formatting]]. == About == Rich text tags are similar to XML/HTML tags where you must include both an opening and closing tag around the text. These allow you to change the font style, type, color, and more, and allow for more diverse and interesting [[Sign|Signs]] on your plot. == Tags Listhttps://create.roblox.com/docs/en-us/ui/rich-text == '''Italics:''' ''''''Lorem Ipsum'''''' | Makes text within the tags ''Italic''. '''Fonts: '''Lorem Ipsum'''''' | Changes the font of the text. A full list of supported fonts can be found on the [https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/datatypes/Font Official Roblox Documentation site].[[File:Rich text collage.png|thumb|222x222px|"This is sample text!" with the applied font, italics, color and stroke.]]'''Color:''' ''''''Lorem Ipsum'''''' | Changes the text color to Red. Change "ff0000" to the HEX code of the color '''without the pound (#)''' you wish to use. (For example, 32cd32 for Lime Green.) '''Stroke:''' ''''''Lorem Ipsum'''''' | Adds a '''red outline''' to text. As with '''Color''', change "ff0000" to the HEX color you want to use. title: Snowdrift Station A & B
wikitext:
{{Stub}}{{Buildings|Island=[[Snowlands]]|NPC=[[Sleepy Bridgeman]]|Purpose=Bring a player across the [[Snowlands]] through a cablecar|Version Added=[[Version 1.71.0]]}}

== Overview ==
The '''Snowdrift Stations A and B''' were added in the [[Version 1.71.0|1.71.0 Christmas Update]] on December 1st, 2024. It was added alongside a full map revamp of the [[Snowlands]].

== Usage ==
The cablecar is to bring cars to and from each station, aka across the biome. It is also an easy way to get to [[Gizmo's Observatory]]. In order to use it, you need either ~$2,500 or a [[Red Keycard]]. The cablecar takes about 33 seconds to go from one side to the other not including wait times.

== Trivia ==

* During the first few days of [[Version 1.71.0]] being out, the Cablecar was bugged, meaning it would be nonfunctional, the [[Sleepy Bridgeman]] would steal your money, and the Cablecar itself would be on the ground.

title: Stars
wikitext:
{{Missing Info}} - Star Chances need further testing for confirmation. - Spawn chances for stars during weather conditions (e.g. stormy) need verification. ''"A wonderous delight sent by the gods of above. Providing essence and love to all. They're also worth money, try selling them!"'' == [[File:Diamond_Main_Titles.png|75x75px]] Stars == '''Stars''' are a resource and material in Oaklands. They spawn at night, and come in 5 different colors, similarly to [[fireflies]]. Stars can also be used as a building material, taking the form of a colored forcefield material when placed into a schematic. Stars fall from the sky at night. Every night has a 1 in 5 chance of being a star rain, which greatly increases the amount of stars that fall. They can be sold at the [[Resource Hub]]. Stars come in 5 colors, each of a different value and rarity. {|style="margin:auto;" class="sortable article-table" |+Star Chances !Yellow, common rarity, has a ~84% or ~8/10 spawn chance. |- !Green, common rarity, has a 10% or 1/10 spawn chance. |- !Red, common rarity, has a 5% or 1/20 spawn chance. |- !Blue, uncommon rarity, has a 0.9% or roughly ~1/100 spawn chance |- !Purple, rare rarity, is the rarest variant. Has a <0.1% or 1/1000 spawn chance. |}
Note that the frequency of star spawns depend upon the ''weather'': * During stormy conditions (such as rainy or thunderstorm), star spawning is reduced by about 0.5X. * A clear night has a 1/5 chance to be a meteor shower/star rain, where stars spawn 2X more than usual. * Any stars that are not claimed will disappear at 6:30. {|style="margin:auto;" class="sortable article-table" !Image !Color Variant !Sell Value |- |[[File:Yellow Star.png|frameless|80x80px]] |Yellow Star |$250 |- |[[File:Green Star.png|frameless|80x80px]] |Green Star |$350 |- |[[File:Red Star.png|frameless|80x80px]] |Red Star |$750 |- |[[File:Blue Star.png|frameless|80x80px]] |Blue Star |$1200 |- |[[File:Purple Star.png|frameless|80x80px]] |Purple Star |$4800 |} == [[File:Hexagon_Question.png|50x50px]] Trivia == * Stars resemble Star Bits from Super Mario Galaxy. The original suggestion on Discord was actually based upon Star Bits. * When viewing the description of a star, it shimmers with all the colors of the rainbow. * Blue and Purple Stars have high trading value - it is not recommended to sell them; make a trade with them instead! * You can save rare stars when filling out schematics by using Yellow Stars. For example, fill a schematic up to 90-95% with Yellow Stars; then, put a Purple Star in to complete the schematic. If done correctly, the schematic will form a material from the rarer variant - useful if you want to do a big project needing a lot of rare stars. [[Category:Resources]]

title: Speaker Text Formatting
wikitext: This page is for '''Speaker''' Text Formatting. For '''Signs''', go to [[Sign Text Formatting]]. == About == Rich text tags are similar to XML/HTML tags where you must include both an opening and closing tag around the text. These allow you to change the font style, and have unique and interesting [[Speaker]] text! == Tags Listhttps://create.roblox.com/docs/en-us/ui/rich-text == '''Bold''': ''''''Lorem Ipsum'''''' | Makes text '''bold'''. '''Italics''': ''''''Lorem Ipsum'''''' | Makes text ''italic''. '''Underline''': ''''''Lorem Ipsum'''''' | Adds an underline to text. '''Strikethrough''': ''''''Lorem Ipsum'''''' | Strikes out text. '''Smallcaps''': ''''''Lorem Ipsum'''''' | Turns text into Sᴍᴀʟʟᴄᴀᴘs. [[File:Rich speaker collage 2.png|thumb|425x425px|A speaker using bold, italic, underlined, and smallcaps text at the same time]] You can nest multiple tags within each other, as long as the closing tags are in the reverse order. For example, ''''''This text is bold, italic, underlined, and in small caps!'''''' would create "This text is bold, italic, underlined, and in small caps!" in bold, italic, underlined, and in smallcaps. == Keywords == Speakers have two unique "tags", referred to ingame as Keywords. These work using signal values. '''Number''': '''{num}''' | Chats the power value it receives. For example, pressing a [[Button]] will make it say "'''10'''", or connecting it to a [[Number Interface]] with an input of 123 will make it say "'''123'''". '''Name''': '''{display_name}''' | Chats the display name of the UserID it receives. For example, connecting it to a number interface with an input of 155551426 will make it say "'''Beta'''", the display name of [https://roblox.fandom.com/wiki/Player:Beta_Protogen Beta_Protogen] (UserID 155551426). [[File:Rich speaker collage.png|thumb|416x416px|A mixture of tags and keywords used together in a speaker.]] These can be inserted between text, and can even be formatted with the above Tags. For example, connecting a speaker to the top wire slot of a [[Donator]] and setting the speaker's text to "''''''Thank you for your donation, ''''''{display_name}''''''!'''''' Fun fact: Your UserID is '''{num}'''!" will output the first whole sentence in bold, display name in italics, and UserID underlined. == Escape Forms == If you want to render certain characters like < or > and exempt them from consideration as part of rich text tags, you can write them in their '''escape form'''. Just write the text that's under "Escape" and it should convert it to the Character version on signs in the game. {| class="fandom-table" |+Table of escape forms, their usages, and outcomes. !Character !Escape !Example !Result |- |< |< |x '''<''' y |x < y |- |> |> |x '''>''' y |y > x |- |" |" |'''"'''x'''"''' |"x" |- |' |' |'''''''xyz''''''' |'xyz' |- |& |& |yes '''&''' no |yes & no |} == Trivia == * Rich text tags like Color () and Font () have been tested and unfortunately '''do not work.''' ** These tags will break speakers and show a mess of code instead of outputting the desired result. * If a rich text tag doesn't work in a speaker, it will disappear from the text box entirely when confirmed. == Gallery == File:Rich speaker i b ul.png|Italic, Bold, and Underline File:Rich speaker s.png|Strikethrough File:Rich speaker sc.png|Smallcaps File:Rich speaker broken.png|Broken speaker trying to say unsupported tags File:Speaker num keyword.png|A speaker outputting the Number Interface's value of 123 using the {num} keyword.

''"Wait, if it's a sticky bomb how doesn't it get stuck to your hand?"''
The '''Sticky Bomb''' is a special explosive sold exclusively at the [[River Shop]] for 1 Credit. It is a throwable bomb that sticks to surfaces. == Details == The Sticky Bomb, unlike any other explosive, can be picked up and treated like a [[:Category:Tools|tool]] that the player can hold in their inventory. While equipped, the user can throw it, which will cause it to stick to the first surface it impacts. On the ground, it can still be ignited as if it were any other explosive. Regardless of the method of activation, the Sticky Bomb explodes like a regular [[Small Bomb]]. ==Gallery== [[File:Sticky_Launching.mp4|left|thumb|Sticky launching technique|300px]] {{Clear}} ==Trivia== * A gimmick of the Sticky Bomb is "sticky jumping" using vehicles. It has grown popular enough that the developers started a contest incentivizing people to "trickshot" with their sticky jumps. The winner of the contest will earn 6,000 Robux. * A patch on 4 March, 2024 fixed an issue where "property flinging" could occur. [[Category:Items]] [[Category:Explosives]]

title: Subspace Tripmine
wikitext:
{{Objects|image1=subspacetripminereal.png|Island=[[Classic Biome]] {{!}} Ferwater|Shop=[[Classic Store]]|Price=$1,010|Function=Raw Chaos|Version Added=1.57.0}}''<big>"A hidden deathtrap, waiting to be USED! Powered by purple goop >:D"</big>''

==Description==
The '''Subspace Tripmine''' is a special item bought in the [[Classic Store]] for $1,010. It is part of the random rotation in the store.

When used, the Subspace Tripmine plants a mine in front of the user, which when stationary, will turn invisible. 

If stepped on by anybody with permissions on your base (including the user), the tripmine instantly explodes, killing those close to it and converting certain objects and schematics nearby temporarily pink with sparkles. 

==Trivia==

*Only one mine can be placed by a person's tool at one time.
*This item can be used to ruin a person's grind (and day) by placing it in risky locations like the plank bridges near the [[Magma Caves]].
*Master trolling item.
*The Subspace Tripmine works and sounds incredibly similar to the original Roblox gear, the [https://www.roblox.com/catalog/11999247/Subspace-Tripmine Subspace Tripmine], however it is modified slightly.[https://www.roblox.com/catalog/11999247/Subspace-Tripmine]

== Subspace Climbing ==
Subspace Climbing is a strategy that you can use to climb large walls. You begin by standing close to the wall. You then spam the mine while moving forward and jumping. Using an autoclicker can help with this process. If you use the strategy on a corner, it can make the process way easier.

wikitext:

</gallery>|Log=$0.90/stud|Sanded=$116.69/stud|Planked=$145.86/stud}}

The Suiratcal is a tree found in [[The Void|The Void Grove]] Biome, in the Island in the middle of the place. To get to the tree, you have to drive or walk across narrow bridge-like rocks.

It is recommended but not required to bring a [[Shadow Etcher]] as it deals 2x damage to the Suiratcal.

The [[Lunar Staff]], or the [[Grabbiest Grabber]] is recommended as the tree is typically on the edge and will fall into the void when cut down.

it was, nerfed from $207.70/stud planked to near $135.7/stud planked. This is slightly less than the [[Snow Tree]], which is far easier to obtain, however Suiratcal is still much better if you manage to get enough, due to its sheer width.

It takes roughly 5-8 minutes for the Suiratcal to respawn however if you leave the stump from a previous tree there it will never respawn until the stumps gone.

=== Fun facts: ===
1. The [[Freyliner Transporter Upgrade|box]] variant of the [[Freyliner Transporter]] can in fact traverse the bridges to the Suiratcal tree, and fit under the arches, allowing you to get around 2.5 trees, or just 1 if its mutated to be large. 

2. if you want to grind and not fail try magma caves as if you cut and sand 1 tree it is very simple to move and you can have a better time grinding

The raw form of Tin takes on a light gray color that can be mistaken for [[Iron]], but is much closer to [[Zinc]], with less edges on the material. 

Putting Tin in a refiner raises the sell price to $22 per stud. Putting that refined Tin through a forge further increases the price to $24 per stud.

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a structure that can be bought from [[The Oak Depot]]. It is a sloping straight section of conveyor belt.

==Appearance==
The Tilted Conveyor is identical in functionality to the [[Straight Conveyor]]. However, the Tilted Conveyor operates at an angle, allowing it to move objects vertically. This can be used to create conveyor systems that go under/over each other, or to lift objects high enough to be dumped into a truck. 

The Tilted Conveyor, when unboxed, is a 6×4×6 object, and feeds resources upwards. Like the Straight Conveyor, it can be resized to be as short as 3 studs in length, or as long as 24 studs in length. The Tilted Conveyor has a minimum height of 3 studs and a maximum height of 6 studs.

== Description ==
The Tree takes the appearance of a classic Roblox tree, with a single sphere as the leaves and a long rectangle for the trunk. The Tree appears within the [[Classic Biome]].

== Trivia ==
* The Tree first appeared for a total of 48 hours in celebration of the game hitting 1 million visits on January 21st, 2023. 
* These trees are a reference to trees that were from old Roblox games, such as Happy Home of Robloxia.
* Its predecessor is the "Pink Tree" from Woodmill inc. It was a tree that spawned in all of the servers upon reaching a large milestone. Internally, it was named "Plastic", and had the default Roblox plastic material applied on it's plank form.
* Due to a miscalculation, this tree was removed two hours early, but was brought back for an extended period to compensate the lost hours.
* It was originally obtainable for a limited amount of time after the game reached a certain visit milestone, alongside the [[Ore]], but now spawns all year round in the [[Classic Biome]].

title: Toy Train
wikitext:
''<big>"Choo Choo! Create your own custom train tracks and create the most popular train industry."</big>''{{Axe|Island=Finlay|Shop=The Oak Depot|Price=$2,400|Version Added=1.45|Date Added=11.12.23|image1=ToyTrainPic.png}}

The '''Toy Train''' is a decorative object in ''Oaklands''. It is a tiny steam train that runs on tracks. It was only purchasable during the 2023, 2024 and, 2025 Christmas event for $2,400 at The Oak Depot and 2400 Snowflakes in Santa's workshop respectively.

== Details ==
Unboxing the Toy Train prompts the user with a placement system similar to running wires for [[Logic]] systems. Players can place rails anywhere they want on the property, though the rails will always face down towards the ground. There are no rules as to how large the rail system is, nor whether it intersects with itself or other props. All the player is required to do is to create a complete loop of rail.

Once completed, the Toy Train will run along the rails. It emits a chugging sound and occasionally plays a steam train horn sound.

wikitext:
(Note: If you want to grind but you don't like having to try hard for only 1 tree, The [[Magma Tree|Magma Trees]] in the [[Magma Caves]] (Lava Cave) are a great way to make cash, as the void is extremely dangerous and not for everyone.) [[Category:Locations]] {| class="fandom-table" |} == Description == [[File:(04FE493F-E057-4D0C-9BEE-781639C38460).png|thumb]] The Void is a very dark, vast and rocky unknown biome located deep underneath the whole map of Oaklands. Entering it makes everything become greyscale and renders the player's freecam and minimap defunct. It is hard to see there, so [[Night Vision Goggles]] are helpful but not necessary. Two [[Large Bomb|large bombs]] or 5 [[Small Bomb|small bombs]] are needed to destroy the stone blocking the entrance. At the very bottom of the Void is an ocean of black water; ''this will kill the player immediately'' ''if touched''. Also, if a player is to climb too high they will reach an invisible barrier, which will kill the player immediately if touched. === Entrances === # [[Magma Caves]], upon entering the main area with lava pools and [[Magma Tree|Magma Trees]], simply hugging the right wall, there is another cave going deeper. # Inside [[Uncertainty Cave]], in the [[Oobmab]] area right side, where you make a [[Fusion Coil]]. # From inside the [[Acidlands|Acid Caves]] in the [[Acid Smog]] in the [[Acidlands]], leading to the opposite side from the [[Magma Caves]] entrance. # Inside the [[Plek]] spawn area, on the other side of where you enter it, there is a hole that leads to the [[Magma Caves]] entrance. (You will have to leave through the Magma Caves if you come this way) # In the [[Icelands]], opposite the [[Sapphire|Sapphire Cave]] entrance, there's another explodable wall that leads to another void entrance. # There is ''technically'' another entrance in the Icelands, though it appears to be unintentional- in the very deep ice caves, if one falls off the ice and into the water below, it is possible to enter the Void through a gap in the sand floor. Note that if this is done without first opening a normal entrance, ''you will be trapped in the Void and forced to respawn''. # doing a set amount of quests in the acidlands will provide you with a difficult, but rewarding entrance to the void. ''although this is a good way to enter, it costs'' ''$300K to use and begin the quests.'' == Resources == Prevalently, the Void contains [[Void Crystal|Void Crystals]] scattered about, but in the Void Grove there are [[Shadow Tree|Shadow Trees]] and [[Suiratcal]]. There are also enemies that can drop one of two axes: [[Shadow etcher|Shadow Etcher]] and [[Light Etcher|Light Etcher]]. These two axes drop at a 2% chance from the respective enemy carrying them. Also in the Void Grove there are Zebra [[Butterflies]] and Black Swallowtail Butterflies, which sell for $2000 and $1000 each. == Hazards == The Void is home to many hazards. Most prominently, there is a dark ocean at the bottom of the Void which instantly kills players who fall into it. Additionally, in the Void Grove, there are also thorn bushes that can spawn in place of Shadow Trees, which deal damage to players in a large area. === Darklings === The void is home to many variations of Darklings, they can spawn randomly around the player when they are in the void. They can also be found in large numbers around Shadow Forest. Because of the difficulty to run away from Darklings given their speed (slightly slower then a coil, Light Darklings are faster than a coil) it is recommended to bring [[Tools|weapons]] or to maneuver in a way to get them to fall into the void water or off a straight edge. The following variations of Darklings are present in the void: * [[Darkling]]: These are your common Darkling. They are all black, emit a dark smoke and have 500 HP. Unlike all other Darklings, they can spawn anywhere and not just in the Void Grove, and in the sparse parts of the Void they have an exceedingly large chase radius. They have ??? hp and deal 25 damage with a large amount of knockback. * Void Axe Darkling: Slightly Rarer Darklings that wields a [[Shadow Etcher|shadowy axe]] but move very slowly and can easily be maneuvered around. They deal 50 damage and have 750 HP. * Light Darkling: These Rarer Darklings are all white, emit a white smoke and glow. They are faster than [[Speed Coil]] and [[Fusion Coil]], deals 50 damage, inflict a VERY large amount of knockback, and have 750 HP. * Light Axe Darkling: Extremely Rare Darklings that wields a [[Light Etcher|shadow axe with neon white highlights]]. They are as fast as a normal Darkling, deals 99 damage, and have 1000 HP. Void Axe Darkling and Light Axe Darkling each have a 2% chance to drop their respective Axe when defeated. == Tips == * Coils: While you can venture down without one, it's recommended to craft a [[Fusion Coil|Fusion coil]] before venturing into the void * Vehicles: If one wishes to get Wood or [[Void Crystal]] its recommended to bring a [[Sellner Explorer]] due to its speed and maneuverability, if one is up to a challenge the [[Freyliner Transporter]] can fit through the [[Oobmab]] entrance (if one succeeds in this Darklings can be killed through the walls of the Transporter with relative safety) but this is not recommended due to the terrain and general unwieldiness of the large vehicle. If one wishes to farm [[The Void#Darklings|Darklings]], a [[UFO]] is recommended due to its speed and ability to float above the Darklings. ** Do not bring a [[Landhauler]] into the void, it cannot climb steep edges due to its high center of mass. ** Do not bring a [[Stud helicopter|Helicopter]] or [[Oakwing 172 Airplane|Airplane]] into the void, it will explode, kick you out, and be rendered unusable in the void. * Weapons: Due to the inherent dangers, melee weapons are NOT recommended but can be used. Ranged weapons like the [[Rusted Piercer]], [[Alien Blaster]] or even the [[Acid staff]] are effective as long as you keep your distance * Tools: Aside from bringing your strongest axes and pickaxes, Bring a few [[Large Bomb|Large Bombs]], preferably inside a [[Boom Blaster|Boom Blaster]], to open up the Void entrances. Two Large Bombs will be needed to blow open an entrance to the void. Additionally, a Flamethrower or an [[Icethrower|Icethrower]] can help with clearing out thorns in the Void Grove (their flames destroy the thorns instantly) * The more players there are in the void, the more often Darklings will spawn. == Trivia == * The Void Grove is directly under [[Finlay]]. * The grass on the center of the Void Grove has a teal color. * As of 1/8/26, there is a bug with Roblox’s rendering system that makes parts of the Void to not fully generate, causing players to fall through and die. Hoofer has filed a report with Roblox and is working on a fix. You can find the report here. (this report has been fixed) ** There still exists a similar bug, in which players in vehicles randomly become invisible in random patches in the void. This has no physics effect however. *Entering the Void with a flying vehicle, such as the [[Oakwing 172 Airplane|Oakwing 172 airplane,]] will have the player forced out of it as an explosion effect appears in the center of the vehicle. {| class="mw-collapsible fandom-table" ![[Template:Locations Nav|v]] • [[Template talk:Locations Nav|d]] • e |- | {| class="fandom-table" ! colspan="3" |[[:Category:Locations|'''Locations''']] |- ![[:Category:Stores|Stores]] |[[Alan's AutoLogistics]] • [[Classic Store]] • [[Dugg's Digging]] • [[Fairway Island]] • [[Flora Laura]] • [[Fungi Finds]] • [[Goblin Town Shop]] • [[Gizmo's Observatory]] • [[Ice Golem Shop]] • [[Illumine Designs]] • [[Lighthouse]] • [[Magma Cave Shop]] • [[Mike's Mines]] • [[Pirate Boat]] • [[Radical Shack]] • [[Resource Hub]] • [[River Shop]] • [[The Oak Depot]] |- ![[:Category:Locations|Locations]] |[[Acid Wastes]] • [[Bridge]] • [[Easter Island]] • [[Fairway Island]] • [[Ferwater Island]] • [[Finlay Island]] • [[Flowering Meadows]] • [[Icelands]] • [[Lost Woods]] • [[Magma Caves]] • [[Mike's Mines]] • [[Resource Hub]] • [[River Caves]] • [[Snowy peaks]] • '''The Void''' • [[Uncertainty Cave]] |- ![[:Category:Locations|Structures]] |[[Property]] • [[Lab]] • [[Aurora Shrine]] • [[Duck Shrine]] • [[Heavenly Shrine]] • [[Ruins]] • [[Skull Rock]] • [[Secret Shack]] |- ![[:Category:Locations|Removed]] |[[Abandoned Mine]] • [[Eggstatic Hop Shop]] • [[Familiar Island]] • [[Ghoulish Goods]] • [[Jer's Junkyard]] • [[Radical Isle]] • [[Uncertainty Island]] • [[The Manor]] |} |} # Lose all colour saturation # Other explosive options are available, these are just recommended. # If using a melee weapon a [[Fusion Coil|Fusion coil]] is recommended # All ranged weapons have an auto aim ability even if it doesn't look like it hits, it does inflict damage === “??? Sighting” === '''Seen By:''' blak (p1neapples_50) '''Location:''' The Void '''Date:''' November 1, 2025
“While exploring the Void, a Darkling began convulsing. The area dimmed — everything went black except for a white outline around its body. It grew larger and its form turned fleshy and tentacled. I heard cracking and wet sounds as it changed. Then it started flying toward me, going above a fall with a speed faster than fusion coil. It lunged right as I teleported out with my word teleportation device. When I returned, it was gone. The last thing I saw was it holding a monochrome axe."
