title: Uncertainty Cave
wikitext:
{{Buildings
|image1 = Uncertaintycaveentrance.png 
|Island = Ferwater
|NPC = [[Mushroo]]
|Purpose = Shop, Mushrooms
|Version Added = v1.4.1
|Date Added = 3/10/2023}}
{{Outdated}}

== Description ==
The '''Uncertainty Cave''' is a speciality cave located at the bottom of [[Ferwater Island]]'s desertlands' fissure. To navigate to the cave, players must go through the Oke Caves, the caves of the desertlands, into the canyon. It is best to be careful as the [[Boomite]] Caves are also connected to the Oke Caves. Another way to access the cave is to drive off into the fissure and flip the vehicle once landed, granted there are no trailers.  

The Uncertainty Cave is characterized by a deep purple fog and lightly-colored lavender sands. The cave is expansive with high ceilings and multiple levels within the same cavern. 

Mysterious Mushrooms on the ceiling of the cave shoot poisonous spores at the player, requiring the player to hide and heal as they explore the cave. The spore projectiles confer an anti-gravity effect to the player, allowing them to float and reach the ceiling of the cave. It is recommended that the player have a [[Healing Coil]] (bought from the [[Classic Store]]) to quickly regenerate health while exploring the cave.   

There are three walls that can be broken with explosives in Uncertainty Cave. One leads to the entrance of Fungi Finds. The other two walls are both secret entrances to Fusion Lake containing [[Oobmab]], a purple species of [[Bamboo]], along with Tamed Mysterious Mushrooms, a unique flower.   

== Resources ==
The cave is home to five types of [[Mushrooms]] - Red, Green, Blue, Purple, and [[Mysterious Mushrooms]]. The former four mushroom types spawn on the ground, while Mysterious Mushrooms spawn on the ceiling of the cave. The different colors of Mushrooms have equal monetary value regardless of color (except the Mysterious variety). Mysterious Mushrooms offer a much higher profit, both for its wood and cap.   

The last type of wood available in Uncertainty Cave is Oobmab wood, which can be farmed at the hidden lake behind the explodable walls adjacent to Fungi Finds.  

Uncertainty Cave is also the only spawn location for [[Fungoidite]] nodes, which can have one rare ore type - [[Fungiviolet]]. No other ores spawn in Fungoidite nodes, and Fungiviolet ores have a distinct neon glow that can be seen without a Flashlight. [[File:Uncertaintylocation.png|thumb|386x386px|Location of Uncertainty Cave, indicated by the red dot]]

== Stores ==
There are two shops located in Uncertainty Cave:

* [[Fungi Finds]] (Shop)
* [[Pirate Boat|Pirate Boat Shop]]

'''Fungi Finds''' is a secret shop hidden behind a destructible wall. This shop offers mainly decoration and quality-of-life items, such as [[Dice]], Music Discs, and three statue decorations; [[Kallostide]], [[Moai]], and [[Mysterious Teacup|Mysterious Teacups]]. 

The '''Pirate Boat''' shop sells high-tier explosives, which can be used on breakable walls. This shop moves around the map, with the dock at Uncertainty Cave being a potential location for this shop. The explosives this shop offers are convenient for accessing Fungi Finds and the Oobmab spawn location, both of which require explosives to enter. 

== Special Quests ==
There are three secret quests that require the use of Uncertainty Cave to complete:

* Refined/Forged [[Inkstone]] can be enchanted into [[? ? ?]] when it comes in contact with a spore projectile, then it will turn into a neon pink block. This special ore is useful in completing the [[Uncertain Pickaxe]] quest. The special  ? ? ? ore is used to be placed on pedestals at specific points around the map, summoning the one and only [[Uncertain Pickaxe]].
* Fusion Lake or Oobmab Lake is required for the [[Fusion Coil]] quest. Firstly, the player must use explosives - at minimum, a [[Small Bomb]] - to destroy one of the two breakable walls and open the entrance. By placing a [[Healing Coil]], a [[Speed Coil]], a [[Gravity Coil]], and an [[Infused Core]] into the lake, the materials combine to create a Fusion Coil. The coils can be bought from the Classic Store, and the Infused Core can be created by taking a [[Meteor core|Meteor Core]] from the site of a meteorite impact and putting it into contact with a spore projectile from a Mysterious Mushroom.
* Tamed Mysterious Mushrooms from the Fusion Lake can be used in a multiple part quest to obtain the elusive Petalbloom, obtained at multiple shrines that need to hold a specific flower from multiple locations.

== Other ==
In the place where you combine coils to make a [[Fusion Coil]]. Now there is an entrance to [[The Void]].

== Trivia ==
* When selling any type of Mushroom, note that the caps of Mushrooms are considered wood. Mushroom caps should be cut off from the stalk and sold raw for the most profit, as they are destroyed when sanded. '''''*I recommend to not sand the caps on accident lol*'''''
* The cave is likely to be inspired in the [https://refinerycaves.fandom.com/wiki/Purple_Cave <u>Purple Cave</u>] from Refinery Caves due to the fact that both are related to mushrooms and both contain a water source.

title: Uncertain Pickaxe
wikitext:
[[File:A player holding the pickaxe.png|thumb|How it looks in a players hand]]''-"The Corrupt Pickaxe: a daily companion of charm and power, crafted with Tupi mastery and Furpz wood. Unveiling hidden paths and ores, it empowers adventurers and builders alike."-''
{{Pickaxe|Swing Power=1|Swing Distance=15 Studs|Swing Time=1.6|AOE Distance=2 Studs|Version Added=1.26.0|Date Added=17.07.23|Status=Obtainable|image1=Uncertain Pickaxe.png|Island=Finlay|Shop=Pedestal|Price=3 [[? ? ?|? ? ?]] Ore}}== Description == The '''Uncertain Pickaxe''', also known as the '''Corrupt Pickaxe''', is a special quest pickaxe obtained by placing 3 pieces of [[? ? ?|Infused Ink]] onto the active [[Pedestal|pedestals]] located around the map. It is the first pickaxe to have a unique ability, which is that it causes small [[Mysterious Mushrooms]] to grow out of an ore vein when it is hit. The [[Mysterious Mushrooms]] damage surrounding rocks and produce a continuous "boo-womp" sound effect from [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/SpongeBob_SquarePants SpongeBob SquarePants]. It has been observed that for the [[? ? ?|Infused Ink]] pieces to work on the pedestals, assuming their length is 1 and width is 2, height must be higher than 2. Regardless if cut to that size or not. ==Appearance== The Uncertain Pickaxe takes appearance of a miniature Mysterious Mushroom with a [[Fungiviolet]] blade impaled through it, being covered in mycelium. ==Obtaining== '''Note:''' As of 1.62.0 the pickaxe's ownership will be automatically assigned to whoever placed the Infused Ink on the 3 pedestals. *Go to [[Mike's Mines]] and find the small red trigger located deep within the mine. The trigger can be reached by navigating the hanging boards over the underground lake, best done using a [[Gravity Coil]]. Note, however, that there are a few dead ends- the correct path leads to a rusty truss. '''If the button is nowhere to be seen, this means that a person in your server already toggled the quest; you can then skip that part and go to the next quest.''' File:Registry.png|Trigger for quest in Mike's Mines File:Registry location.png|Way to trigger in new mike's mines *Find and refine/forge 3 pieces of [[Inkstone]]. The pieces should be big enough (approximately 4 studs in volume), or else the pedestal may not register it as a valid step towards completing the Uncertain Pickaxe quest. *Go to [[Uncertainty Cave]] and make a [[Mysterious Mushrooms|Mysterious Mushroom]] fire a glowing purple spore at a piece of the refined Inkstone. If successful, a "boo-womp" sound effect will be heard and the refined/forged Ink will transform into [[? ? ?|Infused Ink]]. Repeat this process with the remaining 2 pieces of refined/forged [[Inkstone|Ink]]. *Place a piece of [[? ? ?|Infused Ink]] on each of the three pedestals around the map- in the desert canyon, near [[Alan's AutoLogistics]], and in the Lost Woods near the [[Lighthouse]]. When the quest is active, these pedestals will have a red ring around them and emit a barely-audible bass humming sound. When Infused Ink is placed on them, they should emit a pink aura and shoot a beam pointing toward the center pedestal. *If successful, three poof sounds will be heard across the whole server, followed with a louder poof noise. This is the pickaxe spawning. Get to the top of the hill in the [[Acidlands]] (the area with the poison effect) to claim the Uncertain Pickaxe near the center pedestal. The pedestal is on a rock with spires jutting out of it. == Map Guide == File:1st pedestal ashiftinterrain.png|1st pedestal picture File:1st pedestal minimap.jpg|1st pedestal location (old) File:2nd pedestal pic.jpg|2nd pedestal picture File:2nd pedestal minimap.jpg|2nd pedestal location File:3rd pedestal pic.jpg|3rd pedestal picture File:3rd pedestal minimap.jpg|3rd pedestal location File:PedestalsGuide.png| Pedestals tutorial ''(Outdated)''[[File:Oaklands 3 pedestals tutorial (new map).mp4|left|thumb|402x402px|'''Pedestals tutorial (current)''']] == Gallery == UPickaxeRedesignConcept.png|Redesign concept art UncertainPickaxeOld.webp|Old design ==Trivia== *After 15th of March 2024 the pickaxe got a remodel, making it look more fitting to the theme of a tool made out of fungal infused materials. It was made by community members @mr_peeka_boo, @xphrogx and @aylien who drew the concept, provided feedback and modelled it respectively. *The words "Corrupt", "Daily", "Tupi" and "Furpz" referenced in it's description are actually names of 4 known members of the Typical Developers Discord server; Corrupt, Dailyyy, Tupisupi, and Furpz. *The concept of this pickaxe heavily resembles the [https://refinerycaves.fandom.com/wiki/Spore_Pickaxe Spore Pickaxe] from [https://www.roblox.com/games/8726743209/LAST-UPDATE-Refinery-Caves Refinery Caves]. This is possibly because those who suggested the Uncertain Pickaxe's addition were/are fans of that game. *It is the first pickaxe that is obtainable via completion of a quest. *Before being discovered, Daily, Furpz, and Tupisupi were leaving cryptic messages, which have been revealed to be pieces of the item's description. Those messages were "Daily companion", "Furpz wood" and "Tupi mastery". *The Uncertain Pickaxe is capable of destroying entire ore nodes in a couple of swings due to its special ability. title: Trolley
wikitext:
A wonderful 4-wheeled movement device used for all your moving needs. '''Warning: may experience explosions.'''
{{Objects |image1= Image 2023-07-18 072211190.png|Unboxed Trolley Boxed.png|Boxed | Island=Finlay | Shop=The Lighthouse (Jer's Junkyard before the map remake) | Price=$1,400 | Function=Can be used to move multiple items around the property, cant be grab by Grabby Grabber and Grabbiest Grabber | Version Added=1.28.0 | Date Added=July 21, 2023 | Status=Obtainable }} The '''Trolley''' is an object that can be purchased from [[Jerry's Junk]] for $1400. It allows players to move a small amount of cargo. == Details == The Trolley is effectively a human-powered version of the [[Basic Flatbed Trailer]]. Objects can be placed on top of the Trolley, and they will attach to it, allowing the player to move multiple objects at once. If it tips over, it will immediately dump all of its cargo onto the ground. The Trolley cannot be grabbed by any [[:Category:Grabbers|grabbers]]. == Trivia == * Prior to the map revamp, the Trolley was sold at [[Jer's Junkyard]]. * The original price of the Trolley was $280 until it was removed. The developers said: "Trolley will return to the Junkyard soon! Removed it temporarily until it fully works properly." Trolleys returned in update 1.28.0 for a price of $680, although this price was soon changed to $1,400 in update 1.28.1. * We're still not sure if it explodes. [[Category:Items]]

title: Uranium
wikitext:
==Description ==
{{Ore
|image1= <gallery>
Uraniumraw.png|Ore
Uraniumref.png|Refined
Uraniumfor.png|Forged
</gallery>
| Island=Ferwater, Acidlands
| Refined=$250/stud
| Forged=$680/stud
| Version Added=___
| Date Added=__
| Status=Obtainable
}}
Uranium can only spawn on [[Grimestone]] nodes. though there's some evidence on older version of the game that uranium can spawn on other certain nodes. Uranium can spawn with a chance of about 1/500.   

However, there is a place in the [[Acidlands]] called [[Acid Smog]]. There, the main spawn is Uranium. But it does damage, so you need a fusion coil or healing coil to survive.   

Raw Uranium is a shade of dark green. It can most easily be found within the (new) [[Acidlands]] within the [[Grimestone]].

It is recommended you use a [[Metal Detector]] purchased in the [[Gizmo's Observatory]] as it makes it easier to distinguish between the ink that also spawns in the [[Acidlands]]. 

Putting Uranium into a refiner raises the sell price to $250 per stud. Putting that refined Uranium through a forge further increases the price to $680 per stud and changes material to neon.

title: Update Log/Version 1.43.0
wikitext:
This page contains all the changes made in '''Version 1.43.0'''.

== Official update log ==

'''Added'''
* A new store has appeared called [[Alan's AutoLogistics]]
* Three new conveyors have been added to the game. The [[4-Way Conveyor]], [[Filter Conveyor]], [[Alignment Conveyor]]
* Fourty six new logic components have been added. A list in o particular order: [[Signal Lock]], [[Zero Tick]], [[Commander]], [[XOR Gate]], [[Greater Than Gate]], [[Delay]], [[Music Note]], [[Laser Receiver]], [[Red Laser|Laser]], [[Lock]], [[Button]], [[Joystick]], [[Marble]] (sic), [[Receiver]], [[Frequency]], [[Transmitter]], [[Collider]], [[Frequency Clock]] [[Electronic Billboard]], [[LCD]], [[Memory Cell]], [[Daylight Sensor]], [[Blocker]], [[14-Segment Display]], [[Calculator]], [[Pressure Pad]], [[Binary Output]], [[Tether]], [[Privacy Glass]], [[Material Laser]], [[XAND Gate]], [[Interactor]], [[Binary Input]], [[Weather Sensor]], [[AND Gate]], [[Randomizer]], [[OR Gate]], [[Number Interface]], [[Proximity]], [[Relay]], [[Switch]], [[Incrementor]], [[Slider]], [[T Flip-Flop]], [[7-Segment Display]], [[NOT Gate]], and the [[Sustainer]]
*A new marble item has been added
*Added a [[Smoke Emitter]], now you can have cool fog!
*A new color approaches! Introducing, the grey vehicle color. So special, wait- no.. so common!
*The economy UI has been completely remade from the ground up
*A new gamepass has been added, The Creative Wiring Gamepass!
*A lot of performance additions have been added in attempt to help. The impact of these changes is unknown, more work is to be needed though! (sic)
*New Playstation icons to replace Xbox when needed
*A changelog summary now apepars for the first time you play that update, and can also be opened by clicking the TD logo in the bottom left
*It's starting to get very cold! The grass colors will begin to shift

'''Fixed'''
* Resolved a typo with the Clair de Lune music vinyl
* The tutorial no longer gives finlay clover, now kelp for structures
* The familiar place badge should now work again
* Raw lavaslate on doors should no longer turn the door blue
* The shopping vinyl now plays music
* The statistic tool now shows plank and sawed wood correctly
* Olive bark now is correctly displayed
* You can no longer spam create save slots
* Renwved collision from lanterns and ropes in the mines
* Mobile can now correctly rotate items
* Neon lights now lose their neon when powered Off

'''Changed'''
* The loading content system is now accurate, faster, and will guarantee you load all assets in the game
* The main menu music now is apart of the music sound group because I cannot take it anymore!
* Sanded Kelp now follows the current grass color
* Removed halloween items, decor, and other related content
* Revamped delete mode completely, it's now a lot easier to delete objects!
* Revamped unboxing structures via build mode, you can now open multiple in a row.
* Reworked the visual appearance of the dragger
* When driving a vehicle, the camera now is locked to the character head
* Lowered the price of boxed water
* Improved magma tree rate from Red Meteors
* Lava cave wall requires more dynamite
* Doors now only open in one direction, which can be changed by the user
* Many UI elements now allow you to move your mouse when fully zoomed in
* Elevators can now be scaled to a 1×4×1 size, and their max height has doubled
* We sold out... the shop icon is now green

== Changes ==
''No changes in this update failed to make it into the patch notes.''

title: Update Log/Version 1.5.0
wikitext:
This page contains all the changes made in '''Version 1.50.0'''.

== Official update log ==

'''Added'''
* Tree generation has been entirely rewritten, resulting in better performance and the ability to save trees on your property!
* New hotbar system! You can now re-organize your inventory, and dropping things should be more intuitive
* A new UI interface for health and oxygen has appeared! No more drowning without realizing.. Although, I'm not sure how you would've noticed you * weren't DYING FOR OXYGEN BEFORE!
* There is now an Aurora Borealis weather event!
* Two new vinyls have been added to the game, can you find them?
* New atmospheric sounds have been added to make the game more immersive
* There is now wind effects, including wind lines and moving leaves

'''Fixed'''
* A weird delay when an object first hits a sander should no longer happen
* Supporter gamepass money should now be given
* Rocks and trees should now spawn in the archway replacement for the tunnel
* Objects with invisible colliders (such as a ladder) should no longer falsely trigger refinery/forge/etc output blockage
* Signs should set their text color correctly for some darker materials such as Mythril
* Conveyors shouldn't "stick" objects as easily anymore, hopefully, please. I need this. please
* An issue where controller users couldn't use the advanced wire options should be fixed
* Icestone is now slippery, yipee!!!!
* Properties should no longer have a "height" limit
* The Alignment Conveyor should no longer grab onto currently dragged items
* An attempt has been made to fix pixel gaps that are created over time. This will not fix existing ones, sorry
* Doors and other misc. schematics should now be able to be replicated in build mode
* Many of the NPCs no longer show "None" for their dialogue prompt
* Improved performance for store region respawning
* Many of the vehicle inspection menus should now have the correct model shown in the viewport
* The lamp head exclusive should now always work
* When purchasing a boxed good with multiple quantity, it will now accurately reflect that in the purchase dialogue
* Moving a toy train track off of your property will now result in the train converting back into it's item form
* A bunch of small map fixes were made
* There was likely a lot of stuff we forgot to note! We hope these changes help everyone out.

'''Changed'''
* Vehicle beds are now rewritten to be better. (strike 1...)
* Crates are now entirely rewritten to be better. (strike 2!)
* Elevators are now rewritten to be better. (3 strikes, you're out!)
* The Large Bombs at the pirate ship are now much much cheaper (5000 -> 1200)
* Vehicles can now be respawned without the need to hover over the button
* The keybind for changing the mode of a calculator is now different due to accidental presses
* Box quantity counts now display on all sides of the box for better visibility
* Property selection should now be more smooth and automatically start on the first available property
* Cauldrons can now have their particles and sound toggled on and off
* The Menorah can now have the lights toggled on and off
* Sliding doors now take way less material to fill (0.7 -> 0.4)
* Modified some of the tutorial dialogue to be less obscure
* The beach music is now different! (Cumbiac by Kevin Macleod)
* Lowered the amount of normal mushrooms that spawn in the cave by 4x
* The inspect menu viewport now rotates and also now has better lighting
* The grabbiest grabber now has a blue light, similar to the grabby grabber
* The underwater ambiance sound is now different
* The ocean water now has transparency, hopefully you can see kelp and other resources easier now!
* The default server time cycle now starts at 12 PM rather than a random time from 12 AM to 12 PM
* Christmas Toy trains can now be picked up off of their track!
* Rocks now slightly shrink when mined in order to prevent them becoming hard to drag out of their node
* Tiny rock wedges no longer generate ore pieces
* The Highlands now have a different grass color

title: Vampire
wikitext:
{{Character|name=Vampire|imagecaption=Vampire in-game|appearsin=Blood Moons|image=Halloween24.png}}The '''Vampire''' is an enemy added in the Halloween 2024 update. The '''Vampire''' can appear during a [[Blood Moon]], which last 5 in-game hours or 5 minutes in real life. When killed, it drops 1-3 [[Bone]], 1-3 [[Candycorn]], and a Meat Vinyl Player.  

It can spawn in the center of the Farlands (near the [[Lighthouse]]), the Taiga (behind [[Alan's AutoLogistics|Alan's Autologistics]]) and in the Savannah.

== Version 1.43.0 (💡 The Logistics Update! 🔦) ==
'''November 1st, 2023'''

=== Added: ===

* A new store has appeared called [[Alan's AutoLogistics]]
* Three new conveyors have been added to the game; The [[4-Way Conveyor]], [[Filter Conveyor]], [[Alignment Conveyor]]
* Forty six new logic components have been added. A list in no particular order
* [[Signal lock|Signal Lock]], [[Zero Tick|Zero-Tick]], [[Commander]], [[XOR Gate]], [[Greater Than Gate]], [[Delay]], [[Music Note]], [[Laser Receiver]], [[Red Laser|Laser]], [[Lock]], [[Button]], [[Joystick]], [[Marble]], [[Receiver]], [[Frequency]], [[Transmitter]], [[Collider]], [[Frequency Clock]], [[Electronic Billboard]], [[LCD]], [[Memory Cell]], [[Daylight Sensor]], [[Blocker]], [[14 Segment Display|14-Segment Display]], [[Calculator]], [[Pressure Pad]], [[Binary Output]], [[Tether]], [[Privacy Glass]], [[Material Laser]], [[XAND Gate]], [[Interactor]], [[Binary Input]], [[Weather Sensor]], [[AND Gate]], [[Randomizer]], [[OR Gate]], [[Number Interface]], [[Proximity Sensor]], [[Relay]], [[Switch]], [[Incrementor]], [[Slider]], [[T-Flip Flop]], [[7 Segment Display|7-Segment Display]], [[NOT Gate]], and the [[Sustainer]]
* A new [[Marbles|marble]] item has been added
* Added a [[smoke emitter]], now you can have cool fog!
* A new color approaches! Introducing, the grey vehicle color. So special, wait- no.. so common!
* The economy UI has been completely remade from the ground up
* A new gamepass has been added, The Creative Wiring Gamepass!
* A lot of  performance additions have been added in attempt to help. The impact of these changes are unknown, more work is to be needed though!
* New Playstation icons to replace Xbox when needed
* A changelog summary now appears for the first time you play that update, and can also be opened by clicking the TD logo in the bottom left
* It's starting to get very cold! The grass colors will begin to shift
* Added new vinyl maker behind The Oak Depot, can be purchased for 250 robux!

=== Changed: ===

* The loading content system is now accurate, faster, and will guarantee you load all assets in the game
* The main menu music now is apart of the music sound group because I cannot take it anymore!
* Sanded [[Kelp]] now follows the current grass color
* Removed halloween items, decor, and other related content
* Revamped delete mode completely, it's now a lot easier to delete objects!
* Revamped unboxing structures via build mode, you can now open multiple in a row.
* Reworked the visual appearance of the dragger
* When driving a vehicle, the camera now is locked to the character head
* Lowered the price of [[Boxed Water|boxed water]]
* Improved [[Magma Tree|magma tree]] rate from Red [[Meteor|Meteors]]
* Lava cave wall requires more dynamite
* Doors now only open in one direction, which can be changed by the user
* Many UI elements now allow you to move your mouse when fully zoomed in
* [[Elevator|Elevators]] can now be scaled to a 1x4x1 size, and their max height has doubled
* We sold out... the shop icon is now green

=== Bug Fixes: ===

* Resolved a typo with the [[Clair de Lune]] music vinyl
* The tutorial no longer gives [[Finlay Clover]], now [[Kelp]] for structures
* The [[Badges|familiar place]] badge should now work again
* Raw [[Lavaslate]] on doors should no longer turn the door blue
* The shopping vinyl now plays music
* The [[Statistic Tool|statistic tool]] now shows plank and sawed wood correctly
* [[Olive]] bark now is correctly displayed
* You can no longer spam create save slots
* Removed collision from lanterns and ropes in the mines
* Mobile can now correctly rotate items
* [[Neon Light|Neon lights]] now lose their neon when powered off

== Version 1.50.0 ==
'''February 21st, 2024'''

=== Added: ===

* Tree generation has been entirely rewritten, resulting in better performance and the ability to save trees on your property!
* New hotbar system! You can now re-organize your inventory, and dropping things should be more intuitive
* A new UI interface for health and oxygen has appeared! No more drowning without realizing.. Although, I'm not sure how you would've noticed you weren't DYING FOR OXYGEN BEFORE!
* There is now an Aurora Borealis weather event!
* Two new vinyls have been added to the game, can you find them?
* New atmospheric sounds have been added to make the game more immersive
* There is now wind effects, including wind lines and moving leaves

=== Changes: ===

* Vehicle beds are now rewritten to be better. (strike 1...)
* Crates are now entirely rewritten to be better. (strike 2!)
* [[Elevator|Elevators]] are now rewritten to be better. (3 strikes, you're out!)
* The [[Large Bomb|Large Bombs]] at the [[Pirate Boat|pirate ship]] are now much much cheaper (5000 -> 1200)
* Vehicles can now be respawned without the need to hover over the button
* The keybind for changing the mode of a calculator is now different due to accidental presses
* Box quantity counts now display on all sides of the box for better visibility
* Property selection should now be more smooth and automatically start on the first available property
* [[Cauldron|Cauldrons]] can now have their particles and sound toggled on and off
* The [[Menorah]] can now have the lights toggled on and off
* [[Sliding Door|Sliding doors]] now take way less material to fill (0.7 -> 0.4)
* Modified some of the tutorial dialogue to be less obscure
* The beach music is now different! ([https://open.spotify.com/track/1qZ0Pq9HUhLg6eSLVw6Z8G Cumbiac by Kevin Macleod])
* Lowered the amount of [[Mushrooms|normal mushrooms]] that spawn in the cave by 4x
* The inspect menu viewport now rotates and also now has better lighting
* The [[Grabbiest Grabber|grabbiest grabber]] now has a blue light, similar to the [[Grabby Grabber|grabby grabber]]
* The underwater ambiance sound is now different
* The ocean water now has transparency, hopefully you can see [[kelp]] and other resources easier now!
* The default server time cycle now starts at 12 PM rather than a random time from 12 AM to 12 PM
* Christmas [[Toy Train|Toy trains]] can now be picked up off of their track!
* Rocks now slightly shrink when mined in order to prevent them becoming hard to drag out of their node
* Tiny rock wedges no longer generate ore pieces
* The Highlands now have a different grass color

=== Fixes: ===

* A weird delay when an object first hits a sander should no longer happen
* Supporter gamepass money should now be given
* Rocks and trees should now spawn in the archway replacement for the tunnel
* Objects with invisible colliders (such as a ladder) should no longer falsely trigger refinery/forge/etc output blockage
* [[Sign|Signs]] should set their text color correctly for some darker materials such as [[Mythril]]
* Conveyors shouldn't "stick" objects as easily anymore, hopefully, please. I need this. please
* An issue where controller users couldn't use the advanced wire options should be fixed
* [[Icestone]] is now slippery, yippee!!!!
* Properties should no longer have a "height" limit
* The [[Alignment Conveyor]] should no longer grab onto currently dragged items
* An attempt has been made to fix pixel gaps that are created over time. This will not fix existing ones, sorry
* Doors and other misc. [[schematics]] should now be able to be replicated in build mode
* Many of the NPCs no longer show "None" for their dialogue prompt
* Improved performance for store region respawning
* Many of the vehicle inspection menus should now have the correct model shown in the viewport
* The lamp head exclusive should now always work
* When purchasing a boxed good with multiple quantity, it will now accurately reflect that in the purchase dialogue
* Moving a [[Toy Train|toy train]] track off of your property will now result in the train converting back into it's item form
* A bunch of small map fixes were made
* There was likely a lot of stuff we forgot to note! We hope these changes help everyone out.

title: Version 1.55.0
wikitext:
== Version 1.55.0 (📦 The I Dont Know What To Label It As Update!!!) ==
'''May 10th, 2024'''

=== Added: ===

* A new form of storage has been added, the [[Storage Drawer]]! Available at the [[lighthouse]].
* Added [[Stained Glass|stained glass]], which can be created by dying glass with a [[Dye Machine|dye machine]]. Glass is obtained by refining and forging [[sand]]
* New rainfall visual effects, things should look a lot more pleasing
* The main region music track is now mono rather than stereo, no more annoying sounds in just your left ear!
* Added the rain sound track for when it rains or storms in game
* Added a brand new music track to the [[Flowering Meadows]], made by Chrythm!
* Added a setting to disable special vinyl effects (such as the halloween exclusive vinyls)
* The wind shake and wind lines can now be toggled in the settings menu.
* The property signs are now back for all of your locating needs!
* Sounds have been added for tool equipping, the [[Dye Machine|dye]] and [[Press Machine|press]], jarring [[fireflies]], crates, and blowing up walls.

=== Changes: ===

* ALL physics ownership of your items are now given to you in order to reduce server lag
* [[Schematics|Schematic]] colors are now blue again, rather than orange
* All players now start with a [[cube]] and [[Wedge|wedge schematic]]
* The default property size is now 55 (35 previously)
* Property can now only be expanded in increments of 5
* Lowered the price of property per stud to 180 (450 previously)
* Spaced out items which come from the starter pack
* The [[Petalfall]], [[Emberbane]], and [[Pedestal]] puzzles now all assign an owner to the resultant item
* All special "wire" types can now have content amounts provided in the store
* Vehicles and trailers now have a despawn option
* [[Cheese]] now assigns a color code for the [[Filter Conveyor|filter conveyor]]
* Begun changing map rock pieces into meshes that are more performant
* Data compression now happens on a separate Luau VM thread, which should increase performance on autosave events
* Property numbers are now internally defined so they should never randomly switch again
* Removed the [[Badges|Alpha Tester]] from the achievements, as it is a limited badge. You still receive the badge, you just can't see it in the achievements section
* Due to massive performance concerns, [[Mannequin|Mannequins]] can no longer be posed. This will likely be changed, we just want to adjust how it works first
* All characters now have the same amount of weight, regardless of size. This should ensure that small avatars can swim!
* [[Electronic Billboard|Electronic Billboards]] can now be resized down to 0.5x0.5x0.5 (1x1x1 previously)
* Temporarily blocked off the Sell bin in the [[Resource Hub]]
* Added 0.125 movement/scaling, 5.625 rotation increments
* Many of the [[schematics]] in-game can now be scaled down to 0.125 (0.25 previously)
* Loading your property onto wood and rocks will now delete said wood and rocks. (previously would not do anything)
* The [[Resource Hub]] no longer has a meteor location due to the new meshes
* Mining an entire rock node now kills the rock, initiating a respawn cycle

=== Fixes: ===

* Random map fixes
* Fixed the [[Floord Putter]] having very bouncy movement
* Fixed the [[Metal Refinery|Metal Refineries]] bounding box, this may have shifted existing ones in the world
* The jump button should no longer show while you have the [[Refined Scooba Tank|Refined Scooba]] gear equipped and enabled whilst driving
* [[Meteor]] craters now destroy any flowers/shrubs that were inside of it
* [[Badges|The First Time]] achievement should now be awarded to the player
* The [[Refined Axe]] should now correctly show Axe Power instead of Pickaxe Power in the inspect menu

== Version 1.62.0 (🐛 The Debuggification Update! 🐞) ==
'''July 15th, 2024'''

=== Added: ===

* [[Eel Kelp]], a special variant of kelp that provides that extra SHOCK you might need for your builds.
* [[Electrified Bamboo]], providing a NEON BLACK and NEON WHITE material, on top of the awesome red bark.
* Looking for something.. conductive? Jenna now has a quest for you in order to find [[Michael's Copper Axe]]. Talk to her to learn more!
* A new gamepass, the [[Easy Filling Gamepass]], allows you to fill up your schematics with 2x less material. This only applies to your property, so if you move those schematics, they may lose their fill state.
* You can now gift gamepasses to other users! A wonderful feature if you want to treat your friends to something special.

=== Changes: ===

* In order to keep developing the game, we have decided to adjust the prices for some of our gamepasses and other products. Hope you can understand!
* The product menu now has a new icon. The icon rotates slightly left and right, if this bothers you, there is a setting to disable it
* There's now new network ownership control for conveyors, improving the speed at which your items go along the conveyors.
* The lava cave has been remade with meshes, hopefully providing heavy performance improvements. Some things also may be easier / more challenging.
* The [[Resource Hub]] now has a leaderboard showing the most sold materials.
* The moon now has 7 phases that slowly change as time progresses!
* The [[Frequency Clock]] is now called a [[Frequency Clock|Hertz Clock]], and the [[Commander]] is now called a [[Commander|Chat Commander]]
* [[Boomite]]'s explosion time has been changed from 15 -> 10 minutes.
* [[Boomite]]'s refined value has been changed from 70 -> 120, and it's forged value has changed from 100 -> 180.
* Large [[Boomite]] Crystals now have a charge time of 5 -> 3, an explosion radius 80 -> 110, and can now trigger from players and trailers.
* Large [[Boomite]] Crystals now have a cool explosion particle!
* The awesome youtuber, [https://www.youtube.com/@N8te. N8te], now has a creator code! You'll be able to find out how to get that on his channel soon. (or you can just guess the code...)

=== Fixed: ===

* I'm not going to go in depth here, but there is a TON of bug fixes for this patch. Not only that, a TON of map issues have also been fixed. There's still a lot more to be done, but we have a big start!

== Version 1.63.0 ==
'''August 8th, 2024'''

=== Added: ===

* Create a basement for your property, going over 100 studs down! So much more building space, so much opportunity...
* Basements can be paid for a one-time fee of $125,000 per slot, or you can buy the [[Basements Gamepass]] and unlock them for all of your slots! The choice is yours.
* The width of basements automatically sizes to your property size, so if you want a wider basement, expand that property!
* Flora Lora is now selling wonderous vines! They are able to be colored all of the same colors that you can with the wire tool.
* You can also buy the [[Creative Wiring Gamepass|More Colors Gamepass]] if you want even more colors for some reason. (This is formally known as the [[Creative Wiring Gamepass|Creative Wiring gamepass]], all gamepasses are now renamed).

=== Changes: ===

* The singular [[brick]] you could find at Flora Lora is now DYEABLE with the [[Dye Machine|Dye machine]]. So many new color options, how delightful!
* The [[Brick|dyeable bricks]] function just like the [[Fabric Roll|fabric rolls]], so you will need to use a [[Press Machine|Press]] to create a jar of dye, and a Dye to combine that with the [[brick]].
* Brick.
* Jak has been working HARD on modifying the [[River Caves|River Cave]] & [[Plek|Plek Cave]]. Things are now a lot more 🫧 bubbly!
* The waterfalls now have 'smoke' (I don't know what it's called) at the bottom of the fall. [hoofer, it's called mist.]
* Some changes have been made to the tutorial. Most notably, you now start with tools in your inventory, and the [[Rusty Axe|rusty axe]] and [[Rusty Pickaxe|pickaxe]] have been buffed.
* All doors can now have their width resized all the way down to 0.25, this includes [[Garage Door|garage doors]]!
* [[Property Spawn Location|Player Spawns]] now create an invisible part on the client, this should prevent that issue where you would fall through your spawn when loading in.
* The [[Blueprint Fabricator]]'s [[Schematics|Schematic]] limit has been changed from 250 -> 500 [[schematics]].
* The [[Blueprint Fabricator]]'s max size has been changed from 80 -> 200 studs.
* The value of [[Lumite]] has been lowered by 15% (390 -> ~331 refined, 608 -> ~516 forged).

=== Fixes: ===

* Loads of performance changes have been made for the game. This should hopefully reduce the server lag by a ton.
* Many touched events for objects such as conveyors, [[Storage Drawer|drawers]], etc, are now on the client.
* Fixes for the Roblox physics sleeper have been made, this should be working now when it hasn't been since the release of WIND? (it's a long story...)
* A bunch of fixes for the build mode have been made, hopefully this becomes easier to use.

title: Version 1.65.0
wikitext:
== Version 1.65.0 (💡 The Quick Thinkin' Update! 🧠) ==
'''August 18th, 2024'''

=== Added: ===

* Introducing... the [[Donator|DONATOR]]! An ATM structure where the owner can define an amount they want donated, and users can donate to you! The structure will output their user id as a power. An [[interactor]] can change the donation amount.
* The [[Ownership Manager|OWNERSHIP MANAGER]]! This can transfer ownership of your items to other players. Powering it with 10.0 clears the ownership, powering it with a user id transfers the ownership to that user.
* The [[Speaker|SPEAKER]]! This sends out a chat message to you (and your friends by default) when it is powered. Any text that says {num} will be replaced by the power input. If other people do not like these chat messages, they can disable them in settings. It has a global cooldown of one second.
* Logic now also runs at a fixed clock speed. This may break some logic creations if it relied on inconsistent ticks. This had to be done in order to prevent exponential crashes, sorry!
* 🤑 Donations and ⭐ Stars now display a notification in chat and on the top of your screen!
* Donations will tell you who sent you the donation, and how much they sent.
* Stars will tell you who starred your base!

=== Changes: ===

* SO. SO. SO MANY IMPROVEMENTS. I have been working on this all week. I truly hope this works.
* The [[interactor]] and [[collider]] have been changed, allowing you to select an entire REGION for it's interaction. This means you no longer have to spend hours trying to make your setup visually look nice, without an [[interactor]] hand STICKING out!
* Another change to the [[interactor]] is that it will now interact with more than one object within its region.
* [[Elevator|Elevators]] should hopefully now be on the client. This means no more slow conveyors. Hopefully. I tried doing this last patch so I hope my changes mean it's actually working now.
* Autosaves now happen every 5 minutes (previously 3 minutes).
* The server performance of a bunch of machines has been improved. This should be noticeable if you have a BUNCH of them on your base. (except sanders)
* A bunch of random things has been done to data saving to hopefully improve server performance.
* Multithreading was broken for numerous systems. I spent forever adding this. AND. IT. DIDNT. EVEN. WORK. It now works :)
* A few more improvements have been made for tree, rock, and scenery cleanup.

=== Fixes: ===

* The build menu should now no longer randomly select a bunch of structures, yay!!
* An incredibly rare bug where wires and trees on your base would vanish is now gone. I hated handling bug reports for this, took so much time.
* The [[Speed Coil|speed]] & [[Fusion Coil|fusion coil]] now REMEMBER if you were sprinting when you unequip them.

🔌 | No more annoying disconnects! Well... sort of!? 

* Getting disconnected will now save any items / vehicles near your player. You will also be returned to that location upon rejoin.
* "This will not work if you are over an unclaimed property!

💎 | [[Magmite]], [[Jade]], [[Silver]]

* Three new ores have been added! What a delight
* [[Magmite]] slowly cools down before turning into [[obsidian]], you can keep it heated by being in the deep caverns, or use some [[Boxed Lava|boxed lava]]!

🪚 | The [[Bandsaw]]

📈 | Stock Market

* (most) Materials now are using a stock market! The stock market randomly changes the values of materials every day. This means that on some days, it might be better to farm other materials!

=== Additions: ===
🍬 | New Currency

* A limited time currency, [[Candy]], is here!

🦇🏰 | [[The Monstrous Manor|Monstrous Manor]]

* A large [[The Monstrous Manor|manor]] has appeared in front of [[the Oak Depot]]!
* [[The Monstrous Manor|The Manor]] contains all of the purchasable limited time items for the event.
* A limited time quest can be found at the [[The Monstrous Manor|manor]]! (learn more below later)
* All event items will be removed from the store on November 4th at 12 AM EST. Gifts will also be able to be opened on October 31st at 12 AM EST! Items will return, gifts will not.
* The Manor contains these items: [[Small Candle|Small]]/[[Tall Candle|Tall]]/[[Big Candle|Big Candles]], a [[Cauldron]], a [[Coffin]], [[Gravestone|Gravestones]], [[Tombstone|Tombstones]], a [[Hallowed Candlestick]], a [[Hallowed Lantern]], [[Halloween Balloons]], three vinyls (a new one by Genisis, art by Peekaboo!), and the [[Hardened Moon Rod]]!
* The Limited time gifts are: the [[Gift Of Spectral Whispers|Gift of Spectral Whispers]], and the [[Gift of Crystallized Blood|Gift of Crystalized Blood]].

🩸🌙 | [[Blood Moon]]!

* Every night, there is a chance for a [[Blood Moon|blood moon]] to occur. When this happens, massive structures will spawn from below the ground with INVADING ENEMIES!
* You can use your tools (Axe, Pickaxe, Grabbers) to attack the pesky enemies.
* The different enemies are the [[Zombie]], [[Skeleton]], [[Zombie|Pumpkin Zombie]], [[Linked Sword|Sword Skeleton]], [[Goblins|Goblin]], [[Werewolf]], [[Vampire]], and the Headless Horseman
* All of the drops you can get are some [[Bone|Bones]], [[Pumpkin|Pumpkins]], [[Skull|Skulls]], [[Zombie Head|Zombie Heads]], [[Candycorn]], [[Greeb]], a [[Meat Vinyl Player]], [[Moon Shard|Moon Shards]], and a [[Bodyless Horse]]!

* For a little hint: Find the attic.

👁️ | Limited Time Materials

* A few limited time materials have returned to Oaklands for you to obtain: [[Sweetstone]], [[Candycorn]], [[Hallow Tree|Hallow]], and [[Weeping Willow]].

💀 | Skeletal [[Meteor]]

🎃⛏️ | [[Mike's Mines]]

🎃 | Natural Pumpkins!

* [[Pumpkin|Pumpkins]] are spawning all over Finlay Island, each coming with a random size.
* Have fun finding rare giant variants! (Listen, you all begged for more random stuff, okay!?)

== Version 1.69.0 (Random Features Update!) ==
'''October 25th, 2024'''

=== Added: ===

* A new conveyor has been introduced, the [[Extending Conveyor]]! This conveyor is a toggleable conveyor that extends outwards, this means you can use it to create some awesome contraptions.
* Alongside the [[Extending Conveyor]], a major revamp has been made for the [[Filter Conveyor]]. You are now able to select multiple items to filter at once, and indidually pick out their properties to be filtered. We're still working on moving this system over to lasers, so stay tuned for that!
* We've decided that some fun changes need to be introduced for this update, so we added the [[Sparks Emitter]]! This is a fillable structure that emits sparks. Maybe you want to create a broken dashboard, or have some sparking electrical panels. You can find it at [[Illumine Designs]]!
* Ever wanted to display some of those awesome items you have? Well now you can with the [[Display Pedestal|Pedestal]]! This structure that can be found at Illumine Designs will levitate and rotate an item for displaying.
* A new base preset is here for 99 Robux, the 15 Stud Challenge Preset. This preset starts you out with 15 studs of land, something that isn't normally possible. You might be asking, why? Why not! Challenge yourself: try not to expand your land and progress through the game. Good luck!

=== Changes: ===

* Our data systems have been migrated from ProfileService to ProfileStore. This doesn't really mean anything to an average player, but we thought that it should be mentioned! This should have some improvements with loading in your slots.
* The UI for property selection has been changed to fit our new style! This is an ongoing effort and you may see some other UI change in the future! We hope you like it!
* The Lunar tools have temporarily had their antigravity effects removed due to the crazy bugs it created. We're still evaluating if it is worthwhile to maintain this feature!

📊 Material Value Changes!?

* Some material values have been adjusted for progression purposes. We've been listening, and we agree that [[Flameslate]] and [[Magmite]] were too weakened. As a result, [[Magmite]] has been buffed (240 -> 360) (296 -> 444) (Refined, Forged), and [[Flameslate]] has been buffed (72 -> 108) (84 -> 126). We've noticed [[Lumite]] has been way too easy to obtain, so the value of that has been lowered (195 -> 165) (304 -> 270). All values here are for volume!

=== Notes: ===

* The [https://lootbloc.com/products/oaklands-grabbiest-grabber-plushie?srsltid=AfmBOoooJSYHAX1BZQK---4YE9vJCPF-ThWybr5QlXmKlnbh4TuscmPT Grabbiest Grabber Plushie campaign] has ended! Our partnership with Lootbloc has been wonderful, and we are happy to announce that we made 250 sales for the plushie. It's such an honor being able to create awesome content for you, the community! 🥰
* Thanks for reading! We're winding down on major updates as we begin to progress towards the Christmas / Winter update coming this December! Stay tuned for more information on that 👀

== Version 1.70.0 (A Builder's Delight Update!) ==
'''November 16th, 2024'''

=== Added: ===

* The [[Material Gun]] is here, an all new game changing tool that allows you to easily fill and empty [[schematics]]. Simply consume some materials, make your selection, and fill in what you need!
* You can find the [[Material Gun]] in [[The Oak Depot]] for a fee of $99,999. It has upgrades that can be purchased to increase your storage limit as well.
* Optionally, there is a gamepass to increase the [[Material Gun]]'s storage to be infinite! This also gives you ONE free [[Material Gun]] for any desires you may have.
* Have you or a loved one ever wanted to float? Well now you can, using the freecam button in the top left! The freecam allows you to get awesome cinematic shots and pictures, with a limited travel distance that can be expanded for cash (or the new gamepass)

=== Changes: ===

* The speaker now supports the {display_name} variable, which will format the label to be the DisplayName of the inputted user id. Basically, in 'noob' terms, if you add {display_name} to your speaker, and attach a donator output to it, it will speak the name of who donated!
* Items outputted of refineries / forges / plankers now have a 3 second cooldown before they can go back into their same machine. We had to do this to prevent materials getting stuck repeatedly processing in the same machine. This took years to fix, isn't that crazy?
* So, when we revamped the slot selection screen, we forgot to add back the menu that showed your slot was outdated... This is fixed! No more risks involving joining really old servers and losing content that doesn't exist yet!
* The property selection screen now has helpful keybinds to quickly navigate through the menu. You can press E to select a property, or press A and D to switch through the options. So easy!
* The snow particles in the [[Snowlands|ice biome]] have been redone to hopefully be better. It's been very hard to get these looking good!

=== Notes: ===

* We hope you enjoy this small little update as we make progress towards the awesome Christmas update, which will include a new permanent ice revamp! Bye for now 👋

== Version 1.86.0 (⚒️Quality of Life Update👷) ==
=== 💡 New Spotlight ===
Ever wanted to make your base look extra special? Well now you can with the spotlight! It creates an awesome beam effect.


You can find the spotlight at Illumine Designs

== 🗺️ Minimap Cave Layers ==
The minimap now supports CAVE LAYERS. This should make it easier to navigate those pesky caves


The minimap's extra details menu is now hidden by default as well

== Semi Truck Improvements ==
We made a LOT of changes to the semi truck. it now has thicker walls, and can no longer unanchor items when flipping



The Upgrade of the Semi Truck now costs $25,000 We understand that before it was too pricey for players. No refunds :)

== 🔴 Raw Adurite Location ==

title: Weather Sensor
wikitext:
{{Stub}}

''"Outputs a signal [1-6]. 1 for sunny, 2 for cloudy, 3 for rain, 4 for thunderstorm, 5 for aurora borealis, 6 for star rain"''

The '''Weather Sensor''' is a logic component that can be purchased from [[Alan's AutoLogistics]] for $700. It outputs a signal of 1-6 depending on the current weather it senses.

The Weather Sensor is near identical to the [[Daylight Sensor]], the main feature being the eyeball. The only differentiating part of the Weather Sensor is the color of the eye's iris.

== Functionality ==
When placed, the Weather Sensor outputs a value of 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, or 6 depending on the current weather.

* 1 being Sunny/Clear.
* 2 being Cloudy.
* 3 being Rainy.
* 4 being a Thunderstorm.
* 5 being Aurora Borealis (Northern Lights)
* 6 being Star Rain

The weather sensor allows the user interact with structures such as the [[Electronic Billboard]] or [[14 Segment Display]], using wires. When connected to these structures, the output number (1, 2 , 3 4, 5, or 6) will be shown on the display.

The Weather Sensor is an output logic system only. It has no input connection.
[[Category:Logic]]

title: Wire
wikitext:
== Wire ==

=== How to create a Wire ===

==== PC ====
Hover over a black square (input/output) on any [[Logic]] component and press E on your keyboard.

Hover over another black square (input/output) on any [[Logic]] component and press E on your keyboard again, now press Confirm at the bottom of your   screen.

==== Mobile ====
Tap on a black square (input/output) on any [[Logic]] component and tap on Create Wire.

Tap on another black square (input/output) on any [[Logic]] component and tap on the black square, now press Confirm at the bottom of your screen.

== Trivia ==

* The largest number that can be transmitted through a wire is 999,999,999,999.

'''Zapium''' is a relatively uncommon ore that can only spawn in [[Electrified Rock|Electrified Stone]] nodes inside of [[Meteor|Electrified Meteor]] Crash Sites.

The raw form of '''Zapium''' is neon yellow with pulses of electricity emitting from the small nodes. When refined, it becomes a yellow foil material, and when forged, becomes a solid neon yellow.

It's raw and refined prices are currently unknown. When forged, it is worth around $65 a stud.

Like any other materials in the game, you can use refined and forged '''Zapium''' to complete schematics.<gallery>
Forged '''Zapium''' is used in acquiring the '''[[Lightningbane|Lightningbane]]''' pickaxe
